**목표**: FV 언어로 FV 컴파일러를 작성하여 `fv` 명령어로 FV 코드를 컴파일할 수 있도록 구현

**상태**: 🚀 시작 예정
**예상 기간**: 2주 (8-14일)

---

**목표**: 480줄의 V 코드로 Lexer 구현

**파일**: `fv-lang/src/lexer.fv`

**구현 내용**:
- Token 타입 정의 (50+ 토큰)
- 키워드 매핑 (34개 키워드)
- 문자 읽기 헬퍼 (readChar, peekChar, skipWhitespace)
- 토큰 인식 로직
  - 식별자 & 키워드
  - 숫자 (정수, 부동소수점)
  - 문자열 (큰따옴표, 작은따옴표)
  - 연산자 & 구분자
  - 주석 (라인, 블록)
- 전체 토크나이제이션

**테스트**: 14개 테스트 케이스
**기준**: Go Lexer와 동일한 토큰 출력

  - 함수 호출, 배열 인덱싱

  - 변수 선언 (let)

  - 함수 호출
  - 반환

  - 함수 정의
  - 구조체 정의
  - 인터페이스 정의
  - 변수/상수 정의
- 에러 복구 및 보고

**기준**: Go Parser와 동일한 AST 생성

- 에러 수집 및 보고

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.1: FreeJulia Lexer Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia Lexer를 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# 이 파일은 FreeJulia 컴파일러의 Lexer을
# FreeJulia 언어로 재작성한 것입니다.
#
# 목표: 자기-호스팅 (Self-Hosting)
# - FreeJulia로 FreeJulia를 컴파일할 수 있도록 함
#
# 기능:
# - 문자 읽기 및 토크나이제이션
# - 50+ 토큰 타입 지원
# - 라인/열 추적
# - 주석 처리 (라인, 블록)
# - 키워드 인식

# ==========================================
# 토큰 타입 정의
# ==========================================

record TokenType =
  | INT
  | FLOAT
  | STRING
  | CHAR
  | BOOL
  | NIL
  | IDENT
  | PLUS
  | MINUS
  | MULTIPLY
  | DIVIDE
  | MODULO
  | POWER
  | ASSIGN
  | PLUS_ASSIGN
  | MINUS_ASSIGN
  | MULTIPLY_ASSIGN
  | DIVIDE_ASSIGN
  | EQ
  | NEQ
  | LT
  | LE
  | GT
  | GE
  | AND
  | OR
  | NOT
  | LPAREN
  | RPAREN
  | LBRACE
  | RBRACE
  | LBRACKET
  | RBRACKET
  | SEMICOLON
  | COMMA
  | DOT
  | COLON
  | ARROW
  | FAT_ARROW
  | AMPERSAND
  | PIPE
  | CARET
  | TILDE
  | QUESTION
  | KEYWORD_LET
  | KEYWORD_FN
  | KEYWORD_RETURN
  | KEYWORD_IF
  | KEYWORD_ELSE
  | KEYWORD_FOR
  | KEYWORD_WHILE
  | KEYWORD_BREAK
  | KEYWORD_CONTINUE
  | KEYWORD_STRUCT
  | KEYWORD_ENUM
  | KEYWORD_INTERFACE
  | KEYWORD_MATCH
  | KEYWORD_IMPORT
  | KEYWORD_EXPORT
  | KEYWORD_RECORD
  | KEYWORD_TYPE
  | EOF_TOKEN
  | NEWLINE
  | COMMENT

# ==========================================
# Token 구조체
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: TokenType
  value: String
  line: Int
  column: Int

# ==========================================
# Lexer 구조체
# ==========================================

record Lexer =
  input: String
  position: Int
  read_position: Int
  ch: Char
  line: Int
  column: Int
  tokens: Array[Token]

# ==========================================
# 헬퍼 함수
# ==========================================

# Lexer 초기화
function new_lexer(input: String): Lexer =
  let lexer = Lexer {
    input: input,
    position: 0,
    read_position: 1,
    ch: if input.length() > 0 then input[0] else '\0',
    line: 1,
    column: 1,
    tokens: []
  }
  lexer

# 다음 문자 읽기
function read_char(lexer: Lexer): Void =
  if lexer.read_position >= lexer.input.length() then
    lexer.ch = '\0'
  else
    lexer.ch = lexer.input[lexer.read_position]
  end
  lexer.position = lexer.read_position
  lexer.read_position = lexer.read_position + 1
  if lexer.ch == '\n' then
    lexer.line = lexer.line + 1
    lexer.column = 1
  else
    lexer.column = lexer.column + 1
  end

# 현재 문자 보기 (읽지 않음)
function peek_char(lexer: Lexer): Char =
  if lexer.read_position >= lexer.input.length() then
    '\0'
  else
    lexer.input[lexer.read_position]
  end

# 공백 건너뛰기
function skip_whitespace(lexer: Lexer): Void =
  while lexer.ch == ' ' or lexer.ch == '\t' or lexer.ch == '\r' do
    read_char(lexer)
  end

# 라인 주석 건너뛰기 (//)
function skip_line_comment(lexer: Lexer): Void =
  while lexer.ch != '\n' and lexer.ch != '\0' do
    read_char(lexer)
  end

# 블록 주석 건너뛰기 (/* */)
function skip_block_comment(lexer: Lexer): Void =
  read_char(lexer)  # skip '/'
  read_char(lexer)  # skip '*'
  while lexer.ch != '\0' do
    if lexer.ch == '*' and peek_char(lexer) == '/' then
      read_char(lexer)  # skip '*'
      read_char(lexer)  # skip '/'
      return
    end
    read_char(lexer)
  end

# 문자가 식별자 시작 문자인지 확인
function is_ident_start(ch: Char): Bool =
  (ch >= 'a' and ch <= 'z') or
  (ch >= 'A' and ch <= 'Z') or
  ch == '_'

# 문자가 식별자 계속 문자인지 확인
function is_ident_char(ch: Char): Bool =
  is_ident_start(ch) or (ch >= '0' and ch <= '9')

# 문자가 숫자인지 확인
function is_digit(ch: Char): Bool =
  ch >= '0' and ch <= '9'

# 식별자 읽기
function read_ident(lexer: Lexer): String =
  let start = lexer.position
  while is_ident_char(lexer.ch) do
    read_char(lexer)
  end
  lexer.input.substring(start, lexer.position)

# 숫자 읽기
function read_number(lexer: Lexer): String =
  let start = lexer.position
  # 정수 부분
  while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
    read_char(lexer)
  end
  # 부동소수점 부분
  if lexer.ch == '.' and is_digit(peek_char(lexer)) then
    read_char(lexer)  # skip '.'
    while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
      read_char(lexer)
    end
  end
  # 지수 부분
  if lexer.ch == 'e' or lexer.ch == 'E' then
    read_char(lexer)
    if lexer.ch == '+' or lexer.ch == '-' then
      read_char(lexer)
    end
    while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
      read_char(lexer)
    end
  end
  lexer.input.substring(start, lexer.position)

# 문자열 읽기
function read_string(lexer: Lexer, quote: Char): String =
  read_char(lexer)  # skip opening quote
  let start = lexer.position
  while lexer.ch != quote and lexer.ch != '\0' do
    if lexer.ch == '\\' then
      read_char(lexer)  # skip escape char
    end
    read_char(lexer)
  end
  let result = lexer.input.substring(start, lexer.position)
  if lexer.ch == quote then
    read_char(lexer)  # skip closing quote
  end
  result

# 키워드 인식
function lookup_ident(ident: String): TokenType =
  match ident {
    "let" -> KEYWORD_LET,
    "fn" -> KEYWORD_FN,
    "return" -> KEYWORD_RETURN,
    "if" -> KEYWORD_IF,
    "else" -> KEYWORD_ELSE,
    "for" -> KEYWORD_FOR,
    "while" -> KEYWORD_WHILE,
    "break" -> KEYWORD_BREAK,
    "continue" -> KEYWORD_CONTINUE,
    "struct" -> KEYWORD_STRUCT,
    "enum" -> KEYWORD_ENUM,
    "interface" -> KEYWORD_INTERFACE,
    "match" -> KEYWORD_MATCH,
    "import" -> KEYWORD_IMPORT,
    "export" -> KEYWORD_EXPORT,
    "record" -> KEYWORD_RECORD,
    "type" -> KEYWORD_TYPE,
    "true" -> BOOL,
    "false" -> BOOL,
    "nil" -> NIL,
    _ -> IDENT
  }

# 토큰 추가
function add_token(lexer: Lexer, type_: TokenType, value: String): Void =
  let token = Token {
    type: type_,
    value: value,
    line: lexer.line,
    column: lexer.column
  }
  lexer.tokens.push(token)

# ==========================================
# 메인 토크나이제이션 엔진
# ==========================================

function next_token(lexer: Lexer): Token =
  skip_whitespace(lexer)

  # 주석 처리
  if lexer.ch == '/' and peek_char(lexer) == '/' then
    skip_line_comment(lexer)
    return next_token(lexer)
  end
  if lexer.ch == '/' and peek_char(lexer) == '*' then
    skip_block_comment(lexer)
    return next_token(lexer)
  end

  let token_type = match lexer.ch {
    '+' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); PLUS_ASSIGN }
      else PLUS
    },
    '-' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); MINUS_ASSIGN }
      else if lexer.ch == '>' then { read_char(lexer); ARROW }
      else MINUS
    },
    '*' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); MULTIPLY_ASSIGN }
      else MULTIPLY
    },
    '/' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); DIVIDE_ASSIGN }
      else DIVIDE
    },
    '%' -> { read_char(lexer); MODULO },
    '^' -> { read_char(lexer); POWER },
    '=' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); EQ }
      else if lexer.ch == '>' then { read_char(lexer); FAT_ARROW }
      else ASSIGN
    },
    '!' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); NEQ }
      else NOT
    },
    '<' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); LE }
      else LT
    },
    '>' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); GE }
      else GT
    },
    '&' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '&' then { read_char(lexer); AND }
      else AMPERSAND
    },
    '|' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '|' then { read_char(lexer); OR }
      else PIPE
    },
    '(' -> { read_char(lexer); LPAREN },
    ')' -> { read_char(lexer); RPAREN },
    '{' -> { read_char(lexer); LBRACE },
    '}' -> { read_char(lexer); RBRACE },
    '[' -> { read_char(lexer); LBRACKET },
    ']' -> { read_char(lexer); RBRACKET },
    ';' -> { read_char(lexer); SEMICOLON },
    ',' -> { read_char(lexer); COMMA },
    '.' -> { read_char(lexer); DOT },
    ':' -> { read_char(lexer); COLON },
    '~' -> { read_char(lexer); TILDE },
    '?' -> { read_char(lexer); QUESTION },
    '\n' -> { read_char(lexer); NEWLINE },
    '\0' -> EOF_TOKEN,
    _ -> {
      if is_ident_start(lexer.ch) then {
        let ident = read_ident(lexer)
        lookup_ident(ident)
      } else if is_digit(lexer.ch) then {
        let num = read_number(lexer)
        if num.contains(".") then FLOAT else INT
      } else if lexer.ch == '"' then {
        read_string(lexer, '"')
        STRING
      } else if lexer.ch == '\'' then {
        read_string(lexer, '\'')
        CHAR
      } else {
        read_char(lexer)
        COMMENT  # 인식되지 않은 문자
      }
    }
  }

  Token {
    type: token_type,
    value: if token_type == INT or token_type == FLOAT or token_type == STRING or token_type == CHAR
           then (if is_ident_start(lexer.input[lexer.position])
                 then read_ident(lexer)
                 else "")
           else "",
    line: lexer.line,
    column: lexer.column
  }

# 전체 토크나이제이션
function tokenize(input: String): Array[Token] =
  let lexer = new_lexer(input)
  let tokens: Array[Token] = []

  loop {
    let token = next_token(lexer)
    tokens.push(token)
    if token.type == EOF_TOKEN then break
  }

  tokens

  while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
    read_char(lexer)
  end
  # 부동소수점 부분
  if lexer.ch == '.' and is_digit(peek_char(lexer)) then
    read_char(lexer)  # skip '.'
    while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
      read_char(lexer)
    end
  end
  # 지수 부분
  if lexer.ch == 'e' or lexer.ch == 'E' then
    read_char(lexer)
    if lexer.ch == '+' or lexer.ch == '-' then
      read_char(lexer)
    end
    while is_digit(lexer.ch) do
      read_char(lexer)
    end
  end
  lexer.input.substring(start, lexer.position)

# 문자열 읽기
function read_string(lexer: Lexer, quote: Char): String =
  read_char(lexer)  # skip opening quote
  let start = lexer.position
  while lexer.ch != quote and lexer.ch != '\0' do
    if lexer.ch == '\\' then
      read_char(lexer)  # skip escape char
    end
    read_char(lexer)
  end
  let result = lexer.input.substring(start, lexer.position)
  if lexer.ch == quote then
    read_char(lexer)  # skip closing quote
  end
  result

# 키워드 인식
function lookup_ident(ident: String): TokenType =
  match ident {
    "let" -> KEYWORD_LET,
    "fn" -> KEYWORD_FN,
    "return" -> KEYWORD_RETURN,
    "if" -> KEYWORD_IF,
    "else" -> KEYWORD_ELSE,
    "for" -> KEYWORD_FOR,
    "while" -> KEYWORD_WHILE,
    "break" -> KEYWORD_BREAK,
    "continue" -> KEYWORD_CONTINUE,
    "struct" -> KEYWORD_STRUCT,
    "enum" -> KEYWORD_ENUM,
    "interface" -> KEYWORD_INTERFACE,
    "match" -> KEYWORD_MATCH,
    "import" -> KEYWORD_IMPORT,
    "export" -> KEYWORD_EXPORT,
    "record" -> KEYWORD_RECORD,
    "type" -> KEYWORD_TYPE,
    "true" -> BOOL,
    "false" -> BOOL,
    "nil" -> NIL,
    _ -> IDENT
  }

# 토큰 추가
function add_token(lexer: Lexer, type_: TokenType, value: String): Void =
  let token = Token {
    type: type_,
    value: value,
    line: lexer.line,
    column: lexer.column
  }
  lexer.tokens.push(token)

# ==========================================
# 메인 토크나이제이션 엔진
# ==========================================

function next_token(lexer: Lexer): Token =
  skip_whitespace(lexer)

  # 주석 처리
  if lexer.ch == '/' and peek_char(lexer) == '/' then
    skip_line_comment(lexer)
    return next_token(lexer)
  end
  if lexer.ch == '/' and peek_char(lexer) == '*' then
    skip_block_comment(lexer)
    return next_token(lexer)
  end

  let token_type = match lexer.ch {
    '+' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); PLUS_ASSIGN }
      else PLUS
    },
    '-' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); MINUS_ASSIGN }
      else if lexer.ch == '>' then { read_char(lexer); ARROW }
      else MINUS
    },
    '*' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); MULTIPLY_ASSIGN }
      else MULTIPLY
    },
    '/' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); DIVIDE_ASSIGN }
      else DIVIDE
    },
    '%' -> { read_char(lexer); MODULO },
    '^' -> { read_char(lexer); POWER },
    '=' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); EQ }
      else if lexer.ch == '>' then { read_char(lexer); FAT_ARROW }
      else ASSIGN
    },
    '!' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); NEQ }
      else NOT
    },
    '<' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); LE }
      else LT
    },
    '>' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '=' then { read_char(lexer); GE }
      else GT
    },
    '&' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '&' then { read_char(lexer); AND }
      else AMPERSAND
    },
    '|' -> {
      read_char(lexer)
      if lexer.ch == '|' then { read_char(lexer); OR }
      else PIPE
    },
    '(' -> { read_char(lexer); LPAREN },
    ')' -> { read_char(lexer); RPAREN },
    '{' -> { read_char(lexer); LBRACE },
    '}' -> { read_char(lexer); RBRACE },
    '[' -> { read_char(lexer); LBRACKET },
    ']' -> { read_char(lexer); RBRACKET },
    ';' -> { read_char(lexer); SEMICOLON },
    ',' -> { read_char(lexer); COMMA },
    '.' -> { read_char(lexer); DOT },
    ':' -> { read_char(lexer); COLON },
    '~' -> { read_char(lexer); TILDE },
    '?' -> { read_char(lexer); QUESTION },
    '\n' -> { read_char(lexer); NEWLINE },
    '\0' -> EOF_TOKEN,
    _ -> {
      if is_ident_start(lexer.ch) then {
        let ident = read_ident(lexer)
        lookup_ident(ident)
      } else if is_digit(lexer.ch) then {
        let num = read_number(lexer)
        if num.contains(".") then FLOAT else INT
      } else if lexer.ch == '"' then {
        read_string(lexer, '"')
        STRING
      } else if lexer.ch == '\'' then {
        read_string(lexer, '\'')
        CHAR
      } else {
        read_char(lexer)
        COMMENT  # 인식되지 않은 문자
      }
    }
  }

  Token {
    type: token_type,
    value: if token_type == INT or token_type == FLOAT or token_type == STRING or token_type == CHAR
           then (if is_ident_start(lexer.input[lexer.position])
                 then read_ident(lexer)
                 else "")
           else "",
    line: lexer.line,
    column: lexer.column
  }

# 전체 토크나이제이션
function tokenize(input: String): Array[Token] =
  let lexer = new_lexer(input)
  let tokens: Array[Token] = []

  loop {
    let token = next_token(lexer)
    tokens.push(token)
    if token.type == EOF_TOKEN then break
  }

  tokens

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.2: FreeJulia Parser Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia Parser를 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# Self-Hosting Parser 구현
#
# 기능:
# - 토큰 스트림 → AST (Abstract Syntax Tree)
# - 표현식 파싱 (이항/단항 연산)
# - 문장 파싱 (let, if, for, while 등)
# - 선언 파싱 (함수, 구조체, enum 등)
# - 에러 복구 & 보고

# ==========================================
# AST 노드 정의
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String  # "program", "function", "let", "if", etc.
  name: String
  value: String
  line: Int
  column: Int
  children: Array[ASTNode]
  properties: Array[(String, String)]

# ==========================================
# Parser 구조체
# ==========================================

record Parser =
  tokens: Array[Token]
  current: Int
  errors: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# Parser 헬퍼 함수
# ==========================================

# Parser 초기화
function new_parser(tokens: Array[Token]): Parser =
  Parser {
    tokens: tokens,
    current: 0,
    errors: []
  }

# 현재 토큰 반환
function current_token(parser: Parser): Token =
  if parser.current >= parser.tokens.length() then
    parser.tokens[parser.tokens.length() - 1]  # EOF
  else
    parser.tokens[parser.current]
  end

# 다음 토큰 반환 (현재 토큰 이동)
function next_token(parser: Parser): Token =
  let token = current_token(parser)
  if parser.current < parser.tokens.length() - 1 then
    parser.current = parser.current + 1
  end
  token

# 토큰 타입 확인
function check(parser: Parser, type_: TokenType): Bool =
  current_token(parser).type == type_

# 토큰 타입 일치하고 이동
function match(parser: Parser, type_: TokenType): Bool =
  if check(parser, type_) then
    next_token(parser)
    true
  else
    false
  end

# EOF 도달 확인
function is_at_end(parser: Parser): Bool =
  check(parser, EOF_TOKEN)

# 에러 추가
function add_error(parser: Parser, message: String): Void =
  let token = current_token(parser)
  let error_msg = "Error at line " + token.line.to_string() +
                  ", column " + token.column.to_string() +
                  ": " + message
  parser.errors.push(error_msg)

# ==========================================
# AST 생성 헬퍼
# ==========================================

# 간단한 AST 노드 생성
function make_node(type_: String, name: String, value: String): ASTNode =
  ASTNode {
    type: type_,
    name: name,
    value: value,
    line: 0,
    column: 0,
    children: [],
    properties: []
  }

# 자식 노드 추가
function add_child(node: ASTNode, child: ASTNode): Void =
  node.children.push(child)

# 속성 추가
function add_property(node: ASTNode, key: String, value: String): Void =
  node.properties.push((key, value))

# ==========================================
# 표현식 파싱
# ==========================================

# 기본 표현식 (리터럴, 식별자, 괄호)
function parse_primary(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let token = current_token(parser)

  match token.type {
    INT -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("literal", "int", token.value)
    },
    FLOAT -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("literal", "float", token.value)
    },
    STRING -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("literal", "string", token.value)
    },
    BOOL -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("literal", "bool", token.value)
    },
    NIL -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("literal", "nil", "")
    },
    IDENT -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("identifier", token.value, "")
    },
    LPAREN -> {
      next_token(parser)  # skip '('
      let expr = parse_expression(parser)
      if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after expression")
      end
      expr
    },
    _ -> {
      add_error(parser, "Unexpected token: " + token.value)
      make_node("error", "", "")
    }
  }

# 단항 연산 (-x, !x)
function parse_unary(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  if match(parser, MINUS) or match(parser, NOT) then
    let op = current_token(parser)
    let operand = parse_unary(parser)
    let node = make_node("unary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, operand)
    node
  else
    parse_primary(parser)
  end

# 곱셈/나눗셈 (*, /)
function parse_multiplicative(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_unary(parser)

  while check(parser, MULTIPLY) or check(parser, DIVIDE) or check(parser, MODULO) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_unary(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 덧셈/뺄셈 (+, -)
function parse_additive(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_multiplicative(parser)

  while check(parser, PLUS) or check(parser, MINUS) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_multiplicative(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 비교 연산 (<, >, ==, !=)
function parse_comparison(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_additive(parser)

  while check(parser, LT) or check(parser, LE) or
        check(parser, GT) or check(parser, GE) or
        check(parser, EQ) or check(parser, NEQ) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_additive(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 논리 AND
function parse_logical_and(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_comparison(parser)

  while check(parser, AND) do
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_comparison(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", "&&")
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 논리 OR
function parse_logical_or(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_logical_and(parser)

  while check(parser, OR) do
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_logical_and(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", "||")
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 함수 호출 & 배열 인덱싱
function parse_postfix(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let expr = parse_logical_or(parser)

  while true do
    if check(parser, LPAREN) then
      # 함수 호출
      next_token(parser)
      let call_node = make_node("call", "", "")
      add_child(call_node, expr)

      # 파라미터 파싱
      while not check(parser, RPAREN) and not is_at_end(parser) do
        let arg = parse_expression(parser)
        add_child(call_node, arg)
        if not check(parser, RPAREN) then
          if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
        end
      end

      if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after arguments")
      end
      expr = call_node
    else if check(parser, LBRACKET) then
      # 배열 인덱싱
      next_token(parser)
      let index_node = make_node("index", "", "")
      add_child(index_node, expr)
      let index = parse_expression(parser)
      add_child(index_node, index)

      if not match(parser, RBRACKET) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ']' after index")
      end
      expr = index_node
    else if check(parser, DOT) then
      # 멤버 접근
      next_token(parser)
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)
      let member_node = make_node("member", field_name, "")
      add_child(member_node, expr)
      expr = member_node
    else
      break
    end
  end

  expr

# 전체 표현식 파싱
function parse_expression(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  parse_postfix(parser)

# ==========================================
# 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

# let 바인딩
function parse_let(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'let'
  let var_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)  # skip name

  let node = make_node("let", var_name, "")

  # 타입 annotation (선택)
  if match(parser, COLON) then
    let type_name = current_token(parser).value
    next_token(parser)
    add_property(node, "type", type_name)
  end

  # 초기값
  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    let value = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, value)
  end

  node

# if 문
function parse_if(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'if'
  let condition = parse_expression(parser)

  let node = make_node("if", "", "")
  add_child(node, condition)

  # then 블록
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_LET) or match(parser, LBRACE) then
    # body parsing (simplified)
    let body = make_node("block", "", "")
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  # else 블록 (선택)
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_ELSE) then
    let else_node = make_node("else", "", "")
    # else body (simplified)
    add_child(node, else_node)
  end

  node

# for 루프
function parse_for(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'for'
  let var_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("for", var_name, "")

  # 'in' 키워드는 KEYWORD_IF처럼 처리 (간단히)
  # 실제로는 'in' 토큰 필요
  let iter = parse_expression(parser)
  add_child(node, iter)

  # body
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_LET) or match(parser, LBRACE) then
    let body = make_node("block", "", "")
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  node

# match 표현식
function parse_match(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'match'
  let expr = parse_expression(parser)

  let node = make_node("match", "", "")
  add_child(node, expr)

  if match(parser, LBRACE) then
    while not check(parser, RBRACE) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      # pattern -> body
      let pattern = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, FAT_ARROW) then
        let body = parse_expression(parser)
        let case_node = make_node("case", pattern, "")
        add_child(case_node, body)
        add_child(node, case_node)
      end

      if not check(parser, RBRACE) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RBRACE) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected '}' after match cases")
    end
  end

  node

# return 문
function parse_return(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'return'
  let node = make_node("return", "", "")

  if not check(parser, SEMICOLON) and not check(parser, RBRACE) then
    let value = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, value)
  end

  node

# ==========================================
# 선언 파싱
# ==========================================

# 함수 정의
function parse_function(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'fn'
  let func_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("function", func_name, "")

  # 파라미터
  if match(parser, LPAREN) then
    while not check(parser, RPAREN) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      let param_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let param_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let param = make_node("parameter", param_name, "")
        add_property(param, "type", param_type)
        add_child(node, param)
      end

      if not check(parser, RPAREN) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after parameters")
    end
  end

  # 반환 타입
  if match(parser, COLON) then
    let return_type = current_token(parser).value
    next_token(parser)
    add_property(node, "return_type", return_type)
  end

  # 함수 본문
  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    let body = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  node

# 구조체 정의
function parse_struct(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'struct'
  let struct_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("struct", struct_name, "")

  if match(parser, LBRACE) then
    while not check(parser, RBRACE) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let field_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let field = make_node("field", field_name, "")
        add_property(field, "type", field_type)
        add_child(node, field)
      end

      if not check(parser, RBRACE) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RBRACE) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected '}' after struct fields")
    end
  end

  node

# record 정의 (FreeJulia 특화)
function parse_record(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'record'
  let record_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("record", record_name, "")

  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    # 레코드 필드 파싱
    while not check(parser, EOF_TOKEN) do
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let field_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let field = make_node("field", field_name, "")
        add_property(field, "type", field_type)
        add_child(node, field)
      end

      if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
    end
  end

  node

# enum 정의
function parse_enum(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'enum'
  let enum_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("enum", enum_name, "")

  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    while not check(parser, EOF_TOKEN) do
      let variant = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)
      let variant_node = make_node("variant", variant, "")
      add_child(node, variant_node)

      if not match(parser, PIPE) then break
    end
  end

  node

# 프로그램 파싱
function parse_program(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let program = make_node("program", "", "")

  while not is_at_end(parser) do
    if check(parser, KEYWORD_FN) then
      let func = parse_function(parser)
      add_child(program, func)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_STRUCT) then
      let struct_ = parse_struct(parser)
      add_child(program, struct_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_RECORD) then
      let record = parse_record(parser)
      add_child(program, record)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_ENUM) then
      let enum_ = parse_enum(parser)
      add_child(program, enum_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_LET) then
      let let_ = parse_let(parser)
      add_child(program, let_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_IF) then
      let if_ = parse_if(parser)
      add_child(program, if_)
    else
      next_token(parser)
    end
  end

  program

# ==========================================
# 메인 파싱 함수
# ==========================================

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): ASTNode =
  let parser = new_parser(tokens)
  parse_program(parser)

    IDENT -> {
      next_token(parser)
      make_node("identifier", token.value, "")
    },
    LPAREN -> {
      next_token(parser)  # skip '('
      let expr = parse_expression(parser)
      if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after expression")
      end
      expr
    },
    _ -> {
      add_error(parser, "Unexpected token: " + token.value)
      make_node("error", "", "")
    }
  }

# 단항 연산 (-x, !x)
function parse_unary(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  if match(parser, MINUS) or match(parser, NOT) then
    let op = current_token(parser)
    let operand = parse_unary(parser)
    let node = make_node("unary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, operand)
    node
  else
    parse_primary(parser)
  end

# 곱셈/나눗셈 (*, /)
function parse_multiplicative(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_unary(parser)

  while check(parser, MULTIPLY) or check(parser, DIVIDE) or check(parser, MODULO) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_unary(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 덧셈/뺄셈 (+, -)
function parse_additive(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_multiplicative(parser)

  while check(parser, PLUS) or check(parser, MINUS) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_multiplicative(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 비교 연산 (<, >, ==, !=)
function parse_comparison(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_additive(parser)

  while check(parser, LT) or check(parser, LE) or
        check(parser, GT) or check(parser, GE) or
        check(parser, EQ) or check(parser, NEQ) do
    let op = current_token(parser)
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_additive(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", op.value)
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 논리 AND
function parse_logical_and(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_comparison(parser)

  while check(parser, AND) do
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_comparison(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", "&&")
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 논리 OR
function parse_logical_or(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let left = parse_logical_and(parser)

  while check(parser, OR) do
    next_token(parser)
    let right = parse_logical_and(parser)
    let node = make_node("binary", "", "")
    add_property(node, "operator", "||")
    add_child(node, left)
    add_child(node, right)
    left = node
  end

  left

# 함수 호출 & 배열 인덱싱
function parse_postfix(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let expr = parse_logical_or(parser)

  while true do
    if check(parser, LPAREN) then
      # 함수 호출
      next_token(parser)
      let call_node = make_node("call", "", "")
      add_child(call_node, expr)

      # 파라미터 파싱
      while not check(parser, RPAREN) and not is_at_end(parser) do
        let arg = parse_expression(parser)
        add_child(call_node, arg)
        if not check(parser, RPAREN) then
          if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
        end
      end

      if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after arguments")
      end
      expr = call_node
    else if check(parser, LBRACKET) then
      # 배열 인덱싱
      next_token(parser)
      let index_node = make_node("index", "", "")
      add_child(index_node, expr)
      let index = parse_expression(parser)
      add_child(index_node, index)

      if not match(parser, RBRACKET) then
        add_error(parser, "Expected ']' after index")
      end
      expr = index_node
    else if check(parser, DOT) then
      # 멤버 접근
      next_token(parser)
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)
      let member_node = make_node("member", field_name, "")
      add_child(member_node, expr)
      expr = member_node
    else
      break
    end
  end

  expr

# 전체 표현식 파싱
function parse_expression(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  parse_postfix(parser)

# ==========================================
# 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

# let 바인딩
function parse_let(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'let'
  let var_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)  # skip name

  let node = make_node("let", var_name, "")

  # 타입 annotation (선택)
  if match(parser, COLON) then
    let type_name = current_token(parser).value
    next_token(parser)
    add_property(node, "type", type_name)
  end

  # 초기값
  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    let value = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, value)
  end

  node

# if 문
function parse_if(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'if'
  let condition = parse_expression(parser)

  let node = make_node("if", "", "")
  add_child(node, condition)

  # then 블록
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_LET) or match(parser, LBRACE) then
    # body parsing (simplified)
    let body = make_node("block", "", "")
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  # else 블록 (선택)
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_ELSE) then
    let else_node = make_node("else", "", "")
    # else body (simplified)
    add_child(node, else_node)
  end

  node

# for 루프
function parse_for(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'for'
  let var_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("for", var_name, "")

  # 'in' 키워드는 KEYWORD_IF처럼 처리 (간단히)
  # 실제로는 'in' 토큰 필요
  let iter = parse_expression(parser)
  add_child(node, iter)

  # body
  if match(parser, KEYWORD_LET) or match(parser, LBRACE) then
    let body = make_node("block", "", "")
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  node

# match 표현식
function parse_match(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'match'
  let expr = parse_expression(parser)

  let node = make_node("match", "", "")
  add_child(node, expr)

  if match(parser, LBRACE) then
    while not check(parser, RBRACE) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      # pattern -> body
      let pattern = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, FAT_ARROW) then
        let body = parse_expression(parser)
        let case_node = make_node("case", pattern, "")
        add_child(case_node, body)
        add_child(node, case_node)
      end

      if not check(parser, RBRACE) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RBRACE) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected '}' after match cases")
    end
  end

  node

# return 문
function parse_return(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'return'
  let node = make_node("return", "", "")

  if not check(parser, SEMICOLON) and not check(parser, RBRACE) then
    let value = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, value)
  end

  node

# ==========================================
# 선언 파싱
# ==========================================

# 함수 정의
function parse_function(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'fn'
  let func_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("function", func_name, "")

  # 파라미터
  if match(parser, LPAREN) then
    while not check(parser, RPAREN) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      let param_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let param_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let param = make_node("parameter", param_name, "")
        add_property(param, "type", param_type)
        add_child(node, param)
      end

      if not check(parser, RPAREN) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RPAREN) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected ')' after parameters")
    end
  end

  # 반환 타입
  if match(parser, COLON) then
    let return_type = current_token(parser).value
    next_token(parser)
    add_property(node, "return_type", return_type)
  end

  # 함수 본문
  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    let body = parse_expression(parser)
    add_child(node, body)
  end

  node

# 구조체 정의
function parse_struct(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'struct'
  let struct_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("struct", struct_name, "")

  if match(parser, LBRACE) then
    while not check(parser, RBRACE) and not is_at_end(parser) do
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let field_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let field = make_node("field", field_name, "")
        add_property(field, "type", field_type)
        add_child(node, field)
      end

      if not check(parser, RBRACE) then
        if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
      end
    end

    if not match(parser, RBRACE) then
      add_error(parser, "Expected '}' after struct fields")
    end
  end

  node

# record 정의 (FreeJulia 특화)
function parse_record(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'record'
  let record_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("record", record_name, "")

  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    # 레코드 필드 파싱
    while not check(parser, EOF_TOKEN) do
      let field_name = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)

      if match(parser, COLON) then
        let field_type = current_token(parser).value
        next_token(parser)
        let field = make_node("field", field_name, "")
        add_property(field, "type", field_type)
        add_child(node, field)
      end

      if not match(parser, COMMA) then break
    end
  end

  node

# enum 정의
function parse_enum(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  next_token(parser)  # skip 'enum'
  let enum_name = current_token(parser).value
  next_token(parser)

  let node = make_node("enum", enum_name, "")

  if match(parser, ASSIGN) then
    while not check(parser, EOF_TOKEN) do
      let variant = current_token(parser).value
      next_token(parser)
      let variant_node = make_node("variant", variant, "")
      add_child(node, variant_node)

      if not match(parser, PIPE) then break
    end
  end

  node

# 프로그램 파싱
function parse_program(parser: Parser): ASTNode =
  let program = make_node("program", "", "")

  while not is_at_end(parser) do
    if check(parser, KEYWORD_FN) then
      let func = parse_function(parser)
      add_child(program, func)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_STRUCT) then
      let struct_ = parse_struct(parser)
      add_child(program, struct_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_RECORD) then
      let record = parse_record(parser)
      add_child(program, record)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_ENUM) then
      let enum_ = parse_enum(parser)
      add_child(program, enum_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_LET) then
      let let_ = parse_let(parser)
      add_child(program, let_)
    else if check(parser, KEYWORD_IF) then
      let if_ = parse_if(parser)
      add_child(program, if_)
    else
      next_token(parser)
    end
  end

  program

# ==========================================
# 메인 파싱 함수
# ==========================================

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): ASTNode =
  let parser = new_parser(tokens)
  parse_program(parser)

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.3: FreeJulia Type System Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia Type System을 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# Self-Hosting Type System 구현
#
# 기능:
# - 9개 기본 타입 (Int, Float, String, Bool, Char, Nil, Array, Function, Record)
# - 복합 타입 (Option[T], Result[T, E], Union)
# - 타입 검사 & 추론
# - 프로토콜 (Protocol)

# ==========================================
# 타입 정의
# ==========================================

record FVType =
  name: String           # "Int", "String", "Option[Int]" 등
  kind: String           # "primitive", "array", "function", "record", "option", "result"
  type_params: Array[FVType]  # 제네릭 파라미터
  is_mutable: Bool

# ==========================================
# 기본 타입 생성
# ==========================================

function type_int(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Int",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_float(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Float",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_string(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "String",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_bool(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Bool",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_char(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Char",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_nil(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Nil",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_any(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Any",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Array[T] 타입
function type_array(elem_type: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Array[" + elem_type.name + "]",
    kind: "array",
    type_params: [elem_type],
    is_mutable: true
  }

# Function 타입
function type_function(param_types: Array[FVType], return_type: FVType): FVType =
  let name = "("
  for i in 0:param_types.length() do
    if i > 0 then name = name + ", "
    name = name + param_types[i].name
  end
  name = name + ") -> " + return_type.name

  FVType {
    name: name,
    kind: "function",
    type_params: param_types + [return_type],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Option[T] 타입
function type_option(inner: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Option[" + inner.name + "]",
    kind: "option",
    type_params: [inner],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Result[T, E] 타입
function type_result(ok_type: FVType, err_type: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Result[" + ok_type.name + ", " + err_type.name + "]",
    kind: "result",
    type_params: [ok_type, err_type],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Union 타입
function type_union(types: Array[FVType]): FVType =
  let name = ""
  for i in 0:types.length() do
    if i > 0 then name = name + " | "
    name = name + types[i].name
  end

  FVType {
    name: name,
    kind: "union",
    type_params: types,
    is_mutable: false
  }

# ==========================================
# 타입 호환성 검사
# ==========================================

# 두 타입이 같은지 확인
function types_equal(t1: FVType, t2: FVType): Bool =
  t1.name == t2.name && t1.kind == t2.kind

# 타입 호환성 검사 (t1이 t2로 변환 가능한가?)
function is_assignable(from: FVType, to: FVType): Bool =
  # 같은 타입
  if types_equal(from, to) then return true

  # Nil은 모든 Option[T]에 할당 가능
  if types_equal(from, type_nil()) && to.kind == "option" then
    return true

  # Any 타입 (동적)
  if types_equal(to, type_any()) then return true
  if types_equal(from, type_any()) then return true

  # 숫자 타입 호환성 (Int -> Float)
  if types_equal(from, type_int()) && types_equal(to, type_float()) then
    return true

  false

# ==========================================
# 심볼 테이블
# ==========================================

record Symbol =
  name: String
  symbol_type: FVType
  is_mutable: Bool
  is_used: Bool

record Scope =
  symbols: Array[(String, Symbol)]
  parent: Option[Scope]

record TypeContext =
  scopes: Array[Scope]
  errors: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 타입 컨텍스트 관리
# ==========================================

function new_context(): TypeContext =
  TypeContext {
    scopes: [],
    errors: []
  }

# 스코프 추가
function push_scope(ctx: TypeContext): Void =
  let scope = Scope {
    symbols: [],
    parent: if ctx.scopes.length() > 0 then Some(ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]) else None
  }
  ctx.scopes.push(scope)

# 스코프 제거
function pop_scope(ctx: TypeContext): Void =
  if ctx.scopes.length() > 0 then
    ctx.scopes.pop()
  end

# 심볼 정의
function define_symbol(ctx: TypeContext, name: String, symbol_type: FVType, is_mutable: Bool): Void =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then return

  let scope = ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]
  let symbol = Symbol {
    name: name,
    symbol_type: symbol_type,
    is_mutable: is_mutable,
    is_used: false
  }
  scope.symbols.push((name, symbol))

# 심볼 조회
function lookup_symbol(ctx: TypeContext, name: String): Option[Symbol] =
  let i = ctx.scopes.length() - 1
  loop {
    if i < 0 then return None

    let scope = ctx.scopes[i]
    for (sym_name, symbol) in scope.symbols do
      if sym_name == name then return Some(symbol)
    end

    i = i - 1
  }

# ==========================================
# 타입 검사 엔진
# ==========================================

# 노드 타입 결정
function infer_type(node: ASTNode, ctx: TypeContext): FVType =
  match node.type {
    "literal" -> {
      match node.name {
        "int" -> type_int(),
        "float" -> type_float(),
        "string" -> type_string(),
        "char" -> type_char(),
        "bool" -> type_bool(),
        "nil" -> type_nil(),

# 기능:

# - 복합 타입 (Option[T], Result[T, E], Union)
# - 타입 검사 & 추론
# - 프로토콜 (Protocol)

# ==========================================
# 타입 정의
# ==========================================

record FVType =
  name: String           # "Int", "String", "Option[Int]" 등
  kind: String           # "primitive", "array", "function", "record", "option", "result"
  type_params: Array[FVType]  # 제네릭 파라미터
  is_mutable: Bool

# 기본 타입 생성
# ==========================================

function type_int(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Int",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_float(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Float",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_string(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "String",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_bool(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Bool",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_char(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Char",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_nil(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Nil",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

function type_any(): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Any",
    kind: "primitive",
    type_params: [],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Array[T] 타입
function type_array(elem_type: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Array[" + elem_type.name + "]",
    kind: "array",
    type_params: [elem_type],
    is_mutable: true
  }

# Function 타입
function type_function(param_types: Array[FVType], return_type: FVType): FVType =
  let name = "("
  for i in 0:param_types.length() do
    if i > 0 then name = name + ", "
    name = name + param_types[i].name
  end
  name = name + ") -> " + return_type.name

  FVType {
    name: name,
    kind: "function",
    type_params: param_types + [return_type],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Option[T] 타입
function type_option(inner: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Option[" + inner.name + "]",
    kind: "option",
    type_params: [inner],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Result[T, E] 타입
function type_result(ok_type: FVType, err_type: FVType): FVType =
  FVType {
    name: "Result[" + ok_type.name + ", " + err_type.name + "]",
    kind: "result",
    type_params: [ok_type, err_type],
    is_mutable: false
  }

# Union 타입
function type_union(types: Array[FVType]): FVType =
  let name = ""
  for i in 0:types.length() do
    if i > 0 then name = name + " | "
    name = name + types[i].name
  end

  FVType {
    name: name,
    kind: "union",
    type_params: types,
    is_mutable: false
  }

# ==========================================
# 타입 호환성 검사
# ==========================================

# 두 타입이 같은지 확인
function types_equal(t1: FVType, t2: FVType): Bool =
  t1.name == t2.name && t1.kind == t2.kind

# 타입 호환성 검사 (t1이 t2로 변환 가능한가?)
function is_assignable(from: FVType, to: FVType): Bool =
  # 같은 타입
  if types_equal(from, to) then return true

  # Nil은 모든 Option[T]에 할당 가능
  if types_equal(from, type_nil()) && to.kind == "option" then
    return true

  # Any 타입 (동적)
  if types_equal(to, type_any()) then return true
  if types_equal(from, type_any()) then return true

  # 숫자 타입 호환성 (Int -> Float)
  if types_equal(from, type_int()) && types_equal(to, type_float()) then
    return true

  false

  name: String
  symbol_type: FVType
  is_mutable: Bool
  is_used: Bool

  parent: Option[Scope]

  let scope = Scope {
    symbols: [],
    parent: if ctx.scopes.length() > 0 then Some(ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]) else None
  }
  ctx.scopes.push(scope)

function pop_scope(ctx: TypeContext): Void =

  end

function define_symbol(ctx: TypeContext, name: String, symbol_type: FVType, is_mutable: Bool): Void =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then return

  let scope = ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.4: Semantic Analyzer Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia Semantic Analyzer를 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# Self-Hosting Semantic Analysis
#
# 기능:
# - 심볼 테이블 관리
# - 스코프 분석
# - 사용되지 않은 변수 감지
# - 타입 일관성 검사

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 결과
# ==========================================

record SemanticInfo =
  is_valid: Bool
  symbol_table: Array[(String, FVType)]
  unused_symbols: Array[String]
  errors: Array[String]
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 변수 사용 추적
# ==========================================

record VariableInfo =
  name: String
  symbol_type: FVType
  is_mutable: Bool
  is_used: Bool
  declaration_line: Int

record VariableScope =
  variables: Array[VariableInfo]
  parent: Option[VariableScope]

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 컨텍스트
# ==========================================

record SemanticContext =
  scopes: Array[VariableScope]
  errors: Array[String]
  warnings: Array[String]
  current_function: String

# ==========================================
# 스코프 관리
# ==========================================

function new_semantic_context(): SemanticContext =
  SemanticContext {
    scopes: [],
    errors: [],
    warnings: [],
    current_function: ""
  }

# 스코프 시작
function enter_scope(ctx: SemanticContext): Void =
  let parent = if ctx.scopes.length() > 0 then
    Some(ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1])
  else
    None
  end

  let scope = VariableScope {
    variables: [],
    parent: parent
  }
  ctx.scopes.push(scope)

# 스코프 종료
function exit_scope(ctx: SemanticContext): Array[VariableInfo] =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then return []

  let scope = ctx.scopes.pop()
  # 사용되지 않은 변수 경고
  for var in scope.variables do
    if not var.is_used then
      ctx.warnings.push("Unused variable: " + var.name +
                        " at line " + var.declaration_line.to_string())
    end
  end

  scope.variables

# 변수 선언
function declare_variable(ctx: SemanticContext, name: String, symbol_type: FVType,
                          is_mutable: Bool, line: Int): Void =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then
    enter_scope(ctx)
  end

  let scope = ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]

  # 중복 선언 확인
  for var in scope.variables do
    if var.name == name then
      ctx.errors.push("Duplicate variable declaration: " + name + " at line " + line.to_string())
      return
    end
  end

  let var_info = VariableInfo {
    name: name,
    symbol_type: symbol_type,
    is_mutable: is_mutable,
    is_used: false,
    declaration_line: line
  }
  scope.variables.push(var_info)

# 변수 사용 표시
function use_variable(ctx: SemanticContext, name: String, line: Int): Option[FVType] =
  let i = ctx.scopes.length() - 1
  loop {
    if i < 0 then return None

    let scope = ctx.scopes[i]
    for var in scope.variables do
      if var.name == name then
        var.is_used = true
        return Some(var.symbol_type)
      end
    end

    i = i - 1
  }

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 함수
# ==========================================

# 노드 분석
function analyze_node(node: ASTNode, ctx: SemanticContext): Bool =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> {
      enter_scope(ctx)
      let success = true
      for child in node.children do
        if not analyze_node(child, ctx) then
          success = false
        end
      end
      exit_scope(ctx)
      success
    },
    "function" -> {
      let func_name = node.name
      let prev_func = ctx.current_function
      ctx.current_function = func_name

      enter_scope(ctx)

      # 파라미터 분석
      for param in node.children do
        if param.type == "parameter" then
          let param_type = type_any()
          for (key, value) in param.properties do
            if key == "type" then
              param_type = match value {
                "Int" -> type_int(),
                "Float" -> type_float(),
                "String" -> type_string(),
                "Bool" -> type_bool(),
                _ -> type_any()
              }
            end
          end
          declare_variable(ctx, param.name, param_type, false, 0)
        end
      end

      # 함수 본문 분석
      let success = true
      for stmt in node.children do
        if stmt.type != "parameter" then
          if not analyze_node(stmt, ctx) then
            success = false
          end
        end
      end

      exit_scope(ctx)
      ctx.current_function = prev_func
      success
    },
    "let" -> {
      let var_name = node.name
      let var_type = type_any()

      # 타입 annotation 파싱
      for (key, value) in node.properties do
        if key == "type" then
          var_type = match value {
            "Int" -> type_int(),
            "Float" -> type_float(),
            "String" -> type_string(),
            "Bool" -> type_bool(),
            "Char" -> type_char(),
            _ -> type_any()
          }
        end
      end

      # 초기값 분석
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end
      end

      declare_variable(ctx, var_name, var_type, true, node.line)
      true
    },
    "identifier" -> {
      let ident_name = node.name
      match use_variable(ctx, ident_name, node.line) {
        Some(_) -> true,
        None -> {
          ctx.errors.push("Undefined variable: " + ident_name + " at line " + node.line.to_string())
          false
        }
      }
    },
    "if" -> {
      if node.children.length() >= 1 then
        # 조건 분석
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.4: Semantic Analyzer Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia Semantic Analyzer를 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# Self-Hosting Semantic Analysis
#
# 기능:
# - 심볼 테이블 관리
# - 스코프 분석
# - 사용되지 않은 변수 감지
# - 타입 일관성 검사

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 결과
# ==========================================

record SemanticInfo =
  is_valid: Bool
  symbol_table: Array[(String, FVType)]
  unused_symbols: Array[String]
  errors: Array[String]
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 변수 사용 추적
# ==========================================

record VariableInfo =
  name: String
  symbol_type: FVType
  is_mutable: Bool
  is_used: Bool
  declaration_line: Int

record VariableScope =
  variables: Array[VariableInfo]
  parent: Option[VariableScope]

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 컨텍스트
# ==========================================

record SemanticContext =
  scopes: Array[VariableScope]
  errors: Array[String]
  warnings: Array[String]
  current_function: String

# ==========================================
# 스코프 관리
# ==========================================

function new_semantic_context(): SemanticContext =
  SemanticContext {
    scopes: [],
    errors: [],
    warnings: [],
    current_function: ""
  }

# 스코프 시작
function enter_scope(ctx: SemanticContext): Void =
  let parent = if ctx.scopes.length() > 0 then
    Some(ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1])
  else
    None
  end

  let scope = VariableScope {
    variables: [],
    parent: parent
  }
  ctx.scopes.push(scope)

# 스코프 종료
function exit_scope(ctx: SemanticContext): Array[VariableInfo] =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then return []

  let scope = ctx.scopes.pop()
  # 사용되지 않은 변수 경고
  for var in scope.variables do
    if not var.is_used then
      ctx.warnings.push("Unused variable: " + var.name +
                        " at line " + var.declaration_line.to_string())
    end
  end

  scope.variables

# 변수 선언
function declare_variable(ctx: SemanticContext, name: String, symbol_type: FVType,
                          is_mutable: Bool, line: Int): Void =
  if ctx.scopes.length() == 0 then
    enter_scope(ctx)
  end

  let scope = ctx.scopes[ctx.scopes.length() - 1]

  # 중복 선언 확인
  for var in scope.variables do
    if var.name == name then
      ctx.errors.push("Duplicate variable declaration: " + name + " at line " + line.to_string())
      return
    end
  end

  let var_info = VariableInfo {
    name: name,
    symbol_type: symbol_type,
    is_mutable: is_mutable,
    is_used: false,
    declaration_line: line
  }
  scope.variables.push(var_info)

# 변수 사용 표시
function use_variable(ctx: SemanticContext, name: String, line: Int): Option[FVType] =
  let i = ctx.scopes.length() - 1
  loop {
    if i < 0 then return None

    let scope = ctx.scopes[i]
    for var in scope.variables do
      if var.name == name then
        var.is_used = true
        return Some(var.symbol_type)
      end
    end

    i = i - 1
  }

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 함수
# ==========================================

# 노드 분석
function analyze_node(node: ASTNode, ctx: SemanticContext): Bool =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> {
      enter_scope(ctx)
      let success = true
      for child in node.children do
        if not analyze_node(child, ctx) then
          success = false
        end
      end
      exit_scope(ctx)
      success
    },
    "function" -> {
      let func_name = node.name
      let prev_func = ctx.current_function
      ctx.current_function = func_name

      enter_scope(ctx)

      # 파라미터 분석
      for param in node.children do
        if param.type == "parameter" then
          let param_type = type_any()
          for (key, value) in param.properties do
            if key == "type" then
              param_type = match value {
                "Int" -> type_int(),
                "Float" -> type_float(),
                "String" -> type_string(),
                "Bool" -> type_bool(),
                _ -> type_any()
              }
            end
          end
          declare_variable(ctx, param.name, param_type, false, 0)
        end
      end

      # 함수 본문 분석
      let success = true
      for stmt in node.children do
        if stmt.type != "parameter" then
          if not analyze_node(stmt, ctx) then
            success = false
          end
        end
      end

      exit_scope(ctx)
      ctx.current_function = prev_func
      success
    },
    "let" -> {
      let var_name = node.name
      let var_type = type_any()

      # 타입 annotation 파싱
      for (key, value) in node.properties do
        if key == "type" then
          var_type = match value {
            "Int" -> type_int(),
            "Float" -> type_float(),
            "String" -> type_string(),
            "Bool" -> type_bool(),
            "Char" -> type_char(),
            _ -> type_any()
          }
        end
      end

      # 초기값 분석
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end
      end

      declare_variable(ctx, var_name, var_type, true, node.line)
      true
    },
    "identifier" -> {
      let ident_name = node.name
      match use_variable(ctx, ident_name, node.line) {
        Some(_) -> true,
        None -> {
          ctx.errors.push("Undefined variable: " + ident_name + " at line " + node.line.to_string())
          false
        }
      }
    },
    "if" -> {
      if node.children.length() >= 1 then
        # 조건 분석
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end

        # 브랜치 분석
        for i in 1:node.children.length() do
          enter_scope(ctx)
          if not analyze_node(node.children[i], ctx) then
            exit_scope(ctx)
            return false
          end
          exit_scope(ctx)
        end
      end
      true
    },
    "for" -> {
      enter_scope(ctx)
      let var_name = node.name

      # 루프 변수 선언
      declare_variable(ctx, var_name, type_any(), true, node.line)

      # 루프 본문 분석
      let success = true
      for stmt in node.children do
        if not analyze_node(stmt, ctx) then
          success = false
        end
      end

      exit_scope(ctx)
      success
    },
    "binary" -> {
      if node.children.length() >= 2 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end
        if not analyze_node(node.children[1], ctx) then
          return false
        end
      end
      true
    },
    "call" -> {
      # 함수 호출 분석
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end

        # 인자 분석
        for i in 1:node.children.length() do
          if not analyze_node(node.children[i], ctx) then
            return false
          end
        end
      end
      true
    },
    "return" -> {
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end
      end
      true
    },
    "block" -> {
      enter_scope(ctx)
      let success = true
      for stmt in node.children do
        if not analyze_node(stmt, ctx) then
          success = false
        end
      end
      exit_scope(ctx)
      success
    },
    "struct" -> {
      # 구조체 필드 분석
      for field in node.children do
        if field.type == "field" then
          # 필드 타입 확인
          for (key, value) in field.properties do
            if key == "type" then

            end
          end

      true

    "record" -> {
      # record 필드 분석 (struct와 유사)

        if field.type == "field" then
          for (key, value) in field.properties do
            if key == "type" then
              # 타입 검증 (생략)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      true
    },
    "match" -> {
      # match 표현식 분석
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        if not analyze_node(node.children[0], ctx) then
          return false
        end

        # 패턴 분석
        for case in node.children do
          if case.type == "case" then
            enter_scope(ctx)

              exit_scope(ctx)

            exit_scope(ctx)
          end

      true

    _ -> true

# ==========================================
# 의미 분석 공개 API

function analyze_semantic(program: ASTNode): SemanticInfo =

# ==========================================
# Phase D Task D.5: IR Builder Bootstrap
# (FreeJulia IR Builder를 FreeJulia로 재작성)
# ==========================================
# Self-Hosting IR (Intermediate Representation) Builder
#
# 기능:
# - AST → IR 변환
# - BasicBlock 생성
# - 명령어 생성 & 최적화 기본

# ==========================================
# 명령어 타입
# ==========================================

record OpCode =
  | OpLoadInt
  | OpLoadFloat
  | OpLoadString
  | OpLoadBool
  | OpLoadNil
  | OpAdd
  | OpSub
  | OpMul
  | OpDiv
  | OpMod
  | OpAnd
  | OpOr
  | OpNot
  | OpEq
  | OpNeq
  | OpLt
  | OpLe
  | OpGt
  | OpGe
  | OpCall
  | OpReturn
  | OpJmp
  | OpCondJmp
  | OpLoadVar
  | OpStoreVar
  | OpLoadArray
  | OpStoreArray
  | OpArrayNew
  | OpArrayLen
  | OpFieldGet
  | OpFieldSet
  | OpMatch
  | OpLabel

# ==========================================
# IR 명령어
# ==========================================

record Instruction =
  opcode: OpCode
  operands: Array[String]
  result: Option[String]

# ==========================================
# BasicBlock
# ==========================================

record BasicBlock =
  label: String
  instructions: Array[Instruction]
  successors: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# IR Function
# ==========================================

record IRFunction =
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  return_type: String
  blocks: Array[BasicBlock]
  entry_block: String

# ==========================================
# IR Module
# ==========================================

record IRModule =
  functions: Array[IRFunction]
  globals: Array[(String, String)]

# ==========================================
# IR Builder 상태
# ==========================================

record IRBuilder =
  current_block: BasicBlock
  blocks: Array[BasicBlock]
  label_counter: Int
  var_counter: Int
  current_function: String

# ==========================================
# 헬퍼 함수
# ==========================================

# 새로운 라벨 생성
function new_label(builder: IRBuilder): String =
  builder.label_counter = builder.label_counter + 1
  "L" + builder.label_counter.to_string()

# 새로운 임시 변수 생성
function new_var(builder: IRBuilder): String =
  builder.var_counter = builder.var_counter + 1
  "t" + builder.var_counter.to_string()

# 명령어 추가
function emit(builder: IRBuilder, instr: Instruction): Void =
  builder.current_block.instructions.push(instr)

# BasicBlock 시작
function begin_block(builder: IRBuilder, label: String): Void =
  let block = BasicBlock {
    label: label,
    instructions: [],
    successors: []
  }
  builder.blocks.push(block)
  builder.current_block = block

# ==========================================
# 명령어 생성 헬퍼
# ==========================================

# 상수 로드
function emit_load_int(builder: IRBuilder, value: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpLoadInt,
    operands: [value],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

function emit_load_float(builder: IRBuilder, value: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpLoadFloat,
    operands: [value],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

function emit_load_string(builder: IRBuilder, value: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpLoadString,
    operands: [value],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

function emit_load_bool(builder: IRBuilder, value: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpLoadBool,
    operands: [value],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

# 이항 연산
function emit_binary_op(builder: IRBuilder, opcode: OpCode, left: String, right: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: opcode,
    operands: [left, right],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

# 변수 로드
function emit_load_var(builder: IRBuilder, name: String): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpLoadVar,
    operands: [name],
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

# 변수 저장
function emit_store_var(builder: IRBuilder, name: String, value: String): Void =
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpStoreVar,
    operands: [name, value],
    result: None
  }
  emit(builder, instr)

# 함수 호출
function emit_call(builder: IRBuilder, func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
  let result = new_var(builder)
  let operands = [func_name] + args
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpCall,
    operands: operands,
    result: Some(result)
  }
  emit(builder, instr)
  result

# 반환
function emit_return(builder: IRBuilder, value: Option[String]): Void =
  let operands = match value {
    Some(v) -> [v],
    None -> []
  }
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpReturn,
    operands: operands,
    result: None
  }
  emit(builder, instr)

# 점프
function emit_jmp(builder: IRBuilder, target: String): Void =
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpJmp,
    operands: [target],
    result: None
  }
  emit(builder, instr)

# 조건부 점프
function emit_cond_jmp(builder: IRBuilder, cond: String, true_target: String, false_target: String): Void =
  let instr = Instruction {
    opcode: OpCondJmp,
    operands: [cond, true_target, false_target],
    result: None
  }
  emit(builder, instr)

# ==========================================
# AST → IR 변환
# ==========================================

function build_ir_from_node(node: ASTNode, builder: IRBuilder): Option[String] =
  match node.type {
    "literal" -> {
      match node.name {
        "int" -> Some(emit_load_int(builder, node.value)),
        "float" -> Some(emit_load_float(builder, node.value)),
        "string" -> Some(emit_load_string(builder, node.value)),
        "bool" -> Some(emit_load_bool(builder, node.value)),
        "nil" -> Some(emit_load_bool(builder, "nil")),
        _ -> None
      }
    },
    "identifier" -> {
      Some(emit_load_var(builder, node.name))
    },
    "binary" -> {
      if node.children.length() >= 2 then
        let left = build_ir_from_node(node.children[0], builder)
        let right = build_ir_from_node(node.children[1], builder)

        match (left, right) {
          (Some(l), Some(r)) -> {
            let op = match node.properties[0].1 {
              "+" -> OpAdd,
              "-" -> OpSub,
              "*" -> OpMul,
              "/" -> OpDiv,
              "%" -> OpMod,
              "&&" -> OpAnd,
              "||" -> OpOr,
              "==" -> OpEq,
              "!=" -> OpNeq,
              "<" -> OpLt,
              "<=" -> OpLe,
              ">" -> OpGt,
              ">=" -> OpGe,
              _ -> OpAdd
            }
            Some(emit_binary_op(builder, op, l, r))
          },
          _ -> None
        }
      else
        None
      end
    },
    "call" -> {
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        let func_node = node.children[0]
        let func_name = func_node.name

        let args = Array[String]()
        for i in 1:node.children.length() do
          match build_ir_from_node(node.children[i], builder) {
            Some(arg) -> args.push(arg),
            None -> {}
          }
        end

        Some(emit_call(builder, func_name, args))
      else
        None
      end
    },
    "let" -> {
      let var_name = node.name
      if node.children.length() > 0 then
        match build_ir_from_node(node.children[0], builder) {
          Some(value) -> {
            emit_store_var(builder, var_name, value)
            Some(value)
          },
          None -> None
        }
      else
        None
      end
    },
    "if" -> {
      if node.children.length() >= 1 then
        match build_ir_from_node(node.children[0], builder) {
          Some(cond) -> {
            let true_label = new_label(builder)
            let false_label = new_label(builder)
            let end_label = new_label(builder)

            emit_cond_jmp(builder, cond, true_label, false_label)

            # true 브랜치
            begin_block(builder, true_label)
            if node.children.length() > 1 then
              build_ir_from_node(node.children[1], builder)
            end
            emit_jmp(builder, end_label)

            # false 브랜치
            begin_block(builder, false_label)
            if node.children.length() > 2 then
              build_ir_from_node(node.children[2], builder)
            end
            emit_jmp(builder, end_label)

            # end 블록
            begin_block(builder, end_label)
            Some("")
          },
          None -> None
        }
      else
        None
      end
    },
    "return" -> {
      let value = if node.children.length() > 0 then
        build_ir_from_node(node.children[0], builder)
      else
        None
      end
      emit_return(builder, value)
      value
    },
    _ -> None
  }

# ==========================================
# IR 빌더 초기화
# ==========================================

function new_ir_builder(): IRBuilder =
  let entry_block = BasicBlock {
    label: "entry",
    instructions: [],
    successors: []
  }

  IRBuilder {

    blocks: [entry_block],
    label_counter: 0,
    var_counter: 0,
    current_function: ""
  }

# ==========================================
# IR 빌더 공개 API
# ==========================================

function build_ir(program: ASTNode): IRModule =
  let builder = new_ir_builder()
  let functions = Array[IRFunction]()

  for node in program.children do
    if node.type == "function" then
      let func_name = node.name
      builder.current_function = func_name

      let entry = BasicBlock {
        label: "entry",
        instructions: [],
        successors: []
      }
      builder.current_block = entry
      builder.blocks = [entry]

      # 함수 본문 빌드
      for child in node.children do
        build_ir_from_node(child, builder)
      end

      let ir_func = IRFunction {
        name: func_name,
        params: [],
        return_type: "Any",
        blocks: builder.blocks,
        entry_block: "entry"
      }
      functions.push(ir_func)
    end
  end

    functions: functions,
