# ==========================================
# FV-Julia Code Generator 통합 테스트
# src/codegen_fv2.fl + tests/codegen_fv2_test.fl 통합
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# A. Type Mapping (기본)
# ==========================================
record TypeMapping =
  fj_type: String
  fv_type: String
  needs_import: Bool
  conversion_func: String

function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "String",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
        "Map(String, String)"
      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
        "fn(String) String"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    let start = 6
    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    array_type.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# B. 함수 정의 변환
# ==========================================
record FunctionDef =
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  return_type: String
  body: String

function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("

  let param_parts = Array[String]()
  let i = 0
  while i < fj_func.params.length() do
    let param = fj_func.params[i]
    let parts = param.split(":")
    if parts.length() == 2 then
      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "

  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"

  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
  let result = ""
  let i = 0
  while i < arr.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + separator
    end
    result = result + arr[i]
    i = i + 1
  end
  result

# ==========================================
# C. 제어 흐름
# ==========================================
function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"

  if else_body.length() > 0 then
    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

function convert_while_loop(condition: String, body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "for " + condition + " {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

# ==========================================
# D. 표현식
# ==========================================
function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"

function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"

function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
  array_name + "[" + index + "]"

# ==========================================
# E. Record → Struct
# ==========================================
record RecordField =
  name: String
  field_type: String

function convert_record_def(record_name: String, fields: Array[RecordField]): String =
  let fv_code = "struct " + record_name + " {\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < fields.length() do
    let field = fields[i]
    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(field.field_type)
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + field.name + ": " + mapped_type + "\n"
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# F. Match 표현식
# ==========================================
record MatchArm =
  pattern: String
  body: String

function convert_match_arm(arm: MatchArm): String =
  arm.pattern + " => " + arm.body

function convert_match_expr(subject: String, arms: Array[MatchArm]): String =
  let fv_code = "match " + subject + " {\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < arms.length() do
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + convert_match_arm(arms[i])
    if i < arms.length() - 1 then
      fv_code = fv_code + ",\n"
    else
      fv_code = fv_code + "\n"
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# G. Let/Const
# ==========================================
function convert_let_stmt(var_name: String, var_type_opt: String, value: String): String =
  let fv_code = "let " + var_name

  if var_type_opt.length() > 0 then
    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(var_type_opt)
    fv_code = fv_code + ": " + mapped_type
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + " := " + value
  fv_code

function convert_const_stmt(const_name: String, const_type: String, value: String): String =
  let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(const_type)
  "const " + const_name + ": " + mapped_type + " = " + value

# ==========================================
# H. Result/Option 확장 타입 매핑
# ==========================================
function get_type_mapping_extended(fj_type: String): String =
  if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
    let start = 7
    let end = fj_type.length() - 1
    let types_str = fj_type.substring(start, end)
    let parts = types_str.split(",")

    if parts.length() == 2 then
      let ok_type = get_type_mapping(parts[0].trim())
      let err_type = get_type_mapping(parts[1].trim())
      "Result(" + ok_type + ", " + err_type + ")"
    else
      "Result(unknown, unknown)"
    end
  else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type.replace("Option", "Array"))
    let mapped = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    "?" + mapped
  else if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    "[]" + mapped_elem
  else
    get_type_mapping(fj_type)
  end

# ==========================================
# I. 전체 프로그램 생성
# ==========================================
record Program =
  imports: Array[String]
  structs: Array[String]
  functions: Array[String]
  main_body: String

function convert_program(prog: Program): String =
  let output = ""

  output = output + "// FV-Julia Generated Code\n"
  output = output + "// Converted from FreeJulia\n\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < prog.imports.length() do
    output = output + "import " + prog.imports[i] + "\n"
    i = i + 1
  end

  if prog.imports.length() > 0 then
    output = output + "\n"
  end

  let j = 0
  while j < prog.structs.length() do
    output = output + prog.structs[j] + "\n\n"
    j = j + 1
  end

  let k = 0
  while k < prog.functions.length() do
    output = output + prog.functions[k] + "\n\n"
    k = k + 1
  end

  output = output + "fn main() void {\n"
  output = output + "  " + prog.main_body + "\n"
  output = output + "}\n"

  output

# ==========================================
# 테스트 헬퍼
# ==========================================
function assert_equal(actual: String, expected: String, test_name: String): Bool =
  let result = actual == expected
  if not result then
    println("[FAIL] " + test_name)
    println("  Expected: " + expected)
    println("  Actual:   " + actual)
  end
  result

function assert_contains(actual: String, substring: String, test_name: String): Bool =
  let result = actual.contains(substring)
  if not result then
    println("[FAIL] " + test_name)
    println("  Expected to contain: " + substring)
    println("  Actual: " + actual)
  end
  result

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia Code Generator 통합 테스트
# src/codegen_fv2.fl + tests/codegen_fv2_test.fl 통합
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# A. Type Mapping (기본)
# ==========================================
record TypeMapping =
  fj_type: String
  fv_type: String
  needs_import: Bool
  conversion_func: String

function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "String",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
        "Map(String, String)"
      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
        "fn(String) String"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    let start = 6
    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    array_type.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# B. 함수 정의 변환
# ==========================================
record FunctionDef =
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  return_type: String
  body: String

function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("

  let param_parts = Array[String]()
  let i = 0
  while i < fj_func.params.length() do
    let param = fj_func.params[i]
    let parts = param.split(":")
    if parts.length() == 2 then
      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "

  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"

  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
  let result = ""
  let i = 0
  while i < arr.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + separator
    end
    result = result + arr[i]
    i = i + 1
  end
  result

# ==========================================
# C. 제어 흐름
# ==========================================
function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"

  if else_body.length() > 0 then
    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

function convert_while_loop(condition: String, body: String): String =
  let fv_code = "for " + condition + " {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"

  fv_code

# ==========================================
# D. 표현식
# ==========================================
function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"

function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"

function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
  array_name + "[" + index + "]"

# ==========================================
# E. Record → Struct
# ==========================================
record RecordField =
  name: String
  field_type: String

function convert_record_def(record_name: String, fields: Array[RecordField]): String =
  let fv_code = "struct " + record_name + " {\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < fields.length() do
    let field = fields[i]
    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(field.field_type)
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + field.name + ": " + mapped_type + "\n"
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# F. Match 표현식
# ==========================================
record MatchArm =
  pattern: String
  body: String

function convert_match_arm(arm: MatchArm): String =
  arm.pattern + " => " + arm.body

function convert_match_expr(subject: String, arms: Array[MatchArm]): String =
  let fv_code = "match " + subject + " {\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < arms.length() do
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + convert_match_arm(arms[i])
    if i < arms.length() - 1 then
      fv_code = fv_code + ",\n"
    else
      fv_code = fv_code + "\n"
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# G. Let/Const
# ==========================================
function convert_let_stmt(var_name: String, var_type_opt: String, value: String): String =
  let fv_code = "let " + var_name

  if var_type_opt.length() > 0 then
    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(var_type_opt)
    fv_code = fv_code + ": " + mapped_type
  end

  fv_code = fv_code + " := " + value
  fv_code

function convert_const_stmt(const_name: String, const_type: String, value: String): String =
  let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(const_type)
  "const " + const_name + ": " + mapped_type + " = " + value

# ==========================================
# H. Result/Option 확장 타입 매핑
# ==========================================
function get_type_mapping_extended(fj_type: String): String =
  if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
    let start = 7
    let end = fj_type.length() - 1
    let types_str = fj_type.substring(start, end)
    let parts = types_str.split(",")

    if parts.length() == 2 then
      let ok_type = get_type_mapping(parts[0].trim())
      let err_type = get_type_mapping(parts[1].trim())
      "Result(" + ok_type + ", " + err_type + ")"
    else
      "Result(unknown, unknown)"
    end
  else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type.replace("Option", "Array"))
    let mapped = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    "?" + mapped
  else if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    "[]" + mapped_elem
  else
    get_type_mapping(fj_type)
  end

# ==========================================
# I. 전체 프로그램 생성
# ==========================================
record Program =
  imports: Array[String]
  structs: Array[String]
  functions: Array[String]
  main_body: String

function convert_program(prog: Program): String =
  let output = ""

  output = output + "// FV-Julia Generated Code\n"
  output = output + "// Converted from FreeJulia\n\n"

  let i = 0
  while i < prog.imports.length() do
    output = output + "import " + prog.imports[i] + "\n"
    i = i + 1
  end

  if prog.imports.length() > 0 then
    output = output + "\n"
  end

  let j = 0
  while j < prog.structs.length() do
    output = output + prog.structs[j] + "\n\n"
    j = j + 1
  end

  let k = 0
  while k < prog.functions.length() do
    output = output + prog.functions[k] + "\n\n"
    k = k + 1
  end

  output = output + "fn main() void {\n"
  output = output + "  " + prog.main_body + "\n"
  output = output + "}\n"

  output

# ==========================================
# 테스트 헬퍼
# ==========================================
function assert_equal(actual: String, expected: String, test_name: String): Bool =
  let result = actual == expected
  if not result then
    println("[FAIL] " + test_name)
    println("  Expected: " + expected)
    println("  Actual:   " + actual)
  end
  result

function assert_contains(actual: String, substring: String, test_name: String): Bool =
  let result = actual.contains(substring)
  if not result then
    println("[FAIL] " + test_name)
    println("  Expected to contain: " + substring)
    println("  Actual: " + actual)
  end
  result

# FV-Julia 언어 명세

**Version**: 0.2.0
**상태**: Phase 2 Language Specification
**최종 업데이트**: 2026-03-20

---

## 목차

1. [개요](#개요)
2. [타입 시스템](#타입-시스템)
3. [문법 (BNF)](#문법-bnf)
4. [기본 타입](#기본-타입)

6. [함수 정의](#함수-정의)

11. [예제 프로그램](#예제-프로그램)

---

## 개요

FV-Julia는 FreeJulia의 우아한 문법과 FV 2.0의 고성능을 통합한 언어입니다.

### 핵심 특징
- **강타입 시스템**: 모든 변수는 타입 명시 또는 타입 추론
- **함수 오버로딩**: 같은 이름의 함수를 타입별로 다중 정의
- **패턴 매칭**: match 표현식으로 강력한 제어
- **자동 타입 변환**: FV 2.0으로 자동 컴파일 (50-200배 빠름)

### 설계 철학
```
읽기 쉬운 코드 (FreeJulia) → 빠른 실행 (FV 2.0 C 컴파일)
```

---

## 타입 시스템

### 타입 계층

```
Type
├── BasicType
│   ├── Int (i32)
│   ├── Float (f64)
│   ├── String
│   ├── Bool
│   └── Void (return type only)
├── ContainerType
│   ├── Array[T]
│   ├── Dictionary[K, V]
│   └── Set[T]
├── SpecialType
│   ├── Result[T, E]
│   ├── Option[T]
│   └── Tuple[T1, T2, ...]
└── UserType
    ├── Record
    └── Enum (future)
```

### 타입 호환성

| 타입 | 호환 | 설명 |
|------|------|------|
| Int | i32 | 32비트 정수 |
| Float | f64 | 64비트 부동소수점 |
| String | string | UTF-8 문자열 |
| Bool | bool | true/false |
| Array[T] | []T | 동적 배열 |
| Result[T,E] | Result(T,E) | 에러 처리 |
| Option[T] | ?T | nullable 타입 |

---

## 문법 (BNF)

### 프로그램 구조

```bnf
<program> ::= <import>* <definition>* <expression>*

<import> ::= "import" <identifier>

<definition> ::= <function_def>
              | <record_def>
              | <const_def>

<function_def> ::= "function" <identifier> "(" <params>? ")" ":" <type> "=" <expression>

<record_def> ::= "record" <identifier> "=" <field>*

<const_def> ::= "const" <identifier> ":" <type> "=" <literal>
```

### 타입 표현식

```bnf
<type> ::= <basic_type>
         | <array_type>
         | <dict_type>
         | <function_type>
         | <union_type>

<basic_type> ::= "Int" | "Float" | "String" | "Bool" | "Void"

<array_type> ::= "Array" "[" <type> "]"

<dict_type> ::= "Dictionary" "[" <type> "," <type> "]"

<function_type> ::= "(" <type>* ")" "=>" <type>

<union_type> ::= <type> "|" <type>
```

### 표현식

```bnf
<expression> ::= <literal>
              | <identifier>
              | <binary_op>
              | <unary_op>
              | <function_call>
              | <array_literal>
              | <record_literal>
              | <if_expr>
              | <match_expr>
              | <for_expr>
              | <while_expr>
              | <let_expr>
```

---

## 기본 타입

### Int (정수)

```freejulia
let x: Int = 42
let y: Int = -10
let z: Int = 0

# 연산
let sum = x + y      # 더하기
let diff = x - y     # 빼기
let prod = x * y     # 곱하기
let quot = x / y     # 나누기
let rem = x % y      # 나머지

# 비교
x > y
x >= y
x < y
x <= y
x == y
x != y
```

### Float (실수)

```freejulia
let pi: Float = 3.14
let e: Float = 2.71
let neg: Float = -1.5

# 연산
let sum = pi + e
let prod = pi * e
let sqrt_val = 4.0 |> math.sqrt()

# 비교 (정수와 동일)
pi > e
```

### String (문자열)

```freejulia
let hello: String = "Hello"
let world: String = "World"

# 연결
let greeting = hello + " " + world    # "Hello World"

# 길이
let len = greeting.length()           # 11

# 포함
if greeting.contains("Hello") then
  println("Found!")
end

# 부분 추출
let first = greeting.substring(0, 5)  # "Hello"

# 메서드
let upper = greeting.uppercase()
let lower = greeting.lowercase()
let trimmed = "  text  ".trim()
```

### Bool (논리값)

```freejulia
let is_valid: Bool = true
let is_empty: Bool = false

# 연산
let a = true && false      # AND
let b = true || false      # OR
let c = not true           # NOT
```

### Void (반환값 없음)

```freejulia
function print_msg(msg: String): Void =
  println(msg)

function main(): Void =
  print_msg("Hello")
```

---

## 복합 타입

### Array (배열)

```freejulia
let numbers: Array[Int] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
let strings: Array[String] = ["a", "b", "c"]

# 길이
let len = numbers.length()            # 5

# 접근
let first = numbers[0]                # 1
let last = numbers[len - 1]           # 5

# 추가
numbers.push(6)

# 제거
let popped = numbers.pop()            # 6

# 반복
for i in 0:numbers.length() do
  println(numbers[i])
end

# 고차 함수
let doubled = numbers.map(fun x -> x * 2)
let evens = numbers.filter(fun x -> x % 2 == 0)
let sum = numbers.fold(0, fun acc x -> acc + x)
```

### Dictionary (해시맵)

```freejulia
let person: Dictionary[String, String] = {
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": "30",
  "city": "Seoul"
}

# 접근
let name = person["name"]            # "Alice"

# 설정
person["country"] = "Korea"

# 확인
if person.contains_key("age") then
  println(person["age"])
end

# 반복
for key in person.keys() do
  println(key + ": " + person[key])
end
```

### Set (집합)

```freejulia
let unique: Set[Int] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}

# 포함 확인
if unique.contains(3) then
  println("Found")
end

# 추가/제거
unique.add(6)
unique.remove(1)

# 크기
let size = unique.size()
```

### Tuple (튜플)

```freejulia
let pair: (Int, String) = (42, "answer")

# 접근
let num = pair.0
let str = pair.1

# 패턴 매칭
match pair {
  (42, answer) -> println("Found: " + answer),
  _ -> println("Not found")
}
```

### Result (에러 처리)

```freejulia
function divide(a: Int, b: Int): Result[Int, String] =
  if b == 0 then
    Err("Division by zero")
  else
    Ok(a / b)
  end

# 사용
match divide(10, 2) {
  Ok(result) -> println("Result: " + result.to_string()),
  Err(error) -> println("Error: " + error)
}
```

### Option (nullable)

```freejulia
function find_item(items: Array[Int], value: Int): Option[Int] =
  for i in 0:items.length() do
    if items[i] == value then
      return Some(i)
    end
  end

  match op {
    "+" -> Ok(a + b),
    "-" -> Ok(a - b),
    "*" -> Ok(a * b),
    "/" -> (
      if b == 0 then
        Err("Division by zero")
      else
        Ok(a / b)
      end
    ),
    _ -> Err("Unknown operator")
  }

function main(): Void =
  match calculate("+", 10, 5) {
    Ok(result) -> println("Result: " + result.to_string()),
    Err(msg) -> println("Error: " + msg)
  }

### 예제 2: 정렬

```freejulia
function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
  let n = arr.length()
  for i in 0:n do
    for j in 0:(n - i - 1) do
      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
        let temp = arr[j]
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
        arr[j + 1] = temp
      end
    end
  end
  arr

function main(): Void =
  let numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
  let sorted = bubble_sort(numbers)
  println("Sorted: " + sorted.to_string())
```

### 예제 3: 자료구조 (Stack)

```freejulia
record Stack =
  items: Array[Int]

function stack_new(): Stack =
  Stack { items: [] }

function push(s: Stack, val: Int): Stack =
  s.items.push(val)
  s

function pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
  if s.items.length() == 0 then
    None
  else
    let val = s.items[s.items.length() - 1]
    let n = s.items.length()
    s.items = s.items.substring(0, n - 1)
    Some(val)
  end

function main(): Void =
  let s = stack_new()
  push(s, 10)
  push(s, 20)
  push(s, 30)

  match pop(s) {
    Some(val) -> println("Popped: " + val.to_string()),
    None -> println("Stack empty")
  }
```

## 개요

FV-Julia는 FreeJulia의 우아한 문법과 FV 2.0의 고성능을 통합한 언어입니다.

              | <record_def>
              | <const_def>

<function_def> ::= "function" <identifier> "(" <params>? ")" ":" <type> "=" <expression>

## 예제 프로그램

### 예제 1: 계산기

```freejulia
function calculate(op: String, a: Int, b: Int): Result[Int, String] =
  match op {
    "+" -> Ok(a + b),
    "-" -> Ok(a - b),
    "*" -> Ok(a * b),
    "/" -> (
      if b == 0 then
        Err("Division by zero")
      else
        Ok(a / b)
      end
    ),
    _ -> Err("Unknown operator")
  }

function main(): Void =
  match calculate("+", 10, 5) {
    Ok(result) -> println("Result: " + result.to_string()),
    Err(msg) -> println("Error: " + msg)
  }
```

### 예제 2: 정렬

```freejulia
function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
  let n = arr.length()
  for i in 0:n do
    for j in 0:(n - i - 1) do
      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
        let temp = arr[j]
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
        arr[j + 1] = temp
      end
    end
  end
  arr

function main(): Void =
  let numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
  let sorted = bubble_sort(numbers)
  println("Sorted: " + sorted.to_string())
```

### 예제 3: 자료구조 (Stack)

```freejulia
record Stack =
  items: Array[Int]

function stack_new(): Stack =
  Stack { items: [] }

function push(s: Stack, val: Int): Stack =
  s.items.push(val)
  s

function pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
  if s.items.length() == 0 then
    None
  else
    let val = s.items[s.items.length() - 1]
    let n = s.items.length()
    s.items = s.items.substring(0, n - 1)
    Some(val)
  end

function main(): Void =
  let s = stack_new()
  push(s, 10)
  push(s, 20)
  push(s, 30)

  match pop(s) {
    Some(val) -> println("Popped: " + val.to_string()),
    None -> println("Stack empty")
  }
```

| FreeJulia | FV 2.0 | 설명 |
|-----------|--------|------|
| `Int` | `i32` | 32비트 정수 |
| `Float` | `f64` | 64비트 실수 |
| `String` | `string` | 문자열 |
| `Bool` | `bool` | 논리값 |
| `Void` | `void` | 반환값 없음 |
| `Array[T]` | `[]T` | 배열 |
| `Dictionary[K,V]` | `Map(K,V)` | 맵 |
| `Result[T,E]` | `Result(T,E)` | 에러 처리 |
| `Option[T]` | `?T` | nullable |
| `(T1,T2)` | `(T1, T2)` | 튜플 |

- ❌ 비동기/await (async/await) - Future 사용

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 예제 2: 정렬 알고리즘
# ==========================================
# 기능:
# - 배열 생성 및 초기화
# - Bubble Sort (O(n²))
# - Quick Sort (O(n log n))
# - 성능 비교
# ==========================================

# Bubble Sort: O(n²), 안정 정렬
function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
  let n = arr.length()
  let i = 0

  while i < n do
    let j = 0
    while j < n - i - 1 do
      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
        let temp = arr[j]
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
        arr[j + 1] = temp
      end
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  arr

# Quick Sort Helper: Partition
function partition(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Int =
  let pivot = arr[high]
  let i = low - 1
  let j = low

  while j < high do
    if arr[j] < pivot then
      i = i + 1
      let temp = arr[i]
      arr[i] = arr[j]
      arr[j] = temp
    end
    j = j + 1
  end

  let temp = arr[i + 1]
  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]
  arr[high] = temp

  i + 1

# Quick Sort: O(n log n) 평균
function quicksort_helper(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Array[Int] =
  if low < high then
    let pi = partition(arr, low, high)
    quicksort_helper(arr, low, pi - 1)
    quicksort_helper(arr, pi + 1, high)
  end

  arr

function quicksort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
  if arr.length() <= 1 then
    arr
  else
    quicksort_helper(arr, 0, arr.length() - 1)
  end

# 배열 출력
function print_array(arr: Array[Int], name: String): Unit =
  print(name + ": [")
  let i = 0
  while i < arr.length() do
    print(arr[i].to_string())
    if i < arr.length() - 1 then
      print(", ")
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  println("]")

# Bubble Sort: O(n²), 안정 정렬
function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
  let n = arr.length()
  let i = 0

  while i < n do
    let j = 0
    while j < n - i - 1 do
      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
        let temp = arr[j]
        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
        arr[j + 1] = temp
      end
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  arr

# Quick Sort Helper: Partition
function partition(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Int =
  let pivot = arr[high]
  let i = low - 1
  let j = low

  while j < high do
    if arr[j] < pivot then
      i = i + 1
      let temp = arr[i]
      arr[i] = arr[j]
      arr[j] = temp
    end
    j = j + 1
  end

  let temp = arr[i + 1]
  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]
  arr[high] = temp

  i + 1

# Quick Sort: O(n log n) 평균
function quicksort_helper(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Array[Int] =
  if low < high then
    let pi = partition(arr, low, high)
    quicksort_helper(arr, low, pi - 1)
    quicksort_helper(arr, pi + 1, high)
  end

  arr

function quicksort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 예제 3: 자료구조 (Stack & Queue)
# ==========================================
# 기능:
# - Stack (후입선출)
# - Queue (선입선출)
# - Record 기반 구현
# - Result/Option 에러 처리
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# Stack 구현
# ==========================================
record Stack =
  items: Array[Int]

function stack_new(): Stack =
  Stack { items: [] }

function stack_push(s: Stack, val: Int): Unit =
  s.items.push(val)

function stack_pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
  let len = s.items.length()
  if len == 0 then
    None
  else
    let val = s.items[len - 1]
    s.items = s.items.substring(0, len - 1)
    Some(val)
  end

function stack_peek(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
  let len = s.items.length()
  if len == 0 then
    None
  else
    Some(s.items[len - 1])
  end

function stack_size(s: Stack): Int =
  s.items.length()

function stack_is_empty(s: Stack): Bool =
  s.items.length() == 0

# ==========================================
# Queue 구현
# ==========================================
record Queue =
  items: Array[Int]

function queue_new(): Queue =
  Queue { items: [] }

function queue_enqueue(q: Queue, val: Int): Unit =
  q.items.push(val)

function queue_dequeue(q: Queue): Option[Int] =
  if q.items.length() == 0 then
    None
  else
    let val = q.items[0]
    q.items = q.items.substring(1, q.items.length())
    Some(val)
  end

function queue_front(q: Queue): Option[Int] =
  if q.items.length() == 0 then
    None
  else
    Some(q.items[0])
  end

function queue_size(q: Queue): Int =
  q.items.length()

function queue_is_empty(q: Queue): Bool =
  q.items.length() == 0

# 테스트
# ==========================================

  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Data Structure Examples")
  println("========================================\n")

  println("1. Stack (LIFO - Last In First Out)")
  let stack = stack_new()

  println("  Push: 10, 20, 30")
  stack_push(stack, 10)
  stack_push(stack, 20)
  stack_push(stack, 30)
  println("  Size: " + stack_size(stack).to_string())

  println("  Peek: " + stack_peek(stack).to_string())

  println("  Pop sequence:")
  let i = 0
  while i < 3 do
    match stack_pop(stack) {
      Some(val) -> println("    Popped: " + val.to_string()),
      None -> println("    Stack empty")
    }
    i = i + 1
  end

  println("")

  # Queue 테스트
  println("2. Queue (FIFO - First In First Out)")
  let queue = queue_new()

  println("  Enqueue: 10, 20, 30")
  queue_enqueue(queue, 10)
  queue_enqueue(queue, 20)
  queue_enqueue(queue, 30)
  println("  Size: " + queue_size(queue).to_string())

  println("  Front: " + queue_front(queue).to_string())

  println("  Dequeue sequence:")
  let j = 0
  while j < 3 do
    match queue_dequeue(queue) {
      Some(val) -> println("    Dequeued: " + val.to_string()),
      None -> println("    Queue empty")
    }
    j = j + 1
  end

  println("")

  # 혼합 연산
  println("3. Mixed Operations")
  let stack2 = stack_new()

  stack_push(stack2, 100)
  stack_push(stack2, 200)
  println("  Pushed 100, 200")
  println("  Size: " + stack_size(stack2).to_string())
  println("  Is empty: " + stack_is_empty(stack2).to_string())

  match stack_pop(stack2) {
    Some(val) -> (
      println("  Popped: " + val.to_string())
      println("  Size: " + stack_size(stack2).to_string())
    ),
    None -> println("  Stack empty")
  }

  println("\n========================================")

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 예제 4: 행렬 연산
# ==========================================
# 기능:
# - 2D 배열 기반 행렬 표현
# - 행렬 합, 곱셈
# - 함수 오버로딩
# - 고차 함수 활용
# ==========================================

record Matrix =
  rows: Int
  cols: Int
  data: Array[Int]

# 행렬 생성 (모두 0으로 초기화)
function matrix_create(rows: Int, cols: Int): Matrix =
  let size = rows * cols
  let data = []
  let i = 0
  while i < size do
    data.push(0)
    i = i + 1
  end

  Matrix { rows: rows, cols: cols, data: data }

# 인덱스 계산
function matrix_index(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int): Int =
  row * m.cols + col

# 값 설정
function matrix_set(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int, val: Int): Unit =
  m.data[matrix_index(m, row, col)] = val

# 값 조회
function matrix_get(m: Matrix, row: Int, col: Int): Int =
  m.data[matrix_index(m, row, col)]

# 행렬 덧셈
function matrix_add(a: Matrix, b: Matrix): Result[Matrix, String] =
  if a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols then
    Err("Matrix dimensions must match")
  else
    let result = matrix_create(a.rows, a.cols)
    let i = 0
    while i < a.rows do
      let j = 0
      while j < a.cols do
        let sum = matrix_get(a, i, j) + matrix_get(b, i, j)
        matrix_set(result, i, j, sum)
        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    Ok(result)
  end

# 행렬 곱셈
function matrix_multiply(a: Matrix, b: Matrix): Result[Matrix, String] =
  if a.cols != b.rows then
    Err("Invalid dimensions for multiplication")
  else
    let result = matrix_create(a.rows, b.cols)
    let i = 0
    while i < a.rows do
      let j = 0
      while j < b.cols do
        let sum = 0
        let k = 0
        while k < a.cols do
          sum = sum + matrix_get(a, i, k) * matrix_get(b, k, j)
          k = k + 1
        end
        matrix_set(result, i, j, sum)
        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    Ok(result)
  end

# 행렬 스칼라 곱
function matrix_scale(m: Matrix, scalar: Int): Matrix =
  let result = matrix_create(m.rows, m.cols)
  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      let val = matrix_get(m, i, j) * scalar
      matrix_set(result, i, j, val)
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  result

# 행렬 전치
function matrix_transpose(m: Matrix): Matrix =
  let result = matrix_create(m.cols, m.rows)
  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      let val = matrix_get(m, i, j)
      matrix_set(result, j, i, val)
      j = j + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end

  result

# 행렬 출력
function matrix_print(m: Matrix, name: String): Unit =
  println(name + " (" + m.rows.to_string() + "x" + m.cols.to_string() + "):")

  let i = 0
  while i < m.rows do
    print("  [")
    let j = 0
    while j < m.cols do
      print(matrix_get(m, i, j).to_string())
      if j < m.cols - 1 then
        print(", ")
      end
      j = j + 1
    end
    println("]")
    i = i + 1
  end

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Matrix Operations")
  println("========================================\n")

  # 2x2 행렬 생성
  let a = matrix_create(2, 2)
  matrix_set(a, 0, 0, 1)
  matrix_set(a, 0, 1, 2)
  matrix_set(a, 1, 0, 3)
  matrix_set(a, 1, 1, 4)

  let b = matrix_create(2, 2)
  matrix_set(b, 0, 0, 5)
  matrix_set(b, 0, 1, 6)
  matrix_set(b, 1, 0, 7)
  matrix_set(b, 1, 1, 8)

  println("1. Matrix Addition")
  matrix_print(a, "  A")
  matrix_print(b, "  B")

  match matrix_add(a, b) {
    Ok(result) -> (
      matrix_print(result, "  A + B")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("  Error: " + msg)
  }

  println("")

  println("2. Matrix Multiplication")
  match matrix_multiply(a, b) {
    Ok(result) -> (
      matrix_print(result, "  A * B")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("  Error: " + msg)
  }

  println("")

  println("3. Scalar Multiplication")
  let scaled = matrix_scale(a, 2)
  matrix_print(scaled, "  A * 2")

  println("")

  println("4. Matrix Transpose")
  let transposed = matrix_transpose(a)
  matrix_print(transposed, "  A^T")

  println("\n========================================")

  # base^exp 계산
  # FV 2.0 native math.pow 사용
  if exp == 0.0 then
    1.0
  else if exp == 1.0 then
    base
  else if exp == 2.0 then

  else
    # 일반적인 경우: native function 호출

  # 제곱근 계산

    0.0  # 에러: 음수의 제곱근
  else if x == 0.0 then
    0.0
  else
    # Newton's method: x_{n+1} = (x_n + x/x_n) / 2
    newton_sqrt(x, x, 10)
  end

function newton_sqrt(x: Float, guess: Float, iterations: Int): Float =
  if iterations <= 0 then
    guess
  else

    newton_sqrt(x, next_guess, iterations - 1)
  end

  taylor_sin(x, x, 1, 1.0, 0)

    let next_term = term * next_factor

# 기본 메서드

function string_length(s: String): Int =
  s.length()

function string_substring(s: String, start: Int, end: Int): String =
  if start < 0 || end > s.length() || start >= end then
    ""
  else
    s.substring(start, end)
  end

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Option[Int] =
  let i = 0
  while i <= s.length() - substr.length() do
    if s.substring(i, i + substr.length()) == substr then
      return Some(i)
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  None

function string_contains(s: String, substr: String): Bool =
  match string_index_of(s, substr) {
    Some(_) -> true,
    None -> false
  }

function string_starts_with(s: String, prefix: String): Bool =
  if prefix.length() > s.length() then
    false
  else
    s.substring(0, prefix.length()) == prefix
  end

function string_ends_with(s: String, suffix: String): Bool =
  if suffix.length() > s.length() then
    false
  else
    let start = s.length() - suffix.length()
    s.substring(start, s.length()) == suffix
  end

# ==========================================

function string_uppercase(s: String): String =
  let result = ""
  let i = 0
  while i < s.length() do

# ==========================================
# Future 타입 (간단한 구현)
# ==========================================

record Future =
  id: Int
  result: Option[Int]
  is_done: Bool
  timeout_ms: Int

record FutureResult =
  is_ok: Bool
  value: Int
  error_msg: String

# ==========================================
# Future 생성 및 관리
# ==========================================

let next_future_id = 0

function spawn(f: () => Int): Future =
  # 간단한 동기 실행 (FV 2.0에서 native 병렬 처리)
  let result = f()
  let id = next_future_id
  next_future_id = next_future_id + 1

  Future {
    id: id,
    result: Some(result),
    is_done: true,
    timeout_ms: 0
  }

function future_await(fut: Future): Int =
  # 결과 대기 (현재는 즉시 반환, 동기)
  match fut.result {
    Some(val) -> val,
    None -> 0  # 에러 처리
  }

function future_is_done(fut: Future): Bool =
  fut.is_done

function future_cancel(fut: Future): Bool =
  # 취소 시도 (현재는 불가능, 이미 완료됨)
  false

# ==========================================
# 타임아웃 지원
# ==========================================

function future_await_timeout(fut: Future, timeout_ms: Int): Result[Int, String] =
  if fut.is_done then
    match fut.result {
      Some(val) -> Ok(val),
      None -> Err("Future failed")
    }
  else
    # 타임아웃 체크 (현재는 간단히 처리)
    if timeout_ms > 0 then
      Err("timeout")
    else
      match fut.result {
        Some(val) -> Ok(val),
        None -> Err("Future failed")
      }
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 다중 Future 처리
# ==========================================

function wait_all(futures: Array[Future]): Array[Int] =
  let result = []
  let i = 0
  while i < futures.length() do
    let val = future_await(futures[i])
    result.push(val)
    i = i + 1
  end
  result

function wait_any(futures: Array[Future]): Option[Int] =
  # 첫 번째 완료된 Future 반환
  let i = 0
  while i < futures.length() do
    if futures[i].is_done then
      return future_await(futures[i])
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  None

# ==========================================

  resolve_val: Option[Int]
  reject_msg: Option[String]
  callbacks: Array[() => Unit]

    reject_msg: None,

function promise_reject(p: Promise, msg: String): Unit =

function promise_then(p: Promise, callback: (Int) => Unit): Promise =

  p.callbacks.push(fun -> callback(0))

  p

  max_count: Int

function semaphore_new(max_count: Int): Semaphore =

    count: 0,
    max_count: max_count
  }

function semaphore_acquire(s: Semaphore): Bool =
  if s.count < s.max_count then
    s.count = s.count + 1
    true
  else
    false
  end

function semaphore_release(s: Semaphore): Unit =
  if s.count > 0 then
    s.count = s.count - 1
  end

# ==========================================

record Timer =
  delay_ms: Int
  callback: () => Unit
  is_active: Bool

function set_timeout(callback: () => Unit, delay_ms: Int): Timer =
  Timer {
    delay_ms: delay_ms,
    callback: callback,
    is_active: true
  }

function clear_timeout(timer: Timer): Unit =
  timer.is_active = false

function set_interval(callback: () => Unit, interval_ms: Int): Timer =
  Timer {
    delay_ms: interval_ms,
    callback: callback,
    is_active: true
  }

function clear_interval(timer: Timer): Unit =
  timer.is_active = false

function semaphore_release(s: Semaphore): Unit =
  if s.count > 0 then
    s.count = s.count - 1
  end

record Timer =
  delay_ms: Int
  callback: () => Unit
  is_active: Bool

function set_timeout(callback: () => Unit, delay_ms: Int): Timer =
  Timer {
    delay_ms: delay_ms,
    callback: callback,
    is_active: true
  }

function clear_timeout(timer: Timer): Unit =
  timer.is_active = false

function set_interval(callback: () => Unit, interval_ms: Int): Timer =
  Timer {
    delay_ms: interval_ms,
    callback: callback,
    is_active: true
  }

function clear_interval(timer: Timer): Unit =
  timer.is_active = false

    i = i + 1

  test_assert_eq(result.length(), 3, "Array: unique")

    j = j + 1

    while j < result.length() do

    end

    i = i + 1
  end
  test_assert_eq(result.length(), 3, "Array: unique")

  let start = 0
  let i = 0
  while i < s.length() do
    if s.substring(i, i + 1) == "," then

      start = i + 1
    end
    i = i + 1
  end
  result.push(s.substring(start, s.length()))
  test_assert_eq(result.length(), 3, "String: split")

**Version**: 0.4.0

## 목차

## 개요

### 부트스트랩 목표

FV-Julia를 자신의 코드로 컴파일할 수 있는 **자기-호스팅 언어**로 완성합니다.

```
Phase 1-3: FV-Julia 언어 + 표준 라이브러리 (FreeJulia로 작성)
Phase 4: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (FV 2.0으로 작성) → 자신을 컴파일

FreeJulia (기존 컴파일러)
  ↓
FV-Julia Code Generator (Phase 1) → FV 2.0 코드
  ↓
FV 2.0 컴파일러 (Go) → C 코드
  ↓
gcc → 네이티브 바이너리
  ↓
FV-Julia 컴파일러 (자신의 코드로 작성) ✅
  ↓
FV-Julia로 FreeJulia 재컴파일 (순환 완성!)
```

---

## 2단계 부트스트랩

### Stage 1: 초기 부트스트랩

```
Input: FreeJulia 소스 (freelang-julia/)
  ↓
FreeJulia 컴파일러 실행
  ↓
FV-Julia 코드 생성기 (Phase 1) 사용
  ↓
FV 2.0 코드 생성
  ↓
FV 2.0 컴파일러 (Go) 사용 → C 코드
  ↓
gcc 컴파일 → 바이너리
  ↓
Output: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 1 버전)
```

### Stage 2: 자기-호스팅

```
Input: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 1)
  ↓
FV-Julia 컴파일러로 FreeJulia 코드 컴파일
  ↓
Output: FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Stage 2 버전)
  ↓
검증: Stage 1과 Stage 2가 동일한가? (비교)
```

**성공 기준**: `Stage 1 바이너리 == Stage 2 바이너리` (고정점 도달)

---

## 컴파일러 아키텍처

### Phase 1-3 현황

**이미 구현된 것**:
- ✅ Code Generator: FreeJulia → FV 2.0

- 🔲 FV-Julia 컴파일러 (메인 로직)

```
FV-Julia 컴파일러 (Go로 작성, FV 2.0에서 자동 생성)
├── main.fv
│   └── FV-Julia 프로그램 입력 처리
├── compiler/
│   ├── lexer.fv         # Lexer (토큰화)
│   ├── parser.fv        # Parser (AST)
│   ├── typechecker.fv   # Type Checker
│   ├── codegen.fv       # Code Generator → FV 2.0
│   └── linker.fv        # Linker (모듈 통합)
├── stdlib/
│   └── (Phase 3 표준 라이브러리 사용)
└── tests/

```

### 간단한 구현 전략

FV-Julia 컴파일러는 **코드 생성기**로 단순화:

```freejulia
function compile(source_code: String): String =
  # FreeJulia 코드 문자열 입력
  # FV 2.0 코드 문자열 출력

  let tokens = lexer(source_code)
  let ast = parser(tokens)
  let typed_ast = type_checker(ast)
  let fv2_code = code_generator(typed_ast)

  fv2_code
```

### 핵심 컴포넌트

#### 1. Lexer (토큰화)
```freejulia
record Token =
  type: String      # "int", "string", "function", etc.
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function lexer(source: String): Array[Token]
  # 문자열을 토큰으로 변환
```

#### 2. Parser (AST)
```freejulia
record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "function", "let", "match", etc.
  name: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]
  value: String

function parser(tokens: Array[Token]): ASTNode
  # 토큰을 AST로 변환
```

#### 3. Type Checker
```freejulia
function type_checker(ast: ASTNode): ASTNode
  # AST 타입 검사 및 주석 추가
  # 타입 불일치 감지
```

#### 4. Code Generator
```freejulia
function code_generator(typed_ast: ASTNode): String
  # Phase 1의 코드 생성기 재사용
  # 타입 체크된 AST → FV 2.0 코드
```

FV-Julia를 자신의 코드로 컴파일할 수 있는 **자기-호스팅 언어**로 완성합니다.

```
Phase 1-3: FV-Julia 언어 + 표준 라이브러리 (FreeJulia로 작성)

  ↓

  ↓

```

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 간단한 구현: 토큰 배열을 AST로 변환
  # 전체 파싱 로직은 복잡하므로 임시 구현
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 타입 검사 수행
  # 현재: 그냥 통과 (FV 2.0에서 native 타입 체크)
  Ok(ast)

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  # Phase 1의 코드 생성기를 사용
  # 입력: typed AST
  # 출력: FV 2.0 코드

  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n\n"

  # 본문 (임시)
  code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
  code = code + "  println(\"Hello from FV-Julia\")\n"
  code = code + "}\n"

  code

# ==========================================
# Helper: 파일 I/O
# ==========================================

function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 에러 반환
  Err("File I/O not implemented")

function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 성공 반환
  Ok(Unit)

# ==========================================
# Main
# ==========================================

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Compiler v0.4.0")
  println("========================================")
  println("")

  # 테스트: 간단한 소스 컴파일
  let source = "function hello(): Unit = println(\"Hi\")"

  match compile_source(source) {
    Ok(code) -> (
      println("Compilation successful!")
      println("")
      println("Generated FV 2.0 code:")
      println("----------------------------------------")
      println(code)
      println("----------------------------------------")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("Compilation failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행

      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia Code Generator
# FreeJulia → FV 2.0 코드 변환
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# 타입 매핑 정의
# ==========================================

record TypeMapping =
  fj_type: String          # FreeJulia 타입
  fv_type: String          # FV 2.0 타입
  needs_import: Bool       # 임포트 필요 여부
  conversion_func: String  # 변환 함수 (선택사항)

# ==========================================
# 기본 타입 매핑
# ==========================================

function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "String",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      # Array 타입 처리
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
        # Dictionary[K, V] → Map(K, V)
        "Map(String, String)"
      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
        # Function → 함수 포인터
        "fn(String) String"
      else
        # 기본값: 타입명 그대로
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

# ==========================================
# Array 타입 추출
# ==========================================

function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    let start = 6  # "Array[".length()
    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    array_type.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# 함수 정의 변환
# ==========================================

record FunctionDef =
  name: String
  params: Array[String]           # param_name: type 형식
  return_type: String
  body: String

function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
  # FreeJulia:  function add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b
  # FV 2.0:     func add(a i32, b i32) i32 { return a + b }

  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("
  
  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_parts = Array[String]()
  for param in fj_func.params do
    # "a: Int" → "a i32"
    let parts = param.split(":")
    if parts.length() == 2 then
      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    end
  end
  
  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "
  
  # 반환 타입
  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"
  
  # 함수 본문
  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# 배열 조인 (헬퍼)
# ==========================================

function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:arr.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + separator
    end
    result = result + arr[i]
  end
  result

# ==========================================
# 제어 흐름 변환
# ==========================================

function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
  # if condition then body1 else body2 end
  # →
  # if (condition) { body1 } else { body2 }

  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"
  
  if else_body.length() > 0 then
    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
  end
  
  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
  fv_code

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================

  name: String
  params: Array[String]

  value: String

  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",

    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 타입 검사 수행
  # 현재: 그냥 통과 (FV 2.0에서 native 타입 체크)
  Ok(ast)

# ==========================================

# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  # Phase 1의 코드 생성기를 사용
  # 입력: typed AST

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ": " + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

  # 타입 검사 수행

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = param.split(":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = parts[0].trim()
    let type_str = parts[1].trim()
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = type_str.index_of("[") + 1
    let end = type_str.index_of("]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# String 헬퍼 함수 (빌트인 확장)
function index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      if s.substring(i, i + substr.length()) == substr then
        i
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
