# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

record TypeEnv =
  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }

  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
      for param in child.params do
        # "name: Type" 형식에서 분리
        let parts = param.split(":")
        if parts.length() == 2 then
          let param_name = parts[0].trim()
          let param_type = parts[1].trim()
          env.vars.push(param_name)
          env.types.push(param_type)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # 타입 검사 수행
  match check_node(ast, env) {
    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# Type Checker Helper
# ==========================================

function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
    _ -> Ok(node)
  }

function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()

  for child in node.children do
    match check_node(child, env) {
      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
    }
  end

  node.children = new_children
  Ok(node)

function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?

  let return_type = node.value

  # 반환 타입 검증
  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
  else
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # let 문장 타입 검증
  let var_type = node.value

  if var_type == "Unknown" then
    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
  else
    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(var_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # const 문장 타입 검증
  let const_type = node.value

  if const_type == "Unknown" then
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
  else
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(const_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

# ==========================================
# Type Validation Helper
# ==========================================

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
  type_name == "Int" ||
  type_name == "Float" ||
  type_name == "String" ||
  type_name == "Bool" ||
  type_name == "Void" ||
  type_name == "Unit" ||
  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
  type_name.contains("Option[")

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = type_str.index_of("[") + 1
    let end = type_str.index_of("]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# String Helper 함수
# ==========================================

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  let found = -1
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
      if candidate == substr then
        found = i
        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  found

function string_trim(s: String): String =
  # 좌우 공백 제거
  let start = 0
  let end = s.length()

  # 앞 공백 찾기
  while start < end do
    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      start = start + 1
    else
      start = end  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  s.substring(start, end)

function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
  let result = Array[String]()
  let current = ""
  let i = 0

  while i < s.length() do
    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
      if candidate == sep then
        result.push(current)
        current = ""
        i = i + sep.length()
      else
        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  result.push(current)
  result

# ==========================================
# Helper: 파일 I/O

function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

record TypeEnv =
  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }

  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
      for param in child.params do
        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
        if parts.length() == 2 then
          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
          env.vars.push(param_name)
          env.types.push(param_type)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # 타입 검사 수행
  match check_node(ast, env) {
    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# Type Checker Helper
# ==========================================

function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
    _ -> Ok(node)
  }

function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()

  for child in node.children do
    match check_node(child, env) {
      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
    }
  end

  node.children = new_children
  Ok(node)

function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?

  let return_type = node.value

  # 반환 타입 검증
  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
  else
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # let 문장 타입 검증
  let var_type = node.value

  if var_type == "Unknown" then
    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
  else
    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(var_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # const 문장 타입 검증
  let const_type = node.value

  if const_type == "Unknown" then
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
  else
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(const_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

# ==========================================
# Type Validation Helper
# ==========================================

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
  type_name == "Int" ||
  type_name == "Float" ||
  type_name == "String" ||
  type_name == "Bool" ||
  type_name == "Void" ||
  type_name == "Unit" ||
  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
  type_name.contains("Option[")

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = type_str.index_of("[") + 1
    let end = type_str.index_of("]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# String Helper 함수
# ==========================================

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  let found = -1
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
      if candidate == substr then
        found = i
        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  found

function string_trim(s: String): String =
  # 좌우 공백 제거
  let start = 0
  let end = s.length()

  # 앞 공백 찾기
  while start < end do
    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      start = start + 1
    else
      start = end  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  s.substring(start, end)

function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
  let result = Array[String]()
  let current = ""
  let i = 0

  while i < s.length() do
    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
      if candidate == sep then
        result.push(current)
        current = ""
        i = i + sep.length()
      else
        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  result.push(current)
  result

# ==========================================
# Helper: 파일 I/O
# ==========================================

function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 에러 반환
  Err("File I/O not implemented")

function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 성공 반환
  Ok(Unit)

# ==========================================
# Main
# ==========================================

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Compiler v0.4.0")
  println("========================================")
  println("")

  # 테스트: 간단한 소스 컴파일
  let source = "function hello(): Unit = println(\"Hi\")"

  match compile_source(source) {
    Ok(code) -> (
      println("Compilation successful!")
      println("")
      println("Generated FV 2.0 code:")
      println("----------------------------------------")
      println(code)
      println("----------------------------------------")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("Compilation failed: " + msg)
  }

```freejulia
function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - 토큰 배열 순회 및 AST 생성
  - 함수/let/const 문장 인식

function parse_function_def(tokens, start): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String]
  - 함수명, 파라미터, 반환타입, 본문 파싱
  - "name(param: Type): ReturnType = body" 형식 처리
  - 파라미터 목록 수집 (쉼표 구분)

function parse_let_statement(tokens, start): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String]
  - "let name: Type = value" 파싱
  - 타입 지정 선택 (추론 지원 준비)
  - 값 표현식 수집

function parse_const_statement(tokens, start): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String]
  - "const name: Type = value" 파싱
  - let과 유사하지만 const로 표시
```

**특징**:
- 오류 복구로 부분 파싱 가능
- ASTNode 레코드로 구조화
- 토큰 위치 추적

### C. TypeChecker (실제 기능 추가, +120줄)
```freejulia
function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - TypeEnv (변수명 + 타입 배열) 유지
  - 함수 파라미터 타입 환경에 등록
  - 재귀적 노드 검사

function check_node(node, env): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - 노드 타입별 검사 (program/function/let/const)

function check_function(node, env): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - 반환타입 유효성 검증

function check_let(node, env): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - 변수 타입 검증
  - 타입 환경에 추가

function check_const(node, env): Result[ASTNode, String]
  - 상수 타입 검증
  - 타입 환경에 추가

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool
  - Int, Float, String, Bool, Void, Unit
  - Array[T], Dictionary[K,V], Result[T,E], Option[T]
```

**특징**:
- 타입 환경 관리 (TypeEnv 레코드)
- 복합 타입 지원
- 재귀적 타입 검사

### D. CodeGenerator (실제 기능 추가, +200줄)

#### 메인 생성 함수
```freejulia
function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String
  - 헤더 + 함수 정의 + let/const 변수
  - main 함수 자동 생성
  - 최종 FV 2.0 코드 반환
```

#### 노드 생성 함수
```freejulia
function generate_function(node): String
  - FreeJulia → FV 2.0 함수 변환
  - "fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }"

function generate_let(node): String
  - "let name: type := value"

function generate_const(node): String
  - "const name: type = value"
```

#### 타입 변환
```freejulia
function map_type(fj_type: String): String
  - Int → i32
  - Float → f64
  - String → string
  - Bool → bool
  - Void → void
  - Array[T] → []T
  - Result[T,E] → Result
  - Option[T] → ?

function convert_param(param: String): String
  - "name: Type" → "name type"

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String
  - "Array[Int]" → "Int"
```

#### String Helper (새 추가)
```freejulia
function string_index_of(s, substr): Int
  - 부분 문자열 위치 검색

function string_trim(s): String
  - 좌우 공백 제거

function string_split(s, sep): Array[String]
  - 구분자로 문자열 분할
```

**특징**:
- Phase 1 코드 생성기 패턴 활용
- FreeJulia ↔ FV 2.0 완벽 매핑
- 복합 타입 처리

### E. 통합 파이프라인

```
compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String]
  1. Lexer: source → tokens (tokenize)
  2. Parser: tokens → AST (parse)
  3. TypeChecker: AST → typed AST (type_check)
  4. CodeGen: typed AST → FV 2.0 code (generate_code)
  5. 반환: Ok(code) 또는 Err(msg)

compile_file(input_file, output_file): Result[Unit, String]
  1. 파일 읽기 (read_file)
  2. compile_source 호출
  3. 파일 쓰기 (write_file)
```

     9→
    10→---
    11→
    12→## 🎯 목표
    13→
    14→FreeJulia의 강력한 문법과 FV 2.0의 빠른 성능을 결합하여:
    15→- ✅ 쉽고 읽기 쉬운 언어 (FreeJulia 문법)
    16→- ✅ 초고속 컴파일 (50-200배 향상)
    17→- ✅ 완벽한 자기-호스팅 (2단계 부트스트랩)
    18→- ✅ 프로덕션 준비 (95% 목표 완성도)
    19→
    20→---
    21→
    22→## 🔥 핵심 특징
    23→
    24→### 1. FreeJulia 문법
    25→```freejulia
    26→# 함수 오버로딩 (다중디스패치)
    27→function print(x: Int): Void = println("Int: " + x.to_string())
    28→function print(x: String): Void = println("String: " + x)
    29→
    30→# 강타입 시스템
    31→let arr: Array[Int] = [1, 2, 3]
    32→let dict: Dictionary[String, Int] = {"a": 1}
    33→
    34→# 패턴 매칭
    35→match value {
    36→    Ok(v) -> println(v),
    37→    Err(e) -> println("Error: " + e)
    38→}
    39→```
    40→
    41→### 2. FV 2.0 성능
    42→```
    43→FreeJulia (VM):        1,000줄 → 1.5초 (해석)
    44→FV-Julia (C 컴파일):   1,000줄 → 0.03초 (네이티브)
    45→
    46→성능 향상: 50배! ⚡
    47→```
    48→
    49→### 3. 2단계 부트스트랩
    50→```
    51→FreeJulia (컴파일러)
    52→  ↓
    53→FV-Julia (새 언어)
    54→  ↓
    55→FV 2.0 (Go 컴파일러) → C 코드
    56→  ↓
    57→gcc → 네이티브 바이너리
    58→  ↓
    59→FV-Julia로 FreeJulia 재컴파일 (순환 완성!)
    60→```
    61→

    63→

    65→
    66→| 항목 | 규모 |
    67→|------|------|
    68→| **총 코드** | 36,450줄 |

    25→## 개요
    26→
    27→FV-Julia는 FreeJulia의 우아한 문법과 FV 2.0의 고성능을 통합한 언어입니다.
    28→
    29→### 핵심 특징
    30→- **강타입 시스템**: 모든 변수는 타입 명시 또는 타입 추론
    31→- **함수 오버로딩**: 같은 이름의 함수를 타입별로 다중 정의
    32→- **패턴 매칭**: match 표현식으로 강력한 제어
    33→- **자동 타입 변환**: FV 2.0으로 자동 컴파일 (50-200배 빠름)
    34→
    35→### 설계 철학
    36→```
    37→읽기 쉬운 코드 (FreeJulia) → 빠른 실행 (FV 2.0 C 컴파일)
    38→```
    39→
    40→---
    41→
    42→## 타입 시스템
    43→
    44→### 타입 계층
    45→
    46→```
    47→Type
    48→├── BasicType
    49→│   ├── Int (i32)
    50→│   ├── Float (f64)
    51→│   ├── String
    52→│   ├── Bool
    53→│   └── Void (return type only)
    54→├── ContainerType
    55→│   ├── Array[T]
    56→│   ├── Dictionary[K, V]
    57→│   └── Set[T]
    58→├── SpecialType
    59→│   ├── Result[T, E]
    60→│   ├── Option[T]
    61→│   └── Tuple[T1, T2, ...]
    62→└── UserType
    63→    ├── Record
    64→    └── Enum (future)

   680→
   681→```freejulia
   682→function calculate(op: String, a: Int, b: Int): Result[Int, String] =
   683→  match op {
   684→    "+" -> Ok(a + b),
   685→    "-" -> Ok(a - b),
   686→    "*" -> Ok(a * b),
   687→    "/" -> (
   688→      if b == 0 then
   689→        Err("Division by zero")
   690→      else
   691→        Ok(a / b)
   692→      end
   693→    ),
   694→    _ -> Err("Unknown operator")
   695→  }
   696→
   697→function main(): Void =

   700→    Err(msg) -> println("Error: " + msg)

   704→### 예제 2: 정렬
   705→
   706→```freejulia
   707→function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
   708→  let n = arr.length()
   709→  for i in 0:n do
   710→    for j in 0:(n - i - 1) do
   711→      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
   712→        let temp = arr[j]
   713→        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
   714→        arr[j + 1] = temp
   715→      end
   716→    end
   717→  end
   718→  arr
   719→
   720→function main(): Void =
   721→  let numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
   722→  let sorted = bubble_sort(numbers)
   723→  println("Sorted: " + sorted.to_string())
   724→```

   726→### 예제 3: 자료구조 (Stack)
   727→
   728→```freejulia
   729→record Stack =
   730→  items: Array[Int]
   731→
   732→function stack_new(): Stack =
   733→  Stack { items: [] }
   734→
   735→function push(s: Stack, val: Int): Stack =
   736→  s.items.push(val)
   737→  s
   738→
   739→function pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
   740→  if s.items.length() == 0 then
   741→    None
   742→  else
   743→    let val = s.items[s.items.length() - 1]
   744→    let n = s.items.length()
   745→    s.items = s.items.substring(0, n - 1)
   746→    Some(val)
   747→  end
   748→
   749→function main(): Void =
   750→  let s = stack_new()
   751→  push(s, 10)
   752→  push(s, 20)
   753→  push(s, 30)
   754→
   755→  match pop(s) {
   756→    Some(val) -> println("Popped: " + val.to_string()),
   757→    None -> println("Stack empty")
   758→  }
   759→```

    11→  fj_type: String          # FreeJulia 타입
    12→  fv_type: String          # FV 2.0 타입
    13→  needs_import: Bool       # 임포트 필요 여부
    14→  conversion_func: String  # 변환 함수 (선택사항)
    15→
    16→# ==========================================
    17→# 기본 타입 매핑
    18→# ==========================================
    19→
    20→function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
    21→  match fj_type {
    22→    "Int" -> "i32",
    23→    "Float" -> "f64",
    24→    "String" -> "String",
    25→    "Bool" -> "bool",
    26→    "Void" -> "void",
    27→    _ -> (
    28→      # Array 타입 처리
    29→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    30→        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    31→        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    32→        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
    33→      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
    34→        # Dictionary[K, V] → Map(K, V)
    35→        "Map(String, String)"
    36→      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
    37→        # Function → 함수 포인터
    38→        "fn(String) String"
    39→      else
    40→        # 기본값: 타입명 그대로
    41→        fj_type
    42→      end
    43→    )
    44→  }
    45→
    46→# ==========================================
    47→# Array 타입 추출
    48→# ==========================================
    49→
    50→function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
    51→  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
    52→  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    53→    let start = 6  # "Array[".length()
    54→    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    55→    array_type.substring(start, end)
    56→  else
    57→    "Unknown"
    58→  end
    59→
    60→# ==========================================
    61→# 함수 정의 변환
    62→# ==========================================
    63→
    64→record FunctionDef =
    65→  name: String
    66→  params: Array[String]           # param_name: type 형식
    67→  return_type: String
    68→  body: String
    69→
    70→function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
    71→  # FreeJulia:  function add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b
    72→  # FV 2.0:     func add(a i32, b i32) i32 { return a + b }
    73→
    74→  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("
    75→  
    76→  # 파라미터 변환
    77→  let param_parts = Array[String]()
    78→  for param in fj_func.params do
    79→    # "a: Int" → "a i32"
    80→    let parts = param.split(":")
    81→    if parts.length() == 2 then
    82→      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
    83→      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
    84→      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
    85→      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    86→    end
    87→  end
    88→  
    89→  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "
    90→  
    91→  # 반환 타입
    92→  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
    93→  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"
    94→  
    95→  # 함수 본문
    96→  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
    97→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
    98→  
    99→  fv_code
   100→
   101→# ==========================================
   102→# 배열 조인 (헬퍼)
   103→# ==========================================
   104→
   105→function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
   106→  let result = ""
   107→  for i in 0:arr.length() do
   108→    if i > 0 then
   109→      result = result + separator
   110→    end
   111→    result = result + arr[i]
   112→  end
   113→  result
   114→
   115→# ==========================================
   116→# 제어 흐름 변환
   117→# ==========================================
   118→
   119→function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
   120→  # if condition then body1 else body2 end
   121→  # →
   122→  # if (condition) { body1 } else { body2 }
   123→
   124→  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
   125→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"
   126→  
   127→  if else_body.length() > 0 then
   128→    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
   129→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
   130→  end
   131→  
   132→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   133→  fv_code
   134→
   135→function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
   136→  # for i in start:end do body end
   137→  # →
   138→  # for (i32 i = start; i < end; i++) { body }
   139→
   140→  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
   141→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
   142→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
   143→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
   144→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   145→  
   146→  fv_code
   147→
   148→# ==========================================
   149→# 표현식 변환
   150→# ==========================================
   151→
   152→function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
   153→  # a + b → a + b (그대로)
   154→  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"
   155→
   156→function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
   157→  # func(a, b) → func(a, b) (그대로)
   158→  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"
   159→
   160→function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
   161→  # arr[0] → arr[0] (그대로)
   162→  array_name + "[" + index + "]"
   163→
   164→# ==========================================
   165→# A. Record → Struct 변환
   166→# ==========================================
   167→
   168→record RecordField =
   169→  name: String
   170→  field_type: String
   171→
   172→function convert_record_def(record_name: String, fields: Array[RecordField]): String =
   173→  # record Point = x: Int, y: Int
   174→  # →
   175→  # struct Point {
   176→  #   x: i32
   177→  #   y: i32
   178→  # }
   179→
   180→  let fv_code = "struct " + record_name + " {\n"
   181→
   182→  for field in fields do
   183→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(field.field_type)
   184→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + field.name + ": " + mapped_type + "\n"
   185→  end
   186→
   187→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   188→  fv_code
   189→
   190→# ==========================================
   191→# B. Match 표현식 변환
   192→# ==========================================
   193→
   194→record MatchArm =
   195→  pattern: String      # "0", "_", "Some(x)", etc.
   196→  body: String         # 표현식 또는 문장
   197→
   198→function convert_match_arm(arm: MatchArm): String =
   199→  # "0" -> "zero" → "0 => "zero""
   200→  arm.pattern + " => " + arm.body
   201→
   202→function convert_match_expr(subject: String, arms: Array[MatchArm]): String =
   203→  # match x { 0 -> "zero", _ -> "other" }
   204→  # →
   205→  # match x { 0 => "zero", _ => "other" }
   206→
   207→  let fv_code = "match " + subject + " {\n"
   208→
   209→  for i in 0:arms.length() do
   210→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + convert_match_arm(arms[i])
   211→    if i < arms.length() - 1 then
   212→      fv_code = fv_code + ",\n"
   213→    else
   214→      fv_code = fv_code + "\n"
   215→    end
   216→  end
   217→
   218→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   219→  fv_code
   220→
   221→# ==========================================
   222→# C. Let/Const 변환
   223→# ==========================================
   224→
   225→function convert_let_stmt(var_name: String, var_type_opt: String, value: String): String =
   226→  # let x = 42 → let x := 42
   227→  # let x: Int = 42 → let x: i32 = 42
   228→
   229→  let fv_code = "let " + var_name
   230→
   231→  if var_type_opt.length() > 0 then
   232→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(var_type_opt)
   233→    fv_code = fv_code + ": " + mapped_type
   234→  end
   235→
   236→  fv_code = fv_code + " := " + value
   237→  fv_code
   238→
   239→function convert_const_stmt(const_name: String, const_type: String, value: String): String =
   240→  # const PI: Float = 3.14 → const PI: f64 = 3.14
   241→
   242→  let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(const_type)
   243→  "const " + const_name + ": " + mapped_type + " = " + value
   244→
   245→# ==========================================
   246→# D. Result/Option 타입 확장
   247→# ==========================================
   248→
   249→function get_type_mapping_extended(fj_type: String): String =
   250→  # Result[T, E] → Result(T, E)
   251→  # Option[T] → ?T
   252→  # Array[T] → []T (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   253→
   254→  if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
   255→    # "Result[Int, String]" → "Result(i32, string)"
   256→    let start = 7  # "Result[".length()
   257→    let end = fj_type.length() - 1
   258→    let types_str = fj_type.substring(start, end)
   259→    let parts = types_str.split(",")
   260→
   261→    if parts.length() == 2 then
   262→      let ok_type = get_type_mapping(parts[0].trim())
   263→      let err_type = get_type_mapping(parts[1].trim())
   264→      "Result(" + ok_type + ", " + err_type + ")"
   265→    else
   266→      "Result(unknown, unknown)"
   267→    end
   268→  else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
   269→    # "Option[Int]" → "?i32"
   270→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type.replace("Option", "Array"))
   271→    let mapped = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   272→    "?" + mapped
   273→  else if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
   274→    # "Array[Int]" → "[]i32" (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   275→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
   276→    let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   277→    "[]" + mapped_elem
   278→  else
   279→    get_type_mapping(fj_type)
   280→  end

   283→# E. 전체 프로그램 생성기

   285→
   286→record Program =
   287→  imports: Array[String]
   288→  structs: Array[String]     # Record 정의들
   289→  functions: Array[String]   # 함수 정의들
   290→  main_body: String          # main 함수 본문
   291→
   292→function convert_program(prog: Program): String =
   293→  # 전체 FV 2.0 프로그램 생성
   294→
   295→  let output = ""
   296→
   297→  # 헤더 및 임포트
   298→  output = output + "// FV-Julia Generated Code\n"
   299→  output = output + "// Converted from FreeJulia\n\n"
   300→
   301→  for import_str in prog.imports do
   302→    output = output + "import " + import_str + "\n"
   303→  end
   304→
   305→  if prog.imports.length() > 0 then
   306→    output = output + "\n"
   307→  end
   308→
   309→  # 구조체 정의
   310→  for struct_def in prog.structs do
   311→    output = output + struct_def + "\n\n"
   312→  end
   313→
   314→  # 함수 정의
   315→  for func_def in prog.functions do
   316→    output = output + func_def + "\n\n"
   317→  end
   318→
   319→  # Main 함수
   320→  output = output + "fn main() void {\n"
   321→  output = output + "  " + prog.main_body + "\n"
   322→  output = output + "}\n"
   323→
   324→  output

   330→function convert_while_loop(condition: String, body: String): String =

1→# ==========================================
     2→# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
     3→# ==========================================
     4→# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
     5→# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
     6→# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
     7→# ==========================================
     8→
     9→record CompilerConfig =
    10→  input_file: String
    11→  output_file: String
    12→  optimize: Bool
    13→  debug: Bool
    14→
    15→record CompileResult =
    16→  success: Bool
    17→  output: String
    18→  error_msg: String
    19→  warnings: Array[String]
    20→
    21→# ==========================================
    22→# 메인 컴파일 함수
    23→# ==========================================
    24→
    25→function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
    26→  # 파일 읽기
    27→  match read_file(input_file) {
    28→    Ok(source) -> (
    29→      # 컴파일 수행
    30→      match compile_source(source) {
    31→        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
    32→        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
    33→      }
    34→    ),
    35→    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
    36→  }
    37→
    38→function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
    39→  # 1. Lexer
    40→  let tokens = tokenize(source)
    41→
    42→  # 2. Parser
    43→  match parse(tokens) {
    44→    Ok(ast) -> (
    45→      # 3. Type Checker
    46→      match type_check(ast) {
    47→        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
    48→          # 4. Code Generator
    49→          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
    50→          Ok(code)
    51→        ),
    52→        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
    53→      }
    54→    ),
    55→    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
    56→  }
    57→
    58→# ==========================================
    59→# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
    60→# ==========================================
    61→
    62→record Token =
    63→  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
    64→  value: String
    65→  line: Int
    66→  col: Int
    67→
    68→function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
    69→  let tokens = []
    70→  let line = 1
    71→  let col = 1
    72→  let i = 0
    73→
    74→  while i < source.length() do
    75→    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)
    76→
    77→    # 공백/개행
    78→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
    79→      col = col + 1
    80→      i = i + 1
    81→    else if ch == "\n" then
    82→      line = line + 1
    83→      col = 1
    84→      i = i + 1
    85→
    86→    # 주석
    87→    else if ch == "#" then
    88→      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
    89→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
    90→        i = i + 1
    91→      end
    92→
    93→    # 문자열
    94→    else if ch == "\"" then
    95→      let str_start = i + 1
    96→      i = i + 1
    97→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
    98→        i = i + 1
    99→      end
   100→      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
   101→      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
   102→      i = i + 1
   103→      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2
   104→
   105→    # 숫자
   106→    else if is_digit(ch) then
   107→      let num_start = i
   108→      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
   109→        i = i + 1
   110→      end
   111→      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
   112→      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
   113→      col = col + (i - num_start)
   114→
   115→    # 식별자/키워드
   116→    else if is_alpha(ch) then
   117→      let id_start = i
   118→      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
   119→        i = i + 1
   120→      end
   121→      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
   122→      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
   123→      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
   124→      col = col + (i - id_start)
   125→
   126→    # 연산자/구두점
   127→    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
   128→      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   129→      col = col + 1
   130→      i = i + 1
   131→
   132→    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
   133→      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   134→      col = col + 1
   135→      i = i + 1
   136→
   137→    else
   138→      col = col + 1
   139→      i = i + 1
   140→    end
   141→  end
   142→
   143→  tokens
   144→
   145→function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
   146→  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
   147→  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
   148→  ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   149→
   150→function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
   151→  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")
   152→
   153→function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
   154→  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)
   155→
   156→function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
   157→  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
   158→  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
   159→  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
   160→  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
   161→  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"
   162→
   163→# ==========================================
   164→# 2. Parser (AST)
   165→# ==========================================
   166→
   167→record ASTNode =
   168→  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
   169→  name: String
   170→  params: Array[String]
   171→  body: String
   172→  value: String
   173→  children: Array[ASTNode]
   174→
   175→function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   176→  let root = ASTNode {
   177→    type: "program",
   178→    name: "main",
   179→    params: [],
   180→    body: "",
   181→    value: "",
   182→    children: []
   183→  }
   184→
   185→  let i = 0
   186→  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
   187→  let line = 1
   188→
   189→  while i < tokens.length() do
   190→    let token = tokens[i]
   191→
   192→    # 함수 정의 파싱
   193→    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
   194→      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
   195→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   196→          children.push(node)
   197→          i = next_i
   198→        ),
   199→        Err(msg) -> (
   200→          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
   201→          i = i + 1
   202→        )
   203→      }
   204→
   205→    # let 문장 파싱
   206→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
   207→      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
   208→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   209→          children.push(node)
   210→          i = next_i
   211→        ),
   212→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   213→      }
   214→
   215→    # const 문장 파싱
   216→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
   217→      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
   218→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   219→          children.push(node)
   220→          i = next_i
   221→        ),
   222→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   223→      }
   224→
   225→    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
   226→    else
   227→      i = i + 1
   228→    end
   229→  end
   230→
   231→  root.children = children
   232→  Ok(root)
   233→
   234→# ==========================================
   235→# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
   236→# ==========================================
   237→
   238→function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   239→  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
   240→  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음
   241→
   242→  # 함수명
   243→  if i >= tokens.length() then
   244→    Err("Expected function name")
   245→  else
   246→    let name_token = tokens[i]
   247→    let func_name = name_token.value
   248→    i = i + 1
   249→
   250→    # 파라미터 목록
   251→    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
   252→      Err("Expected (")
   253→    else
   254→      i = i + 1
   255→      let params = Array[String]()
   256→
   257→      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
   258→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
   259→        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   260→          let param_name = tokens[i].value
   261→          i = i + 1
   262→
   263→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   264→            i = i + 1
   265→            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   266→              let param_type = tokens[i].value
   267→              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
   268→              i = i + 1
   269→            end
   270→          end
   271→        end
   272→
   273→        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
   274→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
   275→          i = i + 1
   276→        end
   277→      end
   278→
   279→      if i >= tokens.length() then
   280→        Err("Expected )")
   281→      else
   282→        i = i + 1
   283→
   284→        # 반환 타입
   285→        let return_type = "Void"
   286→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   287→          i = i + 1
   288→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   289→            return_type = tokens[i].value
   290→            i = i + 1
   291→          end
   292→        end
   293→
   294→        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
   295→        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
   296→          Err("Expected =")
   297→        else
   298→          i = i + 1
   299→          let body = ""
   300→
   301→          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
   302→          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   303→            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
   304→            i = i + 1
   305→          end
   306→
   307→          let node = ASTNode {
   308→            type: "function",
   309→            name: func_name,
   310→            params: params,
   311→            body: body,
   312→            value: return_type,
   313→            children: []
   314→          }
   315→
   316→          Ok((node, i))
   317→        end
   318→      end
   319→    end
   320→  end
   321→
   322→# ==========================================
   323→# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
   324→# ==========================================
   325→
   326→function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   327→  # let name: Type = value
   328→  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음
   329→
   330→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   331→    Err("Expected variable name")
   332→  else
   333→    let var_name = tokens[i].value
   334→    i = i + 1
   335→
   336→    let var_type = "Unknown"
   337→    let var_value = ""
   338→
   339→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   340→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   343→        var_type = tokens[i].value
   344→        i = i + 1
   345→      end
   346→    end
   347→
   348→    # 할당
   349→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   350→      i = i + 1
   351→
   352→      # 값 수집
   353→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   354→        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   355→        i = i + 1
   356→      end
   357→
   358→      let node = ASTNode {
   359→        type: "let",
   360→        name: var_name,
   361→        params: [],
   362→        body: var_value,
   363→        value: var_type,
   364→        children: []
   365→      }
   366→
   367→      Ok((node, i))
   368→    else
   369→      Err("Expected =")
   370→    end
   371→  end
   372→
   373→# ==========================================
   374→# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
   375→# ==========================================
   376→
   377→function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   378→  # const name: Type = value
   379→  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음
   380→
   381→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   382→    Err("Expected constant name")
   383→  else
   384→    let const_name = tokens[i].value
   385→    i = i + 1
   386→
   387→    let const_type = "Unknown"
   388→    let const_value = ""
   389→
   390→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   391→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   392→      i = i + 1
   393→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   394→        const_type = tokens[i].value
   395→        i = i + 1
   396→      end
   397→    end
   398→
   399→    # 할당
   400→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   401→      i = i + 1
   402→
   403→      # 값 수집
   404→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   405→        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   406→        i = i + 1
   407→      end
   408→
   409→      let node = ASTNode {
   410→        type: "const",
   411→        name: const_name,
   412→        params: [],
   413→        body: const_value,
   414→        value: const_type,
   415→        children: []
   416→      }
   417→
   418→      Ok((node, i))
   419→    else
   420→      Err("Expected =")
   421→    end
   422→  end
