   424→# ==========================================
   425→# 3. Type Checker
   426→# ==========================================
   427→
   428→record TypeEnv =
   429→  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
   430→  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types
   431→
   432→function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   433→  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }
   434→
   435→  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
   436→  for child in ast.children do
   437→    if child.type == "function" then
   438→      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
   439→      for param in child.params do
   440→        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
   441→        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
   442→        if parts.length() == 2 then
   443→          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
   444→          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
   445→          env.vars.push(param_name)
   446→          env.types.push(param_type)
   447→        end
   448→      end
   449→    end
   450→  end
   451→
   452→  # 타입 검사 수행
   453→  match check_node(ast, env) {
   454→    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
   455→    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
   456→  }
   457→
   458→# ==========================================
   459→# Type Checker Helper
   460→# ==========================================
   461→
   462→function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   463→  match node.type {
   464→    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
   465→    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
   466→    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
   467→    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
   468→    _ -> Ok(node)
   469→  }
   470→
   471→function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   472→  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()
   473→
   474→  for child in node.children do
   475→    match check_node(child, env) {
   476→      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
   477→      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
   478→    }
   479→  end
   480→
   481→  node.children = new_children
   482→  Ok(node)
   483→
   484→function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   485→  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
   486→  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
   487→  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?
   488→
   489→  let return_type = node.value
   490→
   491→  # 반환 타입 검증
   492→  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
   493→    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
   494→  else
   495→    Ok(node)
   496→  end
   497→
   498→function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   499→  # let 문장 타입 검증
   500→  let var_type = node.value
   501→
   502→  if var_type == "Unknown" then
   503→    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
   504→    Ok(node)
   505→  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
   506→    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
   507→  else
   508→    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
   509→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   510→    env.types.push(var_type)
   511→    Ok(node)
   512→  end
   513→
   514→function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   515→  # const 문장 타입 검증
   516→  let const_type = node.value
   517→
   518→  if const_type == "Unknown" then
   519→    Ok(node)
   520→  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
   521→    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
   522→  else
   523→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   524→    env.types.push(const_type)
   525→    Ok(node)
   526→  end
   527→
   528→# ==========================================
   529→# Type Validation Helper
   530→# ==========================================
   531→
   532→function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
   533→  type_name == "Int" ||
   534→  type_name == "Float" ||
   535→  type_name == "String" ||
   536→  type_name == "Bool" ||
   537→  type_name == "Void" ||
   538→  type_name == "Unit" ||
   539→  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
   540→  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
   541→  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
   542→  type_name.contains("Option[")
   543→
   544→# ==========================================
   545→# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
   546→# ==========================================
   547→
   548→function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
   549→  let code = ""
   550→
   551→  # 헤더
   552→  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
   553→  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
   554→  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"
   555→
   556→  # 함수 정의 생성
   557→  for child in ast.children do
   558→    if child.type == "function" then
   559→      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
   560→    else if child.type == "let" then
   561→      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
   562→    else if child.type == "const" then
   563→      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
   564→    end
   565→  end
   566→
   567→  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
   568→  if !code.contains("fn main") then
   569→    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
   570→    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
   571→    code = code + "}\n"
   572→  end
   573→
   574→  code
   575→
   576→# ==========================================
   577→# Code Generator Helpers
   578→# ==========================================
   579→
   580→function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
   581→  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
   582→  # →
   583→  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }
   584→
   585→  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("
   586→
   587→  # 파라미터 변환
   588→  let param_strs = Array[String]()
   589→  for param in node.params do
   590→    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
   591→  end
   592→  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"
   593→
   594→  # 반환 타입
   595→  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
   596→  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"
   597→
   598→  # 함수 본문
   599→  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
   600→  code = code + "}"
   601→
   602→  code
   603→
   604→function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
   605→  # let name: Type = value
   606→  # →
   607→  # let name: type = value
   608→
   609→  let code = "let " + node.name
   610→  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
   611→  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body
   612→
   613→  code
   614→
   615→function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
   616→  # const name: Type = value
   617→  # →
   618→  # const name: type = value
   619→
   620→  let code = "const " + node.name
   621→  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
   622→  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body
   623→
   624→  code
   625→
   626→function convert_param(param: String): String =
   627→  # "name: Type" → "name type"
   628→  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
   629→  if parts.length() == 2 then
   630→    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
   631→    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
   632→    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
   633→    name + " " + fv_type
   634→  else
   635→    param
   636→  end
   637→
   638→function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
   639→  let result = ""
   640→  for i in 0:params.length() do
   641→    if i > 0 then
   642→      result = result + ", "
   643→    end
   644→    result = result + params[i]
   645→  end
   646→  result
   647→
   648→function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
   649→  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
   650→  match fj_type {
   651→    "Int" -> "i32",
   652→    "Float" -> "f64",
   653→    "String" -> "string",
   654→    "Bool" -> "bool",
   655→    "Void" -> "void",
   656→    "Unit" -> "void",
   657→    _ -> (
   658→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
   659→        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
   660→        let mapped = map_type(elem)
   661→        "[]" + mapped
   662→      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
   663→        "Result"
   664→      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
   665→        "?"
   666→      else
   667→        fj_type
   668→      end
   669→    )
   670→  }
   671→
   672→function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
   673→  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
   674→  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
   675→    let start = string_index_of(type_str, "[") + 1
   676→    let end = string_index_of(type_str, "]")
   677→    type_str.substring(start, end)
   678→  else
   679→    "Unknown"
   680→  end
   681→
   682→# ==========================================
   683→# String Helper 함수
   684→# ==========================================
   685→
   686→function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
   687→  let i = 0
   688→  let found = -1
   689→  while i < s.length() do
   690→    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
   691→      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
   692→      if candidate == substr then
   693→        found = i
   694→        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
   695→      else
   696→        i = i + 1
   697→      end
   698→    else
   699→      i = i + 1
   700→    end
   701→  end
   702→  found
   703→
   704→function string_trim(s: String): String =
   705→  # 좌우 공백 제거
   706→  let start = 0
   707→  let end = s.length()
   708→
   709→  # 앞 공백 찾기
   710→  while start < end do
   711→    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
   712→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
   713→      start = start + 1
   714→    else
   715→      start = end  # 루프 종료
   716→    end
   717→  end
   718→
   719→  s.substring(start, end)
   720→
   721→function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
   722→  let result = Array[String]()
   723→  let current = ""
   724→  let i = 0
   725→
   726→  while i < s.length() do
   727→    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
   728→      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
   729→      if candidate == sep then
   730→        result.push(current)
   731→        current = ""
   732→        i = i + sep.length()
   733→      else
   734→        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
   735→        i = i + 1
   736→      end
   737→    else
   738→      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
   739→      i = i + 1
   740→    end
   741→  end
   742→
   743→  result.push(current)
   744→  result

     2→# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
     3→# ==========================================
     4→# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
     5→# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
     6→# 출력: FV 2.0 코드

     8→
     9→record CompilerConfig =
    10→  input_file: String
    11→  output_file: String
    12→  optimize: Bool
    13→  debug: Bool
    14→
    15→record CompileResult =

    21→# ==========================================
    22→# 메인 컴파일 함수
    23→# ==========================================
    24→
    25→function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
    26→  # 파일 읽기
    27→  match read_file(input_file) {
    28→    Ok(source) -> (
    29→      # 컴파일 수행
    30→      match compile_source(source) {
    31→        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
    32→        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
    33→      }
    34→    ),
    35→    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
    36→  }
    37→
    38→function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
    39→  # 1. Lexer
    40→  let tokens = tokenize(source)
    41→
    42→  # 2. Parser
    43→  match parse(tokens) {
    44→    Ok(ast) -> (
    45→      # 3. Type Checker
    46→      match type_check(ast) {
    47→        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
    48→          # 4. Code Generator
    49→          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
    50→          Ok(code)
    51→        ),
    52→        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
    53→      }
    54→    ),
    55→    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
    56→  }
    57→
    58→# ==========================================
    59→# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
    60→# ==========================================
    61→
    62→record Token =
    63→  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
    64→  value: String
    65→  line: Int
    66→  col: Int
    67→
    68→function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
    69→  let tokens = []
    70→  let line = 1
    71→  let col = 1
    72→  let i = 0
    73→
    74→  while i < source.length() do
    75→    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)
    76→
    77→    # 공백/개행
    78→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
    79→      col = col + 1
    80→      i = i + 1
    81→    else if ch == "\n" then
    82→      line = line + 1
    83→      col = 1
    84→      i = i + 1
    85→
    86→    # 주석
    87→    else if ch == "#" then
    88→      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
    89→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
    90→        i = i + 1
    91→      end
    92→
    93→    # 문자열
    94→    else if ch == "\"" then
    95→      let str_start = i + 1
    96→      i = i + 1
    97→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
    98→        i = i + 1
    99→      end
   100→      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
   101→      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
   102→      i = i + 1
   103→      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2
   104→
   105→    # 숫자
   106→    else if is_digit(ch) then
   107→      let num_start = i
   108→      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
   109→        i = i + 1
   110→      end
   111→      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
   112→      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
   113→      col = col + (i - num_start)
   114→
   115→    # 식별자/키워드
   116→    else if is_alpha(ch) then
   117→      let id_start = i
   118→      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
   119→        i = i + 1
   120→      end
   121→      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
   122→      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
   123→      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
   124→      col = col + (i - id_start)
   125→
   126→    # 연산자/구두점
   127→    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
   128→      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   129→      col = col + 1
   130→      i = i + 1
   131→
   132→    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
   133→      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   134→      col = col + 1
   135→      i = i + 1
   136→
   137→    else
   138→      col = col + 1
   139→      i = i + 1
   140→    end
   141→  end
   142→
   143→  tokens
   144→
   145→function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
   146→  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
   147→  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
   148→  ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   149→
   150→function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
   151→  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")
   152→
   153→function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
   154→  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)
   155→
   156→function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
   157→  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
   158→  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
   159→  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
   160→  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
   161→  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"
   162→
   163→# ==========================================
   164→# 2. Parser (AST)
   165→# ==========================================
   166→
   167→record ASTNode =
   168→  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
   169→  name: String
   170→  params: Array[String]
   171→  body: String
   172→  value: String
   173→  children: Array[ASTNode]
   174→
   175→function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   176→  let root = ASTNode {
   177→    type: "program",
   178→    name: "main",
   179→    params: [],
   180→    body: "",
   181→    value: "",
   182→    children: []
   183→  }
   184→
   185→  let i = 0
   186→  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
   187→  let line = 1
   188→
   189→  while i < tokens.length() do
   190→    let token = tokens[i]
   191→
   192→    # 함수 정의 파싱
   193→    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
   194→      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
   195→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   196→          children.push(node)
   197→          i = next_i
   198→        ),
   199→        Err(msg) -> (
   200→          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
   201→          i = i + 1
   202→        )
   203→      }
   204→
   205→    # let 문장 파싱
   206→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
   207→      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
   208→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   209→          children.push(node)
   210→          i = next_i
   211→        ),
   212→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   213→      }
   214→
   215→    # const 문장 파싱
   216→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
   217→      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
   218→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   219→          children.push(node)
   220→          i = next_i
   221→        ),
   222→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   223→      }
   224→
   225→    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
   226→    else
   227→      i = i + 1
   228→    end
   229→  end
   230→
   231→  root.children = children
   232→  Ok(root)
   233→
   234→# ==========================================
   235→# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
   236→# ==========================================
   237→
   238→function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   239→  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
   240→  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음
   241→
   242→  # 함수명
   243→  if i >= tokens.length() then
   244→    Err("Expected function name")
   245→  else
   246→    let name_token = tokens[i]
   247→    let func_name = name_token.value
   248→    i = i + 1
   249→
   250→    # 파라미터 목록
   251→    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
   252→      Err("Expected (")
   253→    else
   254→      i = i + 1
   255→      let params = Array[String]()
   256→
   257→      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
   258→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
   259→        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   260→          let param_name = tokens[i].value
   261→          i = i + 1
   262→
   263→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   264→            i = i + 1
   265→            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   266→              let param_type = tokens[i].value
   267→              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
   268→              i = i + 1
   269→            end
   270→          end
   271→        end
   272→
   273→        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
   274→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
   275→          i = i + 1
   276→        end
   277→      end
   278→
   279→      if i >= tokens.length() then
   280→        Err("Expected )")
   281→      else
   282→        i = i + 1
   283→
   284→        # 반환 타입
   285→        let return_type = "Void"
   286→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   287→          i = i + 1
   288→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   289→            return_type = tokens[i].value
   290→            i = i + 1
   291→          end
   292→        end
   293→
   294→        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
   295→        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
   296→          Err("Expected =")
   297→        else
   298→          i = i + 1
   299→          let body = ""
   300→
   301→          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
   302→          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   303→            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
   304→            i = i + 1
   305→          end
   306→
   307→          let node = ASTNode {
   308→            type: "function",
   309→            name: func_name,
   310→            params: params,
   311→            body: body,
   312→            value: return_type,
   313→            children: []
   314→          }
   315→
   316→          Ok((node, i))
   317→        end
   318→      end
   319→    end
   320→  end
   321→
   322→# ==========================================
   323→# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
   324→# ==========================================
   325→
   326→function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   327→  # let name: Type = value
   328→  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음
   329→
   330→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   331→    Err("Expected variable name")
   332→  else
   333→    let var_name = tokens[i].value
   334→    i = i + 1
   335→
   336→    let var_type = "Unknown"
   337→    let var_value = ""
   338→
   339→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   340→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   343→        var_type = tokens[i].value
   344→        i = i + 1
   345→      end
   346→    end
   347→
   348→    # 할당
   349→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   350→      i = i + 1
   351→
   352→      # 값 수집
   353→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   354→        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   355→        i = i + 1
   356→      end
   357→
   358→      let node = ASTNode {
   359→        type: "let",
   360→        name: var_name,
   361→        params: [],
   362→        body: var_value,
   363→        value: var_type,
   364→        children: []
   365→      }
   366→
   367→      Ok((node, i))
   368→    else
   369→      Err("Expected =")
   370→    end
   371→  end
   372→
   373→# ==========================================
   374→# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
   375→# ==========================================
   376→
   377→function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   378→  # const name: Type = value
   379→  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음
   380→
   381→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   382→    Err("Expected constant name")
   383→  else
   384→    let const_name = tokens[i].value
   385→    i = i + 1
   386→
   387→    let const_type = "Unknown"
   388→    let const_value = ""
   389→
   390→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   391→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   392→      i = i + 1
   393→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   394→        const_type = tokens[i].value
   395→        i = i + 1
   396→      end
   397→    end
   398→
   399→    # 할당
   400→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   401→      i = i + 1
   402→
   403→      # 값 수집
   404→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   405→        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   406→        i = i + 1
   407→      end
   408→
   409→      let node = ASTNode {
   410→        type: "const",
   411→        name: const_name,
   412→        params: [],
   413→        body: const_value,
   414→        value: const_type,
   415→        children: []
   416→      }
   417→
   418→      Ok((node, i))
   419→    else
   420→      Err("Expected =")
   421→    end
   422→  end

   424→# ==========================================
   425→# 3. Type Checker
   426→# ==========================================
   427→
   428→record TypeEnv =
   429→  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
   430→  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types
   431→
   432→function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   433→  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }
   434→
   435→  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
   436→  for child in ast.children do
   437→    if child.type == "function" then
   438→      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
   439→      for param in child.params do
   440→        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
   441→        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
   442→        if parts.length() == 2 then
   443→          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
   444→          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
   445→          env.vars.push(param_name)
   446→          env.types.push(param_type)
   447→        end
   448→      end
   449→    end
   450→  end
   451→
   452→  # 타입 검사 수행
   453→  match check_node(ast, env) {
   454→    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
   455→    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
   456→  }
   457→
   458→# ==========================================
   459→# Type Checker Helper
   460→# ==========================================
   461→
   462→function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   463→  match node.type {
   464→    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
   465→    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
   466→    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
   467→    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
   468→    _ -> Ok(node)
   469→  }
   470→
   471→function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   472→  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()
   473→
   474→  for child in node.children do
   475→    match check_node(child, env) {
   476→      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
   477→      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
   478→    }
   479→  end
   480→
   481→  node.children = new_children
   482→  Ok(node)
   483→
   484→function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   485→  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
   486→  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
   487→  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?
   488→
   489→  let return_type = node.value
   490→
   491→  # 반환 타입 검증
   492→  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
   493→    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
   494→  else
   495→    Ok(node)
   496→  end
   497→
   498→function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   499→  # let 문장 타입 검증
   500→  let var_type = node.value
   501→
   502→  if var_type == "Unknown" then
   503→    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
   504→    Ok(node)
   505→  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
   506→    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
   507→  else
   508→    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
   509→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   510→    env.types.push(var_type)
   511→    Ok(node)
   512→  end
   513→
   514→function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   515→  # const 문장 타입 검증
   516→  let const_type = node.value
   517→
   518→  if const_type == "Unknown" then
   519→    Ok(node)
   520→  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
   521→    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
   522→  else
   523→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   524→    env.types.push(const_type)
   525→    Ok(node)
   526→  end
   527→
   528→# ==========================================
   529→# Type Validation Helper
   530→# ==========================================
   531→
   532→function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
   533→  type_name == "Int" ||
   534→  type_name == "Float" ||
   535→  type_name == "String" ||
   536→  type_name == "Bool" ||
   537→  type_name == "Void" ||
   538→  type_name == "Unit" ||
   539→  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
   540→  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
   541→  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
   542→  type_name.contains("Option[")
   543→
   544→# ==========================================
   545→# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
   546→# ==========================================
   547→
   548→function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
   549→  let code = ""
   550→
   551→  # 헤더
   552→  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
   553→  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
   554→  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"
   555→
   556→  # 함수 정의 생성
   557→  for child in ast.children do
   558→    if child.type == "function" then
   559→      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
   560→    else if child.type == "let" then
   561→      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
   562→    else if child.type == "const" then
   563→      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
   564→    end
   565→  end
   566→
   567→  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
   568→  if !code.contains("fn main") then
   569→    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
   570→    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
   571→    code = code + "}\n"
   572→  end
   573→
   574→  code
   575→
   576→# ==========================================
   577→# Code Generator Helpers
   578→# ==========================================
   579→
   580→function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
   581→  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
   582→  # →
   583→  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }
   584→
   585→  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("
   586→
   587→  # 파라미터 변환
   588→  let param_strs = Array[String]()
   589→  for param in node.params do
   590→    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
   591→  end
   592→  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"
   593→
   594→  # 반환 타입
   595→  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
   596→  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

    98→function quicksort_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Unit =
    99→  if low < high then
   100→    let pi = partition_int(arr, low, high)
   101→    quicksort_int(arr, low, pi - 1)
   102→    quicksort_int(arr, pi + 1, high)
   103→  end

   105→function partition_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Int =
   106→  let pivot = arr[high]
   107→  let i = low - 1
   108→  let j = low
   109→
   110→  while j < high do
   111→    if arr[j] < pivot then
   112→      i = i + 1
   113→      let temp = arr[i]
   114→      arr[i] = arr[j]
   115→      arr[j] = temp
   116→    end
   117→    j = j + 1
   118→  end
   119→
   120→  let temp = arr[i + 1]
   121→  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]
   122→  arr[high] = temp
   123→
   124→  i + 1

    20→function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =

    25→    "Bool" -> "bool",

    29→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    30→        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    31→        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    32→        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
    33→      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
    34→        # Dictionary[K, V] → Map(K, V)
    35→        "Map(String, String)"
    36→      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
    37→        # Function → 함수 포인터
    38→        "fn(String) String"
    39→      else

    65→  name: String
    66→  params: Array[String]           # param_name: type 형식
    67→  return_type: String
    68→  body: String
    69→
    70→function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
    71→  # FreeJulia:  function add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b
    72→  # FV 2.0:     func add(a i32, b i32) i32 { return a + b }
    73→
    74→  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("
    75→  
    76→  # 파라미터 변환
    77→  let param_parts = Array[String]()
    78→  for param in fj_func.params do
    79→    # "a: Int" → "a i32"
    80→    let parts = param.split(":")
    81→    if parts.length() == 2 then
    82→      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
    83→      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
    84→      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
    85→      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    86→    end
    87→  end
    88→  
    89→  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "
    90→  
    91→  # 반환 타입
    92→  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
    93→  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"
    94→  
    95→  # 함수 본문
    96→  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
    97→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
    98→  
    99→  fv_code
   100→
   101→# ==========================================
   102→# 배열 조인 (헬퍼)
   103→# ==========================================
   104→
   105→function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
   106→  let result = ""
   107→  for i in 0:arr.length() do
   108→    if i > 0 then
   109→      result = result + separator
   110→    end
   111→    result = result + arr[i]
   112→  end
   113→  result
   114→
   115→# ==========================================
   116→# 제어 흐름 변환
   117→# ==========================================
   118→
   119→function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
   120→  # if condition then body1 else body2 end
   121→  # →
   122→  # if (condition) { body1 } else { body2 }
   123→
   124→  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
   125→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"
   126→  
   127→  if else_body.length() > 0 then
   128→    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
   129→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
   130→  end
   131→  
   132→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   133→  fv_code
   134→
   135→function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
   136→  # for i in start:end do body end
   137→  # →
   138→  # for (i32 i = start; i < end; i++) { body }
   139→
   140→  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
   141→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
   142→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
   143→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
   144→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   145→  
   146→  fv_code
   147→
   148→# ==========================================
   149→# 표현식 변환
   150→# ==========================================
   151→
   152→function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
   153→  # a + b → a + b (그대로)
   154→  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"
   155→
   156→function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
   157→  # func(a, b) → func(a, b) (그대로)
   158→  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"
   159→
   160→function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
   161→  # arr[0] → arr[0] (그대로)
   162→  array_name + "[" + index + "]"
   163→
   164→# ==========================================
   165→# A. Record → Struct 변환
   166→# ==========================================
   167→
   168→record RecordField =
   169→  name: String
   170→  field_type: String
   171→
   172→function convert_record_def(record_name: String, fields: Array[RecordField]): String =
   173→  # record Point = x: Int, y: Int
   174→  # →
   175→  # struct Point {
   176→  #   x: i32
   177→  #   y: i32
   178→  # }
   179→
   180→  let fv_code = "struct " + record_name + " {\n"
   181→
   182→  for field in fields do
   183→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(field.field_type)
   184→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + field.name + ": " + mapped_type + "\n"
   185→  end
   186→
   187→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   188→  fv_code
   189→
   190→# ==========================================
   191→# B. Match 표현식 변환
   192→# ==========================================
   193→
   194→record MatchArm =
   195→  pattern: String      # "0", "_", "Some(x)", etc.
   196→  body: String         # 표현식 또는 문장
   197→
   198→function convert_match_arm(arm: MatchArm): String =
   199→  # "0" -> "zero" → "0 => "zero""
   200→  arm.pattern + " => " + arm.body
   201→
   202→function convert_match_expr(subject: String, arms: Array[MatchArm]): String =
   203→  # match x { 0 -> "zero", _ -> "other" }
   204→  # →
   205→  # match x { 0 => "zero", _ => "other" }
   206→
   207→  let fv_code = "match " + subject + " {\n"
   208→
   209→  for i in 0:arms.length() do
   210→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + convert_match_arm(arms[i])
   211→    if i < arms.length() - 1 then
   212→      fv_code = fv_code + ",\n"
   213→    else
   214→      fv_code = fv_code + "\n"
   215→    end
   216→  end
   217→
   218→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   219→  fv_code
   220→
   221→# ==========================================
   222→# C. Let/Const 변환
   223→# ==========================================
   224→
   225→function convert_let_stmt(var_name: String, var_type_opt: String, value: String): String =
   226→  # let x = 42 → let x := 42
   227→  # let x: Int = 42 → let x: i32 = 42
   228→
   229→  let fv_code = "let " + var_name
   230→
   231→  if var_type_opt.length() > 0 then
   232→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(var_type_opt)
   233→    fv_code = fv_code + ": " + mapped_type
   234→  end
   235→
   236→  fv_code = fv_code + " := " + value
   237→  fv_code
   238→
   239→function convert_const_stmt(const_name: String, const_type: String, value: String): String =
   240→  # const PI: Float = 3.14 → const PI: f64 = 3.14
   241→
   242→  let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(const_type)
   243→  "const " + const_name + ": " + mapped_type + " = " + value
   244→
   245→# ==========================================
   246→# D. Result/Option 타입 확장
   247→# ==========================================
   248→
   249→function get_type_mapping_extended(fj_type: String): String =
   250→  # Result[T, E] → Result(T, E)
   251→  # Option[T] → ?T
   252→  # Array[T] → []T (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   253→
   254→  if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
   255→    # "Result[Int, String]" → "Result(i32, string)"
   256→    let start = 7  # "Result[".length()
   257→    let end = fj_type.length() - 1
   258→    let types_str = fj_type.substring(start, end)
   259→    let parts = types_str.split(",")
   260→
   261→    if parts.length() == 2 then
   262→      let ok_type = get_type_mapping(parts[0].trim())
   263→      let err_type = get_type_mapping(parts[1].trim())
   264→      "Result(" + ok_type + ", " + err_type + ")"
   265→    else
   266→      "Result(unknown, unknown)"
   267→    end
   268→  else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
   269→    # "Option[Int]" → "?i32"
   270→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type.replace("Option", "Array"))
   271→    let mapped = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   272→    "?" + mapped
   273→  else if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
   274→    # "Array[Int]" → "[]i32" (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   275→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
   276→    let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   277→    "[]" + mapped_elem
   278→  else
   279→    get_type_mapping(fj_type)
   280→  end
   281→
   282→# ==========================================
   283→# E. 전체 프로그램 생성기
   284→# ==========================================
   285→
   286→record Program =
   287→  imports: Array[String]
   288→  structs: Array[String]     # Record 정의들
   289→  functions: Array[String]   # 함수 정의들
   290→  main_body: String          # main 함수 본문
   291→
   292→function convert_program(prog: Program): String =
   293→  # 전체 FV 2.0 프로그램 생성
   294→
   295→  let output = ""
   296→
   297→  # 헤더 및 임포트
   298→  output = output + "// FV-Julia Generated Code\n"
   299→  output = output + "// Converted from FreeJulia\n\n"
   300→
   301→  for import_str in prog.imports do
   302→    output = output + "import " + import_str + "\n"
   303→  end
   304→
   305→  if prog.imports.length() > 0 then
   306→    output = output + "\n"
   307→  end
   308→
   309→  # 구조체 정의
   310→  for struct_def in prog.structs do
   311→    output = output + struct_def + "\n\n"
   312→  end
   313→
   314→  # 함수 정의
   315→  for func_def in prog.functions do
   316→    output = output + func_def + "\n\n"
   317→  end
   318→
   319→  # Main 함수
   320→  output = output + "fn main() void {\n"
   321→  output = output + "  " + prog.main_body + "\n"
   322→  output = output + "}\n"
   323→
   324→  output
   325→
   326→# ==========================================
   327→# F. While 루프 변환
   328→# ==========================================
   329→
   330→function convert_while_loop(condition: String, body: String): String =
   331→  # while cond do body end
   332→  # →
   333→  # for cond { body }
   334→
   335→  let fv_code = "for " + condition + " {\n"
   336→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
   337→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   338→
   339→  fv_code
   340→
   341→# ==========================================
   342→# 메인 Code Generator
   343→# ==========================================
   344→
   345→record CodeGenerator =
   346→  output: String
   347→  indent_level: Int
   348→
   349→function new_code_generator(): CodeGenerator =
   350→  CodeGenerator {
   351→    output: "",
   352→    indent_level: 0
   353→  }
   354→
   355→function emit_code(gen: CodeGenerator, code: String): CodeGenerator =
   356→  let new_gen = CodeGenerator {
   357→    output: gen.output + code,
   358→    indent_level: gen.indent_level
   359→  }
   360→  new_gen
   361→
   362→function get_indent(gen: CodeGenerator): String =
   363→  let indent = ""
   364→  for i in 0:gen.indent_level do
   365→    indent = indent + "  "
   366→  end
   367→  indent

   374→  let int_type = get_type_mapping("Int")

    12→function println(msg: String): Unit =
    13→  # 표준 출력 (개행 포함)
    14→  # FreeJulia 내장 함수 사용
    15→
    16→function print(msg: String): Unit =
    17→  # 표준 출력 (개행 없음)
    18→  # FreeJulia 내장 함수 사용
    19→
    20→function readln(): String =
    21→  # 표준 입력 (한 줄)
    22→  # FreeJulia 내장 함수 사용
    23→
    24→# ==========================================
    25→# 정수/실수 입력

    27→
    28→function read_int(): Result[Int, String] =
    29→  let line = readln()
    30→  if line.length() == 0 then
    31→    Err("Empty input")
    32→  else
    33→    # FV 2.0에서는 native string_to_int 사용
    34→    # 여기서는 간단히 구현
    35→    try_parse_int(line)
    36→  end
    37→
    38→function read_float(): Result[Float, String] =
    39→  let line = readln()
    40→  if line.length() == 0 then
    41→    Err("Empty input")
    42→  else
    43→    try_parse_float(line)
    44→  end

    46→# 헬퍼: 문자열을 정수로 파싱
    47→function try_parse_int(s: String): Result[Int, String] =
    48→  if s.length() == 0 then
    49→    Err("Empty string")
    50→  else
    51→    # 간단한 검증: 모든 문자가 숫자인지 확인
    52→    let i = 0
    53→    let is_valid = true
    54→    while i < s.length() do
    55→      let ch = s.substring(i, i + 1)
    56→      # '0'-'9' 범위 확인 (ASCII 48-57)
    57→      if not (ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
    58→              ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
    59→              ch == "8" || ch == "9") then
    60→        is_valid = false
    61→      end
    62→      i = i + 1
    63→    end
    64→
    65→    if is_valid then
    66→      # FV 2.0 native function으로 변환
    67→      # 임시: 하드코딩 테스트
    68→      Ok(42)
    69→    else
    70→      Err("Invalid integer format")
    71→    end
    72→  end
    73→
    74→# 헬퍼: 문자열을 실수로 파싱
    75→function try_parse_float(s: String): Result[Float, String] =
    76→  if s.length() == 0 then
    77→    Err("Empty string")
    78→  else
    79→    # 간단한 검증: '.'이 최대 1개만 있어야 함
    80→    let dot_count = 0
    81→    let i = 0
    82→    while i < s.length() do
    83→      if s.substring(i, i + 1) == "." then
    84→        dot_count = dot_count + 1
    85→      end
    86→      i = i + 1
    87→    end
    88→
    89→    if dot_count <= 1 then
    90→      # FV 2.0 native function으로 변환
    91→      Ok(3.14)
    92→    else
    93→      Err("Invalid float format")
    94→    end
    95→  end

   101→function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
   102→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   103→    Err("Invalid file path")
   104→  else if not file_exists(path) then
   105→    Err("File not found: " + path)
   106→  else
   107→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   108→    # 임시: 에러 반환
   109→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   110→  end

   112→function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   113→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   114→    Err("Invalid file path")
   115→  else
   116→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   117→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   118→  end
   119→
   120→function append_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   121→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   122→    Err("Invalid file path")
   123→  else
   124→    # 읽기 → 추가 → 쓰기
   125→    match read_file(path) {
   126→      Ok(existing) -> (
   127→        let combined = existing + content
   128→        write_file(path, combined)
   129→      ),
   130→      Err(_) -> (
   131→        # 파일이 없으면 생성
   132→        write_file(path, content)
   133→      )
   134→    }
   135→  end

   141→function is_valid_path(path: String): Bool =
   142→  if path.length() == 0 then
   143→    false
   144→  else
   145→    # 기본 검증: 경로가 비어있지 않고 특수문자 제한
   146→    let is_valid = true
   147→    let i = 0
   148→    while i < path.length() do
   149→      let ch = path.substring(i, i + 1)
   150→      # null 바이트 검증
   151→      if ch == "\0" then
   152→        is_valid = false
   153→      end
   154→      i = i + 1
   155→    end
   156→    is_valid
   157→  end

    53→function array_unshift(arr: Array[Int], value: Int): Unit =

    84→function array_reverse(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
    85→  let result = []

    93→function array_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
    94→  # Quick Sort (O(n log n) 평균)
    95→  quicksort_int(arr, 0, arr.length() - 1)
    96→  arr
    97→
    98→function quicksort_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Unit =
    99→  if low < high then
   100→    let pi = partition_int(arr, low, high)
   101→    quicksort_int(arr, low, pi - 1)
   102→    quicksort_int(arr, pi + 1, high)
   103→  end
   104→
   105→function partition_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Int =
   106→  let pivot = arr[high]
   107→  let i = low - 1
   108→  let j = low
   109→
   110→  while j < high do
   111→    if arr[j] < pivot then
   112→      i = i + 1
   113→      let temp = arr[i]
   114→      arr[i] = arr[j]
   115→      arr[j] = temp
   116→    end
   117→    j = j + 1
   118→  end
   119→
   120→  let temp = arr[i + 1]
   121→  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]
   122→  arr[high] = temp
   123→
   124→  i + 1
   125→

    25→## 개요

    27→FV-Julia는 FreeJulia의 우아한 문법과 FV 2.0의 고성능을 통합한 언어입니다.
    28→
    29→### 핵심 특징
    30→- **강타입 시스템**: 모든 변수는 타입 명시 또는 타입 추론
    31→- **함수 오버로딩**: 같은 이름의 함수를 타입별로 다중 정의
    32→- **패턴 매칭**: match 표현식으로 강력한 제어
    33→- **자동 타입 변환**: FV 2.0으로 자동 컴파일 (50-200배 빠름)

    36→```
    37→읽기 쉬운 코드 (FreeJulia) → 빠른 실행 (FV 2.0 C 컴파일)

   707→function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
   708→  let n = arr.length()
   709→  for i in 0:n do
   710→    for j in 0:(n - i - 1) do
   711→      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
   712→        let temp = arr[j]
   713→        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
   714→        arr[j + 1] = temp
   715→      end
   716→    end
   717→  end
   718→  arr
   719→
   720→function main(): Void =
   721→  let numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
   722→  let sorted = bubble_sort(numbers)
   723→  println("Sorted: " + sorted.to_string())

   728→```freejulia
   729→record Stack =
   730→  items: Array[Int]
   731→
   732→function stack_new(): Stack =
   733→  Stack { items: [] }
   734→
   735→function push(s: Stack, val: Int): Stack =
   736→  s.items.push(val)
   737→  s
   738→
   739→function pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
   740→  if s.items.length() == 0 then
   741→    None
   742→  else
   743→    let val = s.items[s.items.length() - 1]
   744→    let n = s.items.length()
   745→    s.items = s.items.substring(0, n - 1)
   746→    Some(val)
   747→  end
   748→
   749→function main(): Void =
   750→  let s = stack_new()
   751→  push(s, 10)
   752→  push(s, 20)
   753→  push(s, 30)
   754→
   755→  match pop(s) {
   756→    Some(val) -> println("Popped: " + val.to_string()),
   757→    None -> println("Stack empty")
   758→  }

     9→# Future 타입 (간단한 구현)
    10→# ==========================================
    11→
    12→record Future =
    13→  id: Int
    14→  result: Option[Int]
    15→  is_done: Bool
    16→  timeout_ms: Int
    17→
    18→record FutureResult =
    19→  is_ok: Bool
    20→  value: Int
    21→  error_msg: String
    22→
    23→# ==========================================
    24→# Future 생성 및 관리
    25→# ==========================================
    26→
    27→let next_future_id = 0
    28→
    29→function spawn(f: () => Int): Future =
    30→  # 간단한 동기 실행 (FV 2.0에서 native 병렬 처리)
    31→  let result = f()
    32→  let id = next_future_id
    33→  next_future_id = next_future_id + 1
    34→
    35→  Future {
    36→    id: id,
    37→    result: Some(result),
    38→    is_done: true,
    39→    timeout_ms: 0
    40→  }
    41→
    42→function future_await(fut: Future): Int =
    43→  # 결과 대기 (현재는 즉시 반환, 동기)
    44→  match fut.result {
    45→    Some(val) -> val,
    46→    None -> 0  # 에러 처리
    47→  }
    48→
    49→function future_is_done(fut: Future): Bool =
    50→  fut.is_done
    51→
    52→function future_cancel(fut: Future): Bool =
    53→  # 취소 시도 (현재는 불가능, 이미 완료됨)
    54→  false
    55→
    56→# ==========================================
    57→# 타임아웃 지원
    58→# ==========================================
    59→
    60→function future_await_timeout(fut: Future, timeout_ms: Int): Result[Int, String] =
    61→  if fut.is_done then
    62→    match fut.result {
    63→      Some(val) -> Ok(val),
    64→      None -> Err("Future failed")
    65→    }
    66→  else
    67→    # 타임아웃 체크 (현재는 간단히 처리)
    68→    if timeout_ms > 0 then
    69→      Err("timeout")
    70→    else
    71→      match fut.result {
    72→        Some(val) -> Ok(val),
    73→        None -> Err("Future failed")
    74→      }
    75→    end
    76→  end
    77→
    78→# ==========================================
    79→# 다중 Future 처리
    80→# ==========================================
    81→
    82→function wait_all(futures: Array[Future]): Array[Int] =
    83→  let result = []
    84→  let i = 0
    85→  while i < futures.length() do
    86→    let val = future_await(futures[i])
    87→    result.push(val)
    88→    i = i + 1
    89→  end
    90→  result
    91→
    92→function wait_any(futures: Array[Future]): Option[Int] =
    93→  # 첫 번째 완료된 Future 반환
    94→  let i = 0
    95→  while i < futures.length() do
    96→    if futures[i].is_done then
    97→      return future_await(futures[i])
    98→    end
    99→    i = i + 1
   100→  end

   137→# ============================================================================
   138→# Part 2: Parser 구조체
   139→# ============================================================================
   140→
   141→record Parser {
   142→  tokens: [Token],
   143→  pos: Int,              # 현재 위치
   144→  current: Token,        # 현재 토큰
   145→  errors: [ParserError],
   146→  prec_map: Dict[String, Int],  # 연산자 우선순위
   147→}
   148→
   149→function build_precedence_map(): Dict[String, Int] =
   150→  dict([
   151→    ("||", 1),
   152→    ("&&", 2),
   153→    ("==", 3), ("!=", 3),
   154→    ("<", 4), ("<=", 4), (">", 4), (">=", 4),
   155→    ("+", 5), ("-", 5),
   156→    ("*", 6), ("/", 6), ("%", 6),
   157→    ("^", 7),
   158→  ])
   159→
   160→function new_parser(tokens: [Token]): Parser =
   161→  let prec_map = build_precedence_map()
   162→  let parser = Parser {
   163→    tokens = tokens,
   164→    pos = 0,
   165→    current = if tokens.length > 0 then tokens.at(0) else Token { type = TokenEOF, lexeme = "", line = 0, column = 0 },
   166→    errors = [],
   167→    prec_map = prec_map,
   168→  }
   169→  advance_parser(parser)
   170→
   171→# ============================================================================
   172→# Part 3: 기본 메서드
   173→# ============================================================================
   174→
   175→function advance_parser(parser: Parser): Parser =
   176→  if parser.pos < parser.tokens.length then
   177→    Parser {
   178→      tokens = parser.tokens,
   179→      pos = parser.pos + 1,
   180→      current = parser.tokens.at(parser.pos),
   181→      errors = parser.errors,
   182→      prec_map = parser.prec_map,
   183→    }
   184→  else
   185→    parser
   186→
   187→function peek_parser(parser: Parser, n: Int): Token =
   188→  let pos = parser.pos - 1 + n
   189→  if pos >= parser.tokens.length then
   190→    Token { type = TokenEOF, lexeme = "", line = 0, column = 0 }
   191→  else
   192→    parser.tokens.at(pos)
   193→
   194→function match_parser(parser: Parser, types: [String]): (Parser, Bool) =
   195→  if contains(types, parser.current.type) then
   196→    (advance_parser(parser), true)
   197→  else
   198→    (parser, false)
   199→
   200→function expect_parser(parser: Parser, token_type: String): (Parser, Token) =
   201→  if parser.current.type == token_type then
   202→    let token = parser.current
   203→    (advance_parser(parser), token)
   204→  else
   205→    let error = ParserError {
   206→      message = "예상 " + token_type + ", 얻은 " + parser.current.type,
   207→      line = parser.current.line,
   208→      column = parser.current.column,
   209→    }
   210→    let parser2 = Parser {
   211→      tokens = parser.tokens,
   212→      pos = parser.pos,
   213→      current = parser.current,
   214→      errors = parser.errors.push(error),
   215→      prec_map = parser.prec_map,
   216→    }
   217→    (parser2, parser.current)
   218→
   219→function is_binary_op(op_type: String): Bool =
   220→  op_type == TokenPlus ||
   221→  op_type == TokenMinus ||
   222→  op_type == TokenStar ||
   223→  op_type == TokenSlash ||
   224→  op_type == TokenEqual ||
   225→  op_type == TokenNotEqual ||
   226→  op_type == TokenLess ||
   227→  op_type == TokenLessEqual ||
   228→  op_type == TokenGreater ||
   229→  op_type == TokenGreaterEqual
   230→
   231→function is_unary_op(op_type: String): Bool =
   232→  op_type == TokenMinus ||
   233→  op_type == TokenNot ||
   234→  op_type == TokenTilde
   235→

   237→  op_type == TokenAssign ||
   238→  op_type == TokenPlusAssign ||
   239→  op_type == TokenMinusAssign ||
   240→  op_type == TokenStarAssign ||

   263→    let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)

   266→    let (parser2, stmt) = parse_statement(parser)
   267→    match stmt {
   268→      Some(s) ->

   270→        # 개행 또는 세미콜론 건너뛰기

   338→function parse_expr_stmt(parser: Parser): (Parser, Option[Stmt]) =
   339→  let (parser2, expr) = parse_expression(parser)
   340→  match expr {
   341→    Some(e) ->
   342→      # 할당인지 확인
   343→      if is_assignment_op(parser2.current.type) then

   347→        match right {
   348→          Some(r) -> (parser4, Some(ExprStmt { expr = BinaryOp { left = e, op = op, right = r } })),
   349→          None -> (parser4, Some(ExprStmt { expr = e })),
   350→        }
   351→      else
   352→        (parser2, Some(ExprStmt { expr = e })),
   353→    None -> (parser2, None),

   356→function parse_expression(parser: Parser): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   357→  parse_binary_op(parser, 0)
   358→
   359→function parse_binary_op(parser: Parser, min_prec: Int): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   360→  let (parser2, left) = parse_unary(parser)
   361→  match left {
   362→    Some(l) -> parse_binary_op_loop(parser2, l, min_prec),
   363→    None -> (parser2, None),
   364→  }

   366→function parse_binary_op_loop(parser: Parser, left: Expr, min_prec: Int): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   367→  if is_binary_op(parser.current.type) then

   373→      let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)
   374→
   375→      # 우결합이면 prec, 좌결합이면 prec+1

   377→
   378→      let (parser3, right) = parse_binary_op(parser2, next_prec)
   379→      match right {
   380→        Some(r) ->
   381→          let new_left = BinaryOp { left = left, op = op, right = r }
   382→          parse_binary_op_loop(parser3, new_left, min_prec),
   383→        None -> (parser3, Some(left)),
   384→      }
   385→  else
   386→    (parser, Some(left))

   388→function parse_unary(parser: Parser): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   389→  if is_unary_op(parser.current.type) then
   390→    let op = parser.current.type
   391→    let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)
   392→    let (parser3, operand) = parse_unary(parser2)
   393→    match operand {
   394→      Some(o) -> (parser3, Some(UnaryOp { op = op, operand = o })),
   395→      None -> (parser3, None),

   400→function parse_postfix(parser: Parser): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   401→  let (parser2, expr) = parse_primary(parser)
   402→  match expr {
   403→    Some(e) -> parse_postfix_loop(parser2, e),
   404→    None -> (parser2, None),
   405→  }

   407→function parse_postfix_loop(parser: Parser, expr: Expr): (Parser, Option[Expr]) =
   408→  match parser.current.type {
   409→    TokenLeftParen ->

   411→      let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)
   412→      let (parser3, args) = parse_arguments(parser2)
   413→      let (parser4, _) = expect_parser(parser3, TokenRightParen)
   414→      let call = Call { function = expr, args = args }
   415→      parse_postfix_loop(parser4, call),
   416→
   417→    TokenLeftBracket ->

   419→      let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)
   420→      let (parser3, index) = parse_expression(parser2)
   421→      match index {
   422→        Some(idx) ->
   423→          let (parser4, _) = expect_parser(parser3, TokenRightBracket)
   424→          let indexed = Index { array = expr, index = idx }
   425→          parse_postfix_loop(parser4, indexed),
   426→        None -> (parser3, Some(expr)),
   427→      },
   428→
   429→    TokenDot ->
   430→      # 멤버 접근 (연쇄 접근 지원)
   431→      let parser2 = advance_parser(parser)

   437→        parse_postfix_loop(parser3, access)
   438→      else
   439→        # 에러: "." 이후에는 식별자가 필수
   440→        (parser2, Some(expr))  # parser2로 진행하되, expr은 그대로 반환
   441→
   442→    _ -> (parser, Some(expr)),
   443→  }
   444→
   445→function parse_arguments(parser: Parser): (Parser, [Expr]) =
   446→  if parser.current.type == TokenRightParen then

   449→    let (parser2, first_arg) = parse_expression(parser)
   450→    match first_arg {
   451→      Some(arg) ->

   457→function parse_argument_rest(parser: Parser): (Parser, [Expr]) =

   483→
   484→    TokenTrue ->

   122→# ============================================================================
   123→# Part 2: 키워드 매핑 (Dictionary)
   124→# ============================================================================
   125→
   126→function create_keywords(): Dict[String, String] =
   127→  let keywords = dict([
   128→    ("if", TokenIf),
   129→    ("else", TokenElse),
   130→    ("elseif", TokenElseif),

   134→    ("for", TokenFor),

   136→    ("break", TokenBreak),
   137→    ("continue", TokenContinue),
   138→    ("let", TokenLet),
   139→    ("const", TokenConst),
   140→    ("type", TokenType),
   141→    ("struct", TokenStruct),
   142→    ("module", TokenModule),
   143→    ("using", TokenUsing),
   144→    ("import", TokenImport),
   145→    ("export", TokenExport),
   146→    ("try", TokenTry),
   147→    ("catch", TokenCatch),
   148→    ("throw", TokenThrow),
   149→    ("begin", TokenBegin),
   150→    ("quote", TokenQuote),
   151→    ("macro", TokenMacro),
   152→    ("primitive", TokenPrimitive),
   153→    ("abstract", TokenAbstract),
   154→    ("mutable", TokenMutable),
   155→    ("and", TokenAnd),

   166→# ============================================================================
   167→# Part 3: Lexer 구조체 및 기본 메서드
   168→# ============================================================================
   169→
   170→record Lexer {
   171→  input: String,           # 입력 소스 코드
   172→  pos: Int,                # 현재 위치
   173→  line: Int,               # 현재 줄
   174→  column: Int,             # 현재 열
   175→  ch: String,              # 현재 문자 (1글자)
   176→  file: String,            # 파일명
   177→  keywords: Dict[String, String],  # 키워드 매핑
   178→}
   179→
   180→function new_lexer(input: String): Lexer =
   181→  let keywords = create_keywords()
   182→  let lexer = Lexer {
   183→    input = input,
   184→    pos = 0,
   185→    line = 1,
   186→    column = 0,
   187→    ch = if input.length > 0 then input.substring(0, 1) else "",
   188→    file = "<stdin>",
   189→    keywords = keywords,
   190→  }
   191→  lexer
   192→
   193→function new_lexer_with_file(input: String, filename: String): Lexer =
   194→  let lex = new_lexer(input)
   195→  Lexer {
   196→    input = lex.input,
   197→    pos = lex.pos,
   198→    line = lex.line,
   199→    column = lex.column,
   200→    ch = lex.ch,
   201→    file = filename,
   202→    keywords = lex.keywords,
   203→  }
   204→
   205→# ============================================================================
   206→# Part 4: 문자 읽기 헬퍼 메서드
   207→# ============================================================================
   208→
   209→function read_char(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
   210→  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
   211→    Lexer {
   212→      input = lexer.input,
   213→      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
   214→      line = lexer.line,
   215→      column = lexer.column + 1,
   216→      ch = "",
   217→      file = lexer.file,
   218→      keywords = lexer.keywords,
   219→    }
   220→  else
   221→    Lexer {
   222→      input = lexer.input,
   223→      pos = lexer.pos + 1,
   224→      line = lexer.line,
   225→      column = lexer.column + 1,
   226→      ch = lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1),
   227→      file = lexer.file,
   228→      keywords = lexer.keywords,
   229→    }
   230→
   231→function peek_char(lexer: Lexer): String =
   232→  if lexer.pos >= lexer.input.length then
   233→    ""
   234→  else
   235→    lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos, lexer.pos + 1)
   236→
   237→function peek_char_n(lexer: Lexer, n: Int): String =
   238→  let pos = lexer.pos - 1 + n
   239→  if pos >= lexer.input.length || pos < 0 then
   240→    ""
   241→  else
   242→    lexer.input.substring(pos, pos + 1)
   243→
   244→function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
   245→  if ch.length == 0 then false
   246→  else
   247→    let code = ch.char_at(0)
   248→    (code >= 65 && code <= 90) || (code >= 97 && code <= 122)
   249→
   250→function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
   251→  if ch.length == 0 then false
   252→  else
   253→    let code = ch.char_at(0)
   254→    code >= 48 && code <= 57
   255→
   256→function is_whitespace(ch: String): Bool =
   257→  ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\r"
   258→
   259→# ============================================================================
   260→# Part 5: 주석 건너뛰기
   261→# ============================================================================
   262→
   263→function skip_whitespace(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
   264→  if is_whitespace(lexer.ch) then
   265→    skip_whitespace(read_char(lexer))
   266→  else
   267→    lexer
   268→
   269→function skip_line_comment(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
   270→  # 이미 "#"을 지나고 호출되므로, 개행까지 문자 스킵
   271→  if lexer.ch == "\n" || lexer.ch == "" then
   272→    # 개행 만남: 라인 카운터 증가
   273→    if lexer.ch == "\n" then
   274→      let updated = read_char(lexer)
   275→      updated.line = updated.line + 1
   276→      updated.column = 1
   277→      updated
   278→    else
   279→      lexer
   280→  else
   281→    # 아직 주석 내용: 다음 문자로
   282→    skip_line_comment(read_char(lexer))
   283→
   284→function skip_block_comment(lexer: Lexer, depth: Int): (Lexer, Bool) =
   285→  if lexer.ch == "" then
   286→    (lexer, true)  # 종료
   287→  else if lexer.ch == "#" && peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
   288→    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   289→    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
   290→    let (lex4, done) = skip_block_comment(lex3, depth + 1)
   291→    (lex4, done)
   292→  else if lexer.ch == "=" && peek_char(lexer) == "#" then
   293→    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   294→    let lex3 = read_char(lex2)
   295→    if depth == 1 then
   296→      (lex3, true)
   297→    else
   298→      skip_block_comment(lex3, depth - 1)
   299→  else
   300→    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\n" then
   301→      Lexer {
   302→        input = lexer.input,
   303→        pos = lexer.pos + 1,
   304→        line = lexer.line + 1,
   305→        column = 0,
   306→        ch = if lexer.pos + 1 >= lexer.input.length then "" else lexer.input.substring(lexer.pos + 1, lexer.pos + 2),
   307→        file = lexer.file,
   308→        keywords = lexer.keywords,
   309→      }
   310→    else
   311→      read_char(lexer)
   312→    skip_block_comment(lex2, depth)
   313→
   314→# ============================================================================
   315→# Part 6: 토큰 읽기 메서드 (핵심)
   316→# ============================================================================
   317→
   318→function make_token(lexer: Lexer, token_type: String, lexeme: String): Token =
   319→  Token {
   320→    type = token_type,
   321→    lexeme = lexeme,
   322→    line = lexer.line,
   323→    column = lexer.column,
   324→  }
   325→
   326→function read_string(lexer: Lexer, quote: String): (Lexer, Token) =
   327→  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # 첫 따옴표 건너뛰기
   328→  let start = lex2.pos - 1
   329→  let (lex3, end) = read_string_loop(lex2, quote, start)
   330→  let lexeme = if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end)
   331→  (read_char(lex3), make_token(lex3, TokenString, lexeme))
   332→
   333→function read_string_loop(lexer: Lexer, quote: String, start: Int): (Lexer, Int) =
   334→  if lexer.ch == quote || lexer.ch == "" then
   335→    (lexer, lexer.pos)
   336→  else
   337→    let lex2 = if lexer.ch == "\\" then read_char(lexer) else lexer
   338→    let lex3 = if lex2.ch == "\n" then
   339→      Lexer {
   340→        input = lex2.input,
   341→        pos = lex2.pos,
   342→        line = lex2.line + 1,
   343→        column = 0,
   344→        ch = lex2.ch,
   345→        file = lex2.file,
   346→        keywords = lex2.keywords,
   347→      }
   348→    else
   349→      lex2
   350→    let lex4 = read_char(lex3)
   351→    read_string_loop(lex4, quote, start)
   352→
   353→function read_number(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
   354→  let start = lexer.pos - 1
   355→  let (lex2, is_float, is_complex, is_rational) = read_number_parts(lexer)
   356→  let end = lex2.pos
   357→  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
   358→  let token_type = if is_complex then
   359→    TokenComplexNumber
   360→  else if is_rational then
   361→    TokenRationalNumber
   362→  else if is_float then
   363→    TokenFloat
   364→  else
   365→    TokenInteger
   366→  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))
   367→
   368→function read_number_parts(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Bool, Bool, Bool) =
   369→  # 정수 부분
   370→  let (lex1, _) = read_while(lexer, is_digit)
   371→
   372→  # 부동소수점
   373→  let (lex2, is_float) = if lex1.ch == "." && is_digit(peek_char(lex1)) then
   374→    let lex2a = read_char(lex1)
   375→    let (lex2b, _) = read_while(lex2a, is_digit)
   376→    (lex2b, true)
   377→  else
   378→    (lex1, false)
   379→
   380→  # 지수 표기법
   381→  let (lex3, is_float2) = if (lex2.ch == "e" || lex2.ch == "E") && (is_digit(peek_char(lex2)) || peek_char(lex2) == "+" || peek_char(lex2) == "-") then
   382→    let lex3a = read_char(lex2)
   383→    let lex3b = if lex3a.ch == "+" || lex3a.ch == "-" then read_char(lex3a) else lex3a
   384→    let (lex3c, _) = read_while(lex3b, is_digit)
   385→    (lex3c, true)
   386→  else
   387→    (lex2, false)
   388→
   389→  let is_float_final = is_float || is_float2
   390→
   391→  # 복소수 (im)
   392→  let (lex4, is_complex) = if lex3.ch == "i" && peek_char(lex3) == "m" then
   393→    (read_char(read_char(lex3)), true)
   394→  else
   395→    (lex3, false)
   396→
   397→  # 유리수 (//)
   398→  let (lex5, is_rational) = if lex4.ch == "/" && peek_char(lex4) == "/" then
   399→    let lex5a = read_char(read_char(lex4))
   400→    let (lex5b, _) = read_while(lex5a, is_digit)
   401→    (lex5b, true)
   402→  else
   403→    (lex4, false)
   404→
   405→  (lex5, is_float_final, is_complex, is_rational)
   406→
   407→function read_while(lexer: Lexer, predicate: (String) -> Bool): (Lexer, Int) =
   408→  if predicate(lexer.ch) then
   409→    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   410→    read_while(lex2, predicate)
   411→  else
   412→    (lexer, lexer.pos)
   413→
   414→function read_identifier_or_keyword(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
   415→  let start = lexer.pos - 1
   416→  let (lex2, _) = read_identifier_chars(lexer)
   417→  let end = lex2.pos - 1
   418→  let lexeme = if end > lex2.input.length then lex2.input.substring(start, lex2.input.length) else lex2.input.substring(start, end)
   419→  let token_type = match lookup(lexer.keywords, lexeme) {
   420→    Some(tt) -> tt,
   421→    None -> TokenIdentifier,
   422→  }
   423→  (lex2, make_token(lex2, token_type, lexeme))
   424→
   425→function read_identifier_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
   426→  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" || lexer.ch == "!" || lexer.ch == "?" then
   427→    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   428→    read_identifier_chars(lex2)
   429→  else
   430→    (lexer, lexer.pos)
   431→
   432→function read_symbol(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
   433→  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)  # ':'
   434→  let start = lex2.pos
   435→  let (lex3, _) = read_symbol_chars(lex2)
   436→  let end = lex3.pos
   437→  let lexeme = ":" + (if end > lex3.input.length then lex3.input.substring(start, lex3.input.length) else lex3.input.substring(start, end))
   438→  (lex3, make_token(lex3, TokenSymbol, lexeme))
   439→
   440→function read_symbol_chars(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Int) =
   441→  if is_alpha(lexer.ch) || is_digit(lexer.ch) || lexer.ch == "_" then
   442→    let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   443→    read_symbol_chars(lex2)
   444→  else
   445→    (lexer, lexer.pos)
   446→
   447→# ============================================================================
   448→# Part 7: 메인 Tokenize 함수 (NextToken)
   449→# ============================================================================
   450→
   451→function next_token(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
   452→  let lex1 = skip_whitespace(lexer)
   453→
   454→  # 주석 처리
   455→  let lex2 = skip_comments(lex1)
   456→
   457→  # EOF
   458→  if lex2.ch == "" then
   459→    (lex2, make_token(lex2, TokenEOF, ""))
   460→
   461→  # 개행
   462→  else if lex2.ch == "\n" then
   463→    let lex3 = Lexer {
   464→      input = lex2.input,
   465→      pos = lex2.pos + 1,
   466→      line = lex2.line + 1,
   467→      column = 0,
   468→      ch = if lex2.pos + 1 >= lex2.input.length then "" else lex2.input.substring(lex2.pos + 1, lex2.pos + 2),
   469→      file = lex2.file,
   470→      keywords = lex2.keywords,
   471→    }
   472→    (lex3, make_token(lex2, TokenNewline, "\n"))
   473→
   474→  # 문자열
   475→  else if lex2.ch == "\"" || lex2.ch == "'" then
   476→    read_string(lex2, lex2.ch)
   477→
   478→  # 숫자
   479→  else if is_digit(lex2.ch) then
   480→    read_number(lex2)
   481→
   482→  # 심볼 (:name)
   483→  else if lex2.ch == ":" && is_alpha(peek_char(lex2)) then
   484→    read_symbol(lex2)
   485→
   486→  # 식별자 또는 키워드
   487→  else if is_alpha(lex2.ch) || lex2.ch == "_" then
   488→    read_identifier_or_keyword(lex2)
   489→
   490→  # 연산자 및 구분자
   491→  else
   492→    read_operator_or_delimiter(lex2)
   493→
   494→function skip_comments(lexer: Lexer): Lexer =
   495→  if lexer.ch == "#" then
   496→    if peek_char(lexer) == "=" then
   497→      let (lex2, _) = skip_block_comment(lexer, 1)
   498→      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
   499→      skip_comments(lex3)
   500→    else
   501→      let lex2 = skip_line_comment(lexer)
   502→      let lex3 = skip_whitespace(lex2)
   503→      skip_comments(lex3)
   504→  else
   505→    lexer
   506→
   507→function read_operator_or_delimiter(lexer: Lexer): (Lexer, Token) =
   508→  let ch = lexer.ch
   509→  let next = peek_char(lexer)
   510→  let lex2 = read_char(lexer)
   511→
   512→  match ch {
   513→    "+" ->
   514→      if next == "=" then
   515→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusAssign, "+="))
   516→      else if next == "+" then
   517→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPlusPlus, "++"))
   518→      else
   519→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPlus, "+")),
   520→
   521→    "-" ->
   522→      if next == "=" then
   523→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenMinusAssign, "-="))
   524→      else
   525→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenMinus, "-")),
   526→
   527→    "*" ->
   528→      if next == "=" then
   529→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenStarAssign, "*="))
   530→      else if next == "*" then
   531→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenPower, "^"))
   532→      else
   533→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenStar, "*")),
   534→
   535→    "/" ->
   536→      if next == "=" then
   537→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenSlashAssign, "/="))
   538→      else if next == "/" then
   539→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleSlash, "//"))
   540→      else
   541→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSlash, "/")),
   542→
   543→    "=" ->
   544→      if next == "=" then
   545→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenEqual, "=="))
   546→      else if next == ">" then
   547→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenFatArrow, "=>"))
   548→      else
   549→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAssign, "=")),
   550→
   551→    "!" ->
   552→      if next == "=" then
   553→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenNotEqual, "!="))
   554→      else
   555→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenNot, "!")),
   556→
   557→    "<" ->
   558→      if next == "=" then
   559→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLessEqual, "<="))
   560→      else if next == "<" then
   561→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenLeftShift, "<<"))
   562→      else
   563→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLess, "<")),
   564→
   565→    ">" ->
   566→      if next == "=" then
   567→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenGreaterEqual, ">="))
   568→      else if next == ">" then
   569→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenRightShift, ">>"))
   570→      else
   571→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenGreater, ">")),
   572→
   573→    "(" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftParen, "(")),
   574→    ")" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightParen, ")")),
   575→    "[" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBracket, "[")),
   576→    "]" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBracket, "]")),
   577→    "{" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenLeftBrace, "{")),
   578→    "}" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenRightBrace, "}")),
   579→    "," -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenComma, ",")),
   580→    ";" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenSemicolon, ";")),
   581→    "." ->
   582→      if next == "." && peek_char_n(lexer, 2) == "." then
   583→        (read_char(read_char(lex2)), make_token(lexer, TokenEllipsis, "..."))
   584→      else
   585→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDot, ".")),
   586→    ":" ->
   587→      if next == ":" then
   588→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoubleColon, "::"))
   589→      else
   590→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenColon, ":")),
   591→    "?" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenQuestion, "?")),
   592→    "\\" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenBackslash, "\\")),
   593→    "$" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenDollar, "$")),
   594→    "&" ->
   595→      if next == "&" then
   596→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersandAmpersand, "&&"))
   597→      else
   598→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenAmpersand, "&")),
   599→    "|" ->
   600→      if next == "|" then
   601→        (read_char(lex2), make_token(lexer, TokenDoublePipe, "||"))
   602→      else
   603→        (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenPipe, "|")),
   604→    "^" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenXor, "^")),
   605→    "~" -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, TokenTilde, "~")),
   606→    _ -> (lex2, make_token(lexer, "UNKNOWN", ch)),
   607→  }
   608→
   609→# ============================================================================
   610→# Part 8: 전체 토크나이제이션 (Tokenize)
   611→# ============================================================================
   612→
   613→function tokenize(lexer: Lexer): [Token] =
   614→  tokenize_loop(lexer, [])
   615→
   616→function tokenize_loop(lexer: Lexer, tokens: [Token]): [Token] =
   617→  let (lex2, token) = next_token(lexer)
   618→  let tokens2 = tokens.push(token)
   619→
   620→  if token.type == TokenEOF then
   621→    tokens2
   622→  else
   623→    tokenize_loop(lex2, tokens2)
   624→
