# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" || ch == "!" || ch == "&" || ch == "|" || ch == ">" || ch == "<" then
      # 2문자 연산자 확인
      let next_ch = if i + 1 < source.length() then source.substring(i + 1, i + 2) else "" end
      let op_value = ch
      let op_len = 1

      if (ch == "=" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "=="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "!" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "!="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "-" && next_ch == ">") then
        op_value = "->"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "&" && next_ch == "&") then
        op_value = "&&"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "|" && next_ch == "|") then
        op_value = "||"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == ">" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = ">="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "<" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "<="
        op_len = 2
      end

      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: op_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + op_len
      i = i + op_len

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 — 다음 statement keyword까지 수집
          while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

record TypeEnv =
  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }

  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
      for param in child.params do
        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
        if parts.length() == 2 then
          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
          env.vars.push(param_name)
          env.types.push(param_type)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # 타입 검사 수행
  match check_node(ast, env) {
    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# Type Checker Helper
# ==========================================

function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
    _ -> Ok(node)
  }

function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()

  for child in node.children do
    match check_node(child, env) {
      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
    }
  end

  node.children = new_children
  Ok(node)

function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?

  let return_type = node.value

  # 반환 타입 검증
  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
  else
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # let 문장 타입 검증
  let var_type = node.value

  if var_type == "Unknown" then
    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
  else
    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(var_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # const 문장 타입 검증
  let const_type = node.value

  if const_type == "Unknown" then
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
  else
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(const_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

# ==========================================
# Type Validation Helper
# ==========================================

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
  type_name == "Int" ||
  type_name == "Float" ||
  type_name == "String" ||
  type_name == "Bool" ||
  type_name == "Void" ||
  type_name == "Unit" ||
  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
  type_name.contains("Option[")

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = string_index_of(type_str, "[") + 1
    let end = string_index_of(type_str, "]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# String Helper 함수
# ==========================================

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  let found = -1
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
      if candidate == substr then
        found = i
        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  found

function string_trim(s: String): String =
  # 좌우 공백 제거
  let start = 0
  let end = s.length()
  let found_start = false

  # 앞 공백 찾기
  while start < end && !found_start do
    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      start = start + 1
    else
      found_start = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  # 뒤 공백 찾기
  let found_end = false
  while end > start && !found_end do
    let ch = s.substring(end - 1, end)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      end = end - 1
    else
      found_end = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  s.substring(start, end)

function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
  let result = Array[String]()
  let current = ""
  let i = 0

  while i < s.length() do
    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
      if candidate == sep then
        result.push(current)
        current = ""
        i = i + sep.length()
      else
        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  result.push(current)
  result

# ==========================================
# Helper: 파일 I/O
# ==========================================

function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 에러 반환
  Err("File I/O not implemented")

function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 성공 반환
  Ok(Unit)

# ==========================================
# Main
# ==========================================

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Compiler v0.4.0")
  println("========================================")
  println("")

  # 테스트: 간단한 소스 컴파일
  let source = "function hello(): Unit = println(\"Hi\")"

  match compile_source(source) {
    Ok(code) -> (
      println("Compilation successful!")
      println("")
      println("Generated FV 2.0 code:")
      println("----------------------------------------")
      println(code)
      println("----------------------------------------")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("Compilation failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" || ch == "!" || ch == "&" || ch == "|" || ch == ">" || ch == "<" then
      # 2문자 연산자 확인
      let next_ch = if i + 1 < source.length() then source.substring(i + 1, i + 2) else "" end
      let op_value = ch
      let op_len = 1

      if (ch == "=" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "=="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "!" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "!="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "-" && next_ch == ">") then
        op_value = "->"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "&" && next_ch == "&") then
        op_value = "&&"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "|" && next_ch == "|") then
        op_value = "||"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == ">" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = ">="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "<" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "<="
        op_len = 2
      end

      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: op_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + op_len
      i = i + op_len

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 — 다음 statement keyword까지 수집
          while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집 — 다음 statement keyword까지
      while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

record TypeEnv =
  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }

  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
      for param in child.params do
        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
        if parts.length() == 2 then
          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
          env.vars.push(param_name)
          env.types.push(param_type)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # 타입 검사 수행
  match check_node(ast, env) {
    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# Type Checker Helper
# ==========================================

function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
    _ -> Ok(node)
  }

function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()

  for child in node.children do
    match check_node(child, env) {
      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
    }
  end

  node.children = new_children
  Ok(node)

function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?

  let return_type = node.value

  # 반환 타입 검증
  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
  else
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # let 문장 타입 검증
  let var_type = node.value

  if var_type == "Unknown" then
    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
  else
    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(var_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # const 문장 타입 검증
  let const_type = node.value

  if const_type == "Unknown" then
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
  else
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(const_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

# ==========================================
# Type Validation Helper
# ==========================================

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
  type_name == "Int" ||
  type_name == "Float" ||
  type_name == "String" ||
  type_name == "Bool" ||
  type_name == "Void" ||
  type_name == "Unit" ||
  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
  type_name.contains("Option[")

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = string_index_of(type_str, "[") + 1
    let end = string_index_of(type_str, "]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# String Helper 함수
# ==========================================

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  let found = -1
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
      if candidate == substr then
        found = i
        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  found

function string_trim(s: String): String =
  # 좌우 공백 제거
  let start = 0
  let end = s.length()
  let found_start = false

  # 앞 공백 찾기
  while start < end && !found_start do
    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      start = start + 1
    else
      found_start = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  # 뒤 공백 찾기
  let found_end = false
  while end > start && !found_end do
    let ch = s.substring(end - 1, end)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      end = end - 1
    else
      found_end = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  s.substring(start, end)

function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
  let result = Array[String]()
  let current = ""
  let i = 0

  while i < s.length() do
    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
      if candidate == sep then
        result.push(current)
        current = ""
        i = i + sep.length()
      else
        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  result.push(current)
  result

# ==========================================
# Helper: 파일 I/O
# ==========================================

function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 에러 반환
  Err("File I/O not implemented")

function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # FV 2.0 native 필요
  # 임시: 성공 반환
  Ok(Unit)

# ==========================================
# Main
# ==========================================

function main(): Unit =
  println("========================================")
  println("FV-Julia Compiler v0.4.0")
  println("========================================")
  println("")

  # 테스트: 간단한 소스 컴파일
  let source = "function hello(): Unit = println(\"Hi\")"

  match compile_source(source) {
    Ok(code) -> (
      println("Compilation successful!")
      println("")
      println("Generated FV 2.0 code:")
      println("----------------------------------------")
      println(code)
      println("----------------------------------------")
    ),
    Err(msg) -> println("Compilation failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
# ==========================================
# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
# 출력: FV 2.0 코드
# ==========================================

record CompilerConfig =
  input_file: String
  output_file: String
  optimize: Bool
  debug: Bool

record CompileResult =
  success: Bool
  output: String
  error_msg: String
  warnings: Array[String]

# ==========================================
# 메인 컴파일 함수
# ==========================================

function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
  # 파일 읽기
  match read_file(input_file) {
    Ok(source) -> (
      # 컴파일 수행
      match compile_source(source) {
        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
  }

function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
  # 1. Lexer
  let tokens = tokenize(source)

  # 2. Parser
  match parse(tokens) {
    Ok(ast) -> (
      # 3. Type Checker
      match type_check(ast) {
        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
          # 4. Code Generator
          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
          Ok(code)
        ),
        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
      }
    ),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
# ==========================================

record Token =
  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
  value: String
  line: Int
  col: Int

function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
  let tokens = []
  let line = 1
  let col = 1
  let i = 0

  while i < source.length() do
    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)

    # 공백/개행
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    else if ch == "\n" then
      line = line + 1
      col = 1
      i = i + 1

    # 주석
    else if ch == "#" then
      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
        i = i + 1
      end

    # 문자열
    else if ch == "\"" then
      let str_start = i + 1
      i = i + 1
      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
      i = i + 1
      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2

    # 숫자
    else if is_digit(ch) then
      let num_start = i
      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - num_start)

    # 식별자/키워드
    else if is_alpha(ch) then
      let id_start = i
      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
        i = i + 1
      end
      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + (i - id_start)

    # 연산자/구두점
    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" || ch == "!" || ch == "&" || ch == "|" || ch == ">" || ch == "<" then
      # 2문자 연산자 확인
      let next_ch = if i + 1 < source.length() then source.substring(i + 1, i + 2) else "" end
      let op_value = ch
      let op_len = 1

      if (ch == "=" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "=="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "!" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "!="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "-" && next_ch == ">") then
        op_value = "->"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "&" && next_ch == "&") then
        op_value = "&&"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "|" && next_ch == "|") then
        op_value = "||"
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == ">" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = ">="
        op_len = 2
      else if (ch == "<" && next_ch == "=") then
        op_value = "<="
        op_len = 2
      end

      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: op_value, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + op_len
      i = i + op_len

    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1

    else
      col = col + 1
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  tokens

function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
  ch == "8" || ch == "9"

function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")

function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)

function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

# ==========================================
# 2. Parser (AST)
# ==========================================

record ASTNode =
  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
  name: String
  params: Array[String]
  body: String
  value: String
  children: Array[ASTNode]

function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let root = ASTNode {
    type: "program",
    name: "main",
    params: [],
    body: "",
    value: "",
    children: []
  }

  let i = 0
  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
  let line = 1

  while i < tokens.length() do
    let token = tokens[i]

    # 함수 정의 파싱
    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> (
          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
          i = i + 1
        )
      }

    # let 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # const 문장 파싱
    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
          children.push(node)
          i = next_i
        ),
        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
      }

    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  root.children = children
  Ok(root)

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음

  # 함수명
  if i >= tokens.length() then
    Err("Expected function name")
  else
    let name_token = tokens[i]
    let func_name = name_token.value
    i = i + 1

    # 파라미터 목록
    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
      Err("Expected (")
    else
      i = i + 1
      let params = Array[String]()

      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
          let param_name = tokens[i].value
          i = i + 1

          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
            i = i + 1
            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
              let param_type = tokens[i].value
              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
              i = i + 1
            end
          end
        end

        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      if i >= tokens.length() then
        Err("Expected )")
      else
        i = i + 1

        # 반환 타입
        let return_type = "Void"
        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
          i = i + 1
          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
            return_type = tokens[i].value
            i = i + 1
          end
        end

        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
          Err("Expected =")
        else
          i = i + 1
          let body = ""

          # 표현식 파싱 — 다음 statement keyword까지 수집
          while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
            i = i + 1
          end

          let node = ASTNode {
            type: "function",
            name: func_name,
            params: params,
            body: body,
            value: return_type,
            children: []
          }

          Ok((node, i))
        end
      end
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # let name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected variable name")
  else
    let var_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let var_type = "Unknown"
    let var_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        var_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집 — 다음 statement keyword까지
      while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "let",
        name: var_name,
        params: [],
        body: var_value,
        value: var_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
# ==========================================

function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
  # const name: Type = value
  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음

  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
    Err("Expected constant name")
  else
    let const_name = tokens[i].value
    i = i + 1

    let const_type = "Unknown"
    let const_value = ""

    # 타입 지정 (선택)
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
      i = i + 1
      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
        const_type = tokens[i].value
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    # 할당
    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
      i = i + 1

      # 값 수집 — 다음 statement keyword까지
      while i < tokens.length() && !is_statement_start(tokens[i]) do
        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
        i = i + 1
      end

      let node = ASTNode {
        type: "const",
        name: const_name,
        params: [],
        body: const_value,
        value: const_type,
        children: []
      }

      Ok((node, i))
    else
      Err("Expected =")
    end
  end

# ==========================================
# 3. Type Checker
# ==========================================

record TypeEnv =
  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types

function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }

  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
      for param in child.params do
        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
        if parts.length() == 2 then
          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
          env.vars.push(param_name)
          env.types.push(param_type)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  # 타입 검사 수행
  match check_node(ast, env) {
    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
  }

# ==========================================
# Type Checker Helper
# ==========================================

function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  match node.type {
    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
    _ -> Ok(node)
  }

function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()

  for child in node.children do
    match check_node(child, env) {
      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
    }
  end

  node.children = new_children
  Ok(node)

function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?

  let return_type = node.value

  # 반환 타입 검증
  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
  else
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # let 문장 타입 검증
  let var_type = node.value

  if var_type == "Unknown" then
    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
  else
    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(var_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
  # const 문장 타입 검증
  let const_type = node.value

  if const_type == "Unknown" then
    Ok(node)
  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
  else
    env.vars.push(node.name)
    env.types.push(const_type)
    Ok(node)
  end

# ==========================================
# Type Validation Helper
# ==========================================

function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
  type_name == "Int" ||
  type_name == "Float" ||
  type_name == "String" ||
  type_name == "Bool" ||
  type_name == "Void" ||
  type_name == "Unit" ||
  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
  type_name.contains("Option[")

# ==========================================
# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
# ==========================================

function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
  let code = ""

  # 헤더
  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"

  # 함수 정의 생성
  for child in ast.children do
    if child.type == "function" then
      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
    else if child.type == "let" then
      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
    else if child.type == "const" then
      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
    end
  end

  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
  if !code.contains("fn main") then
    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
    code = code + "}\n"
  end

  code

# ==========================================
# Code Generator Helpers
# ==========================================

function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
  # →
  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }

  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("

  # 파라미터 변환
  let param_strs = Array[String]()
  for param in node.params do
    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
  end
  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"

  # 반환 타입
  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"

  # 함수 본문
  code = code + "  return " + node.body + "\n"
  code = code + "}"

  code

function generate_let(node: ASTNode): String =
  # let name: Type = value
  # →
  # let name: type = value

  let code = "let " + node.name
  let var_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + var_type + " := " + node.body

  code

function generate_const(node: ASTNode): String =
  # const name: Type = value
  # →
  # const name: type = value

  let code = "const " + node.name
  let const_type = map_type(node.value)
  code = code + ": " + const_type + " = " + node.body

  code

function convert_param(param: String): String =
  # "name: Type" → "name type"
  let parts = string_split(param, ":")
  if parts.length() == 2 then
    let name = string_trim(parts[0])
    let type_str = string_trim(parts[1])
    let fv_type = map_type(type_str)
    name + " " + fv_type
  else
    param
  end

function join_params(params: Array[String]): String =
  let result = ""
  for i in 0:params.length() do
    if i > 0 then
      result = result + ", "
    end
    result = result + params[i]
  end
  result

function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
  match fj_type {
    "Int" -> "i32",
    "Float" -> "f64",
    "String" -> "string",
    "Bool" -> "bool",
    "Void" -> "void",
    "Unit" -> "void",
    _ -> (
      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
        let mapped = map_type(elem)
        "[]" + mapped
      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
        "Result"
      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
        "?"
      else
        fj_type
      end
    )
  }

function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
    let start = string_index_of(type_str, "[") + 1
    let end = string_index_of(type_str, "]")
    type_str.substring(start, end)
  else
    "Unknown"
  end

# ==========================================
# String Helper 함수
# ==========================================

function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
  let i = 0
  let found = -1
  while i < s.length() do
    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
      if candidate == substr then
        found = i
        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
      else
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  found

function string_trim(s: String): String =
  # 좌우 공백 제거
  let start = 0
  let end = s.length()
  let found_start = false

  # 앞 공백 찾기
  while start < end && !found_start do
    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      start = start + 1
    else
      found_start = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  # 뒤 공백 찾기
  let found_end = false
  while end > start && !found_end do
    let ch = s.substring(end - 1, end)
    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
      end = end - 1
    else
      found_end = true  # 루프 종료
    end
  end

  s.substring(start, end)

function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
  let result = Array[String]()
  let current = ""
  let i = 0

  while i < s.length() do
    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
      if candidate == sep then
        result.push(current)
        current = ""
        i = i + sep.length()
      else
        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
      end
    else
      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
      i = i + 1
    end
  end

  result.push(current)
  result
